alteration.z: 裁缝对这条裙子做了一点小改动，使它更合身。

alternative.s: If the train is full, we can take the bus as an alternative.
alternative.z: 如果火车满员了，我们可以改乘公交车作为替代方案。

alternatively.s: If the train is full, you can alternatively take the bus to the airport.
alternatively.z: 如果火车满员了，你 alternatively 可以改乘公交车去机场。

altogether.s: The trip was expensive altogether, but we enjoyed every moment of it.
altogether.z: 这次旅行总共花费很高，但我们享受了其中的每一刻。

aluminium.s: The frame of the new bicycle is made of light aluminium, so it is easy to carry.
aluminium.z: 这辆新自行车的车架由轻质铝制成，因此很容易搬运。

amateur.s: As an amateur photographer, he spends every weekend taking pictures in the park.
amateur.z: 作为一名业余摄影爱好者，他每个周末都在公园里拍照。

ambient.s: The soft ambient light in the library makes it a comfortable place to study.
ambient.z: 图书馆里柔和的环境光线使它成为一个舒适的学习场所。

ambiguous.s: The manager's ambiguous answer left everyone unsure about what to do next.
ambiguous.z: 经理含糊其辞的回答让大家都不确定接下来该做什么。

ambition.s: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in poor areas.
ambition.z: 她的志向是成为一名医生，帮助贫困地区的人们。

ambitious.s: She is ambitious enough to apply for the top graduate program in the country.
ambitious.z: 她雄心勃勃，足以申请全国顶尖的研究生项目。

america.s: Many students dream of studying in America after they finish college.
america.z: 许多学生梦想大学毕业后去美国留学。

american.s: Many American students study abroad for a semester to experience different cultures.
american.z: 许多美国学生出国学习一个学期，以体验不同的文化。

amid.s: She kept smiling amid the noise and confusion of the crowded market.
amid.z: 在拥挤市场的嘈杂与混乱中，她一直保持着微笑。

among.s: She felt nervous among so many experienced colleagues at the meeting.
among.z: 在会议上这么多经验丰富的同事中间，她感到紧张。

amongst.s: She felt nervous amongst so many experienced professors at the academic conference.
amongst.z: 在学术会议上被这么多经验丰富的教授围着，她感到紧张。

amount.s: A large amount of time was spent preparing for the final exam.
amount.z: 大量时间被花在准备期末考试上。

ampere.s: The fuse is rated for ten amperes, so it will melt if the current gets too high.
ampere.z: 这个保险丝的额定电流是十安培，因此电流过高时它就会熔断。

amplify.s: The new equipment can amplify the weak signal so that everyone can hear it clearly.
amplify.z: 新设备可以放大微弱的信号，以便每个人都能清楚地听到。

amplitude.s: Scientists measured the amplitude of the sound waves to determine how loud the noise was.
amplitude.z: 科学家测量了声波的振幅，以确定噪音有多大。

amusement.s: The children screamed with amusement as the clown performed funny tricks at the party.
amusement.z: 当小丑在聚会上表演滑稽的把戏时，孩子们开心得尖叫起来。

amusing.s: The comedian told an amusing story that made the whole audience laugh.
amusing.z: 那位喜剧演员讲了一个有趣的故事，让全场观众都笑了。

analogous.s: The teacher explained that learning a language is analogous to learning to play an instrument.
analogous.z: 老师解释说，学习一门语言类似于学习演奏一种乐器。

analogy.s: The teacher used a simple analogy to explain how the brain stores memories.
analogy.z: 老师用一个简单的类比来解释大脑如何储存记忆。

analyse.s: Scientists carefully analyse the data before drawing any final conclusions.
analyse.z: 科学家在得出任何最终结论之前会仔细分析数据。

analysis.s: Her careful analysis of the data revealed several unexpected trends.
analysis.z: 她对数据的仔细分析揭示了几个意想不到的趋势。

analytical.s: She wrote an analytical essay that examined both sides of the debate.
analytical.z: 她写了一篇分析性文章，探讨了这场辩论的双方观点。

ancestor.s: Many families visit their ancestors' graves to clean them during the spring festival.
ancestor.z: 春节期间，许多家庭会去扫墓祭拜祖先。

anchor.s: The old fishing boat dropped its anchor near the shore before sunset.
anchor.z: 那艘旧渔船在日落前在岸边附近抛下了锚。

anger.s: His rude remarks filled her with anger during the meeting.
anger.z: 他在会上粗鲁的言论让她满腔怒火。

angle.s: From this angle, the old bridge looks much longer than it really is.
angle.z: 从这个角度看，那座旧桥显得比实际长得多。

announce.s: The company will announce the results of the survey tomorrow morning.
announce.z: 公司将于明天上午公布调查结果。

announcer.s: The announcer told the crowd that the game would start in ten minutes.
announcer.z: 播音员告诉观众比赛将在十分钟后开始。

annual.s: The company holds an annual meeting to discuss its goals for the coming year.
annual.z: 公司举行年度会议，讨论来年的目标。

annually.s: The company reviews its safety rules annually to keep every worker protected.
annually.z: 公司每年审查其安全规定，以确保每位工人都受到保护。

anode.s: In a battery, electrons flow from the anode to the cathode during discharge.
anode.z: 在电池中，放电时电子从阳极流向阴极。

anonymous.s: The survey was conducted anonymously so that students could share their honest opinions.
anonymous.z: 这项调查以匿名方式进行，以便学生们能够分享他们的真实看法。

ant.s: A tiny ant carried a piece of bread across the kitchen floor.
ant.z: 一只小蚂蚁把一块面包搬过了厨房地板。

anticipate.s: We anticipate that the new policy will reduce costs for most families.
anticipate.z: 我们预计新政策将为大多数家庭降低成本。

anxiety.s: Many students feel great anxiety before important exams and find it hard to sleep.
anxiety.z: 许多学生在重要考试前感到极度焦虑，并且难以入睡。

anxious.s: She felt anxious about the exam results and could hardly sleep last night.
anxious.z: 她对考试结果感到焦虑，昨晚几乎睡不着。

anyone.s: Anyone who wants to join the trip should sign up before Friday.
anyone.z: 任何想参加这次旅行的人都应在周五之前报名。

apartment.s: She rented a small apartment near the university to save time on commuting.
apartment.z: 为了节省通勤时间，她在大学附近租了一间小公寓。

apathy.s: The teacher was worried by the apathy of students who never asked questions.
apathy.z: 老师对从不提问的学生的冷漠感到担忧。

apologize.s: You should apologize to your roommate for borrowing her notes without asking.
apologize.z: 你应该为没有打招呼就借用室友的笔记而向她道歉。

apology.s: She offered a sincere apology for arriving late to the important meeting.
apology.z: 她因为重要会议迟到而真诚地道歉。

appeal.s: The new policy appeals to young people who care about the environment.
appeal.z: 这项新政策吸引了关心环境的年轻人。

appealing.s: The idea of studying abroad sounds appealing, but it requires careful planning.
appealing.z: 出国留学的想法听起来很吸引人，但这需要周密的计划。

appearance.s: Her calm appearance hid the fact that she was extremely nervous.
appearance.z: 她平静的外表掩盖了她极度紧张的事实。

appetite.s: Regular exercise can help you build a healthy appetite and improve your sleep.
appetite.z: 规律锻炼有助于你形成健康的食欲并改善睡眠。

applause.s: The audience burst into loud applause when the young singer finished her song.
applause.z: 当那位年轻歌手唱完歌时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。

applicable.s: This rule is applicable to all students who live on campus.
applicable.z: 这条规定适用于所有住校的学生。

applicant.s: Each applicant must submit two letters of recommendation before the deadline.
applicant.z: 每位申请者必须在截止日期前提交两封推荐信。

application.s: She submitted her application for the scholarship before the deadline last week.
application.z: 她上周在截止日期前提交了奖学金申请。

apply.s: Students who apply for the scholarship must submit their essays before Friday.
apply.z: 申请奖学金的学生必须在周五之前提交论文。

appointment.s: She made an appointment with the doctor for next Monday afternoon.
appointment.z: 她预约了下周一下午去看医生。

appraisal.s: The manager gave a fair appraisal of each employee's performance during the review.
appraisal.z: 经理在评估期间对每位员工的表现做出了公正的评价。

appreciable.s: There was an appreciable improvement in her grades after she started studying every evening.
appreciable.z: 她开始每天晚上学习之后，成绩有了明显的提高。

appreciate.s: I really appreciate your help with the report before the deadline.
appreciate.z: 我非常感激你在截止日期前帮我完成这份报告。

appreciation.s: Her sincere appreciation for his help made him feel truly valued.
appreciation.z: 她对他帮助的真诚感激让他感到自己被真正重视。

appreciative.s: The students were very appreciative of the extra help their teacher offered before the exam.
appreciative.z: 学生们非常感谢老师在考试前提供的额外帮助。

approach.s: We need a new approach to solving this problem before the deadline.
approach.z: 我们需要在截止日期前找到解决这个问题的新方法。

appropriate.s: Please choose an appropriate time to discuss this issue with your professor.
appropriate.z: 请选择一个合适的时间与你的教授讨论这个问题。

appropriation.s: Critics argued that the appropriation of local traditions by fashion brands often ignores their cultural meaning.
appropriation.z: 批评者认为，时尚品牌对当地传统的挪用往往忽视了其文化内涵。

approval.s: The manager gave his approval to the new plan after a long discussion.
approval.z: 经过长时间讨论后，经理批准了这项新计划。

approve.s: Her parents did not approve of the decision to study abroad.
approve.z: 她的父母不赞成她出国留学的决定。

approximately.s: The whole trip takes approximately three hours by train from the city center.
approximately.z: 从市中心坐火车走完整个行程大约需要三个小时。

apt.s: She is apt to forget her keys when she leaves in a hurry.
apt.z: 她匆忙离开时容易忘带钥匙。

aptly.s: Her speech was aptly described as inspiring and full of hope by the audience.
aptly.z: 观众恰当地将她的演讲形容为鼓舞人心且充满希望。

arabian.s: The old merchant told us stories about his journeys across the Arabian desert.
arabian.z: 那位老商人给我们讲述了他在阿拉伯沙漠中旅行的故事。

arbitrary.s: The teacher made an arbitrary decision without asking for the students' opinions.
arbitrary.z: 老师没有征求学生的意见就做出了武断的决定。

architect.s: The architect designed a bright, open library that quickly became the heart of the community.
architect.z: 这位建筑师设计了一座明亮开阔的图书馆，它很快成为社区的中心。

architecture.s: She studied the architecture of ancient temples during her summer trip to the countryside.
architecture.z: 她在夏天去乡村旅行时研究了古代寺庙的建筑。

archive.s: The library keeps old newspapers in its archive for students to study.
archive.z: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案室里供学生研究。

arctic.s: Scientists warn that arctic temperatures are rising faster than anywhere else on Earth.
arctic.z: 科学家警告，北极地区的气温上升速度比地球上任何其他地方都快。

area.s: The library has a quiet area where students can study without any distractions.
area.z: 图书馆有一个安静的区域，学生可以在那里不受干扰地学习。

argue.s: She often argues with her roommate about who should clean the shared kitchen.
argue.z: 她经常和室友争论谁该打扫共用的厨房。

argument.s: Their argument about the budget lasted for hours without any clear conclusion.
argument.z: 他们关于预算的争论持续了几个小时，也没有得出明确的结论。

arm.s: She carried the heavy box in her arms and climbed the stairs slowly.
arm.z: 她用双臂抱着那个沉重的箱子，慢慢地爬上楼梯。

arouse.s: The teacher's question aroused the students' interest in the topic.
arouse.z: 老师的问题引起了学生们对这个话题的兴趣。

arrange.s: We need to arrange a meeting with the new manager before Friday.
arrange.z: 我们需要在周五之前安排与新经理的一次会面。

arrangement.s: We made an arrangement to meet at the library after class.
arrangement.z: 我们约定下课后在图书馆见面。

array.s: The teacher displayed a wide array of colorful books for the students to choose from.
array.z: 老师展示了各种各样的彩色书籍供学生选择。

arrest.s: The police arrested the thief shortly after he tried to escape from the store.
arrest.z: 小偷试图从商店逃跑后不久，警察就逮捕了他。

arrival.s: Her sudden arrival at the party surprised all of us.
arrival.z: 她突然出现在聚会上，让我们所有人都感到惊讶。

arrogant.s: His arrogant attitude during the meeting made it difficult for others to share their ideas.
arrogant.z: 他在会议上傲慢的态度让其他人很难分享自己的想法。

artificial.s: Some people worry that artificial intelligence will replace many workers in the near future.
artificial.z: 有些人担心人工智能在不久的将来会取代许多工人。

artist.s: The young artist spent hours painting a quiet scene by the river.
artist.z: 这位年轻的艺术家花了几个小时在河边画一幅宁静的风景。

artistic.s: She has a highly artistic way of arranging flowers in simple glass vases.
artistic.z: 她在简单的玻璃花瓶里插花时有一种极具艺术感的摆法。

asia.s: Many students from Asia study at universities in Europe and North America.
asia.z: 许多来自亚洲的学生在欧洲和北美的大学学习。

asian.s: Many Asian students study hard to improve their English before the exam.
asian.z: 许多亚洲学生努力学习以提高他们的英语水平，为考试做准备。

aspect.s: The most important aspect of learning a language is practicing it every day.
aspect.z: 学习语言最重要的方面是每天练习。

aspiration.s: Her aspiration to become a doctor motivated her to study hard every day.
aspiration.z: 她成为医生的志向激励着她每天努力学习。

aspirational.s: Many young graduates set aspirational goals that seem impossible at first but become achievable through steady effort.
aspirational.z: 许多年轻毕业生设定了起初看似不可能、但通过稳步努力便能实现的远大目标。

assassination.s: The sudden assassination of the leader shocked the entire nation and changed its history.
assassination.z: 领导人的突然暗杀震惊了全国，并改变了这个国家的历史。

assemble.s: The workers will assemble the new machine before the factory opens next week.
assemble.z: 工人们将在下周工厂开业前组装这台新机器。

assembly.s: The whole school gathered in the hall for the morning assembly before classes began.
assembly.z: 上课前，全校师生聚集在礼堂里参加晨会。

assert.s: She asserted that the new policy would benefit students in the long run.
assert.z: 她断言这项新政策从长远来看会使学生受益。

assertive.s: She became more assertive in meetings after gaining confidence in her new role.
assertive.z: 在新岗位上获得自信后，她在会议上变得更加果断。

assess.s: Teachers assess students' progress through regular quizzes and final exams.
assess.z: 教师通过定期的测验和期末考试来评估学生的进步。

assessment.s: The teacher's assessment of our progress was fair and detailed.
assessment.z: 老师对我们进步的评估公正而详细。

asset.s: Her ability to speak three languages is a valuable asset in the job market.
asset.z: 她会说三种语言的能力在就业市场上是一项宝贵的资产。

assign.s: The teacher decided to assign each student a different topic for the final project.
assign.z: 老师决定为每个学生分配一个不同的期末项目主题。

assignment.s: She stayed up late to finish her assignment before the deadline.
assignment.z: 她熬夜赶在截止日期前完成了作业。

assimilate.s: Immigrants often assimilate into the local culture within a few generations.
assimilate.z: 移民往往在几代人内就融入了当地文化。

assimilation.s: The assimilation of new ideas into local culture takes many years.
assimilation.z: 新思想融入当地文化需要很多年的时间。

assist.s: Several volunteers assisted the elderly residents during the community health check last weekend.
assist.z: 上周末，几位志愿者在社区健康检查中协助了老年居民。

assistance.s: She asked her classmate for assistance with the difficult homework assignment.
assistance.z: 她向同学求助完成那项困难的作业。

assistant.s: The professor asked his assistant to prepare the slides for tomorrow's lecture.
assistant.z: 教授让他的助手为明天的讲座准备幻灯片。

associate.s: People often associate the color green with feelings of calm and freshness.
associate.z: 人们常常把绿色与平静和清新的感觉联系在一起。

association.s: She joined a student association to meet new people and develop her leadership skills.
association.z: 她加入了一个学生社团，以结识新朋友并培养自己的领导能力。

assumption.s: Many students make the assumption that reading once is enough to pass the exam.
assumption.z: 许多学生想当然地认为读一遍就足以通过考试。

assurance.s: The manager gave us assurance that the project would be finished on time.
assurance.z: 经理向我们保证项目会按时完成。

assure.s: The doctor assured her that the test results were completely normal.
assure.z: 医生向她保证检查结果完全正常。

astonishment.s: To her astonishment, the quiet student gave a confident speech in front of the whole class.
astonishment.z: 令她惊讶的是，那个安静的学生在全班面前发表了一场自信的演讲。

astronomical.s: The cost of housing in big cities has become astronomical for young couples.
astronomical.z: 大城市的住房成本对年轻夫妇来说已经变得极其高昂。

astronomy.s: She became interested in astronomy after watching a documentary about the stars.
astronomy.z: 她看完一部关于星星的纪录片后对天文学产生了兴趣。

astrophysics.s: She decided to study astrophysics because she was fascinated by stars and planets.
astrophysics.z: 她决定学习天体物理学，因为她对恒星和行星充满好奇。

athletic.s: She stays athletic by running and swimming several times a week.
athletic.z: 她每周跑步和游泳几次，以保持健壮的体格。

athletics.s: She takes part in athletics every morning to stay healthy and full of energy.
athletics.z: 她每天早上参加田径运动，以保持健康和精力充沛。

atlantic.s: They crossed the Atlantic by boat to visit their relatives in another country.
atlantic.z: 他们乘船横渡大西洋去另一个国家探望亲戚。

atmosphere.s: The friendly atmosphere in the classroom encouraged shy students to share their ideas freely.
atmosphere.z: 教室里友好的氛围鼓励害羞的学生自由地分享他们的想法。

atmospheric.s: The atmospheric pressure dropped quickly before the storm arrived.
atmospheric.z: 暴风雨来临前，大气压迅速下降。

atomic.s: Scientists studied the atomic structure of the new material to understand its unusual properties.
atomic.z: 科学家研究了这种新材料的原子结构，以了解其不同寻常的特性。

attach.s: Please attach a recent photo to your application form before sending it.
attach.z: 寄出之前，请在你的申请表上附上一张近照。

attachment.s: Her strong attachment to her hometown made it difficult for her to move abroad.
attachment.z: 她对家乡的强烈依恋使她难以移居国外。

attack.s: The city launched a strong attack on air pollution by limiting car use.
attack.z: 这座城市通过限制汽车使用对空气污染发起了强有力的治理。

attain.s: She worked hard for years to attain her goal of becoming a doctor.
attain.z: 她多年努力工作，以实现成为医生的目标。

attempt.s: She made a serious attempt to finish the project before the deadline.
attempt.z: 她认真尝试在截止日期前完成这个项目。

attendance.s: Regular attendance at every lecture will help you understand the course material better.
attendance.z: 每节课都按时出勤会帮助你更好地理解课程内容。

attendant.s: The flight attendant kindly helped the elderly passenger find her seat.
attendant.z: 那位空乘人员热心地帮助老年乘客找到了她的座位。

attentive.s: The nurse was very attentive to the elderly patient throughout the night.
attentive.z: 那位护士整夜都对那位老年病人照顾得十分周到。

attitude.s: Her positive attitude toward challenges helped her succeed in the difficult exam.
attitude.z: 她对挑战持积极态度，这帮助她在艰难的考试中取得了成功。

attorney.s: The attorney explained the new contract terms to the nervous client before the meeting.
attorney.z: 律师在会议前向紧张的客户解释了新合同的条款。

attract.s: The new science museum attracts thousands of visitors every weekend.
attract.z: 这座新科学博物馆每个周末吸引成千上万的游客。

attraction.s: The new science museum has become a major attraction for families in our city.
attraction.z: 这座新科技馆已成为我们城市家庭的一大吸引人的去处。

attractive.s: The company offers an attractive salary and flexible working hours to new employees.
attractive.z: 公司为新员工提供丰厚的薪水和灵活的工作时间。

attribute.s: She attributes her success to hard work and careful planning.
attribute.z: 她把她的成功归功于努力工作和周密的计划。

auction.s: The charity will hold an auction to raise money for the local hospital.
auction.z: 该慈善机构将举行一场拍卖会，为当地医院筹集资金。

bristle.z: 当那只大声吠叫的狗突然出现时，这只猫因恐惧而毛都竖了起来。

britain.s: She plans to study in Britain for a year after she finishes college.
britain.z: 她计划大学毕业后去英国学习一年。

british.s: The British weather is often unpredictable, so you should always carry an umbrella.
british.z: 英国的天气常常难以预测，所以你应该总是带把伞。

brittle.s: The old paper was so brittle that it tore easily when I turned the page.
brittle.z: 那张旧纸太脆了，我翻页时很容易就撕破了。

broad.s: The professor gave a broad overview of the topic before discussing the details.
broad.z: 教授在讨论细节之前对该主题做了概括性的介绍。

broadcast.s: The station will broadcast the interview live at eight tonight.
broadcast.z: 该电台今晚八点将现场直播这次采访。

broaden.s: Reading books from different cultures can broaden your understanding of the world.
broaden.z: 阅读来自不同文化的书籍可以拓宽你对世界的理解。

broken.s: The washing machine has been broken for a week, so we wash clothes by hand.
broken.z: 洗衣机已经坏了一个星期了，所以我们只能手洗衣服。

brook.s: The small village is built beside a clear brook that flows down from the mountains.
brook.z: 这个小村庄建在一条从山上流下来的清澈小溪旁。

bruise.s: She fell off her bike and got a large bruise on her knee.
bruise.z: 她从自行车上摔了下来，膝盖上留下了一大块瘀伤。

brute.s: He pushed the heavy door open with brute force and rushed into the building.
brute.z: 他用蛮力推开沉重的大门，冲进了大楼。

budget.s: They planned a detailed budget before starting the home renovation project.
budget.z: 他们在开始房屋装修项目之前制定了详细的预算。

bug.s: A software bug caused the system to crash during the final exam.
bug.z: 一个软件漏洞导致系统在期末考试期间崩溃了。

bugle.s: The soldier woke everyone at dawn by playing his bugle loudly.
bugle.z: 士兵在黎明时分大声吹响军号，唤醒了所有人。

building.s: The old building at the corner of the street was torn down last year.
building.z: 街角的那栋旧建筑去年被拆除了。

bulb.s: She switched off the light bulb and went to bed early.
bulb.z: 她关掉灯泡，早早上床睡觉了。

bulk.s: The bulk of the students agreed that the new library rules were fair.
bulk.z: 大多数学生认为新的图书馆规定是公平的。

bull.s: The bull lowered its head and charged toward the fence.
bull.z: 那头公牛低下头，朝栅栏冲了过去。

burden.s: The heavy burden of student loans makes many graduates feel anxious about their future.
burden.z: 学生贷款的沉重负担让许多毕业生对自己的未来感到焦虑。

bureau.s: She went to the travel bureau to ask about cheap flights to the coast.
bureau.z: 她去旅行社询问飞往海滨的便宜航班。

bureaucracy.s: The new manager promised to cut through the bureaucracy and make decisions faster.
bureaucracy.z: 新经理承诺精简官僚程序，以便更快地做出决策。

burial.s: The family chose a quiet hillside for the burial of their beloved grandfather.
burial.z: 这家人选择了一个安静的山坡来安葬他们敬爱的祖父。

burner.s: She forgot to turn off the burner after boiling the soup.
burner.z: 煮完汤后她忘了关炉灶。

burst.s: She burst into tears when she heard the disappointing news about her exam results.
burst.z: 当她听到关于考试成绩的令人失望的消息时，她突然大哭起来。

bury.s: The dog likes to bury its bones in the garden behind the house.
bury.z: 这只狗喜欢把骨头埋在房子后面的花园里。

bushel.s: The farmer harvested a hundred bushels of corn before the heavy rain arrived.
bushel.z: 农民在暴雨来临前收获了一百蒲式耳的玉米。

buy.s: She decided to buy a new laptop before the semester started.
buy.z: 她决定在开学前买一台新笔记本电脑。

buzz.s: The buzz of conversation in the crowded café made it hard to concentrate.
buzz.z: 拥挤的咖啡馆里嗡嗡的交谈声让人难以集中注意力。

cabin.s: We rented a small wooden cabin near the lake for the weekend.
cabin.z: 我们周末在湖边租了一间小木屋。

cable.s: The workers used a long cable to connect the machine to the power supply.
cable.z: 工人们用一根长电缆把机器连接到电源上。

cage.s: The zookeeper carefully cleaned the cage before the birds were let outside.
cage.z: 饲养员在让鸟儿外出之前仔细地清洁了笼子。

calculate.s: Engineers must calculate the load capacity carefully before building the bridge.
calculate.z: 工程师在建造桥梁之前必须仔细计算承载能力。

calculation.s: After a careful calculation, she realized the trip would cost more than expected.
calculation.z: 经过仔细计算，她意识到这次旅行的花费会比预期更多。

calculator.s: She used a calculator to check her answers before handing in the math test.
calculator.z: 她在交数学试卷之前用计算器检查了答案。

calculus.s: He found calculus difficult at first, but daily practice made the problems much easier.
calculus.z: 他起初觉得微积分很难，但每天练习使这些题目变得容易多了。

calendar.s: I marked the exam dates on my calendar so I would not forget them.
calendar.z: 我把考试日期标在日历上，这样就不会忘记了。

calibration.s: Regular calibration of the instruments ensures that our measurements remain accurate.
calibration.z: 定期校准仪器可确保我们的测量结果保持准确。

calorie.s: Many students try to reduce their daily calorie intake by eating more vegetables and less fast food.
calorie.z: 许多学生试图通过多吃蔬菜、少吃快餐来减少每日的卡路里摄入量。

campaign.s: The students launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste on campus.
campaign.z: 学生们发起了一场减少校园塑料垃圾的运动。

campus.s: Students often gather on the campus lawn to relax between classes.
campus.z: 学生们经常在课间聚集在校园草坪上放松。

canada.s: She plans to study in Canada for one year after graduation.
canada.z: 她打算毕业后去加拿大学习一年。

canadian.s: My Canadian roommate taught me how to skate on the frozen lake last winter.
canadian.z: 我的加拿大室友去年冬天教我在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

canal.s: The city built a new canal to carry water to the farms.
canal.z: 这座城市修建了一条新运河，把水引到农田里。

cancel.s: The airline had to cancel several flights because of the heavy snow.
cancel.z: 由于大雪，航空公司不得不取消了好几个航班。

cancer.s: Regular exercise and a healthy diet may reduce the risk of cancer.
cancer.z: 定期锻炼和健康饮食可能降低患癌症的风险。

candidate.s: Each candidate must submit a written application before the deadline.
candidate.z: 每位候选人必须在截止日期前提交书面申请。

cap.s: He took off his cap and wiped the sweat from his forehead.
cap.z: 他摘下帽子，擦了擦额头上的汗水。

capability.s: She has the capability to solve complex problems quickly and efficiently.
capability.z: 她有能力和效率地快速解决复杂问题。

capable.s: She is capable of solving complex problems under great pressure.
capable.z: 她能够在巨大压力下解决复杂的问题。

capacitance.s: The engineer measured the capacitance of the circuit before connecting it to the power supply.
capacitance.z: 工程师在将电路连接到电源之前测量了它的电容。

capacitor.s: The old radio stopped working because one small capacitor inside it had burned out.
capacitor.z: 那台旧收音机停止工作了，因为里面的一个小电容器烧坏了。

capacity.s: This small room has the capacity to hold twenty people comfortably.
capacity.z: 这个小房间能舒适地容纳二十个人。

capital.s: The company needs more capital to expand its business into new markets.
capital.z: 公司需要更多资本才能将业务拓展到新市场。

capture.s: The photograph beautifully captures the peaceful atmosphere of the small village at dawn.
capture.z: 这张照片优美地捕捉到了黎明时分小村庄的宁静氛围。

carbon.s: Scientists warn that too much carbon in the atmosphere is causing global temperatures to rise.
carbon.z: 科学家警告说，大气中过多的碳正在导致全球气温上升。

career.s: She decided to change her career after working in the same company for ten years.
career.z: 在同一家公司工作十年后，她决定转行。

careful.s: She was careful to check every detail before signing the contract.
careful.z: 她在签署合同前仔细检查了每一个细节。

caregiver.s: The caregiver stayed by the old man's side and helped him with daily tasks.
caregiver.z: 护理员守在老人身边，帮助他处理日常事务。

careless.s: A careless mistake in the final exam cost him the scholarship he badly wanted.
careless.z: 期末考试中的一个粗心错误让他失去了他非常想要的奖学金。

carpentry.s: He learned basic carpentry skills from his grandfather and built a small wooden table.
carpentry.z: 他从祖父那里学到了基本的木工技能，并做了一张小木桌。

carpet.s: She spilled coffee on the carpet and spent an hour cleaning it.
carpet.z: 她把咖啡洒在地毯上，花了一个小时清理它。

carrier.s: The airline lost my luggage, so the carrier had to pay for a new suitcase.
carrier.z: 航空公司弄丢了我的行李，因此承运方不得不赔偿一个新的行李箱。

carry.s: She always carries an umbrella in her bag during the rainy season.
carry.z: 在雨季，她总是在包里带一把伞。

cartoon.s: The children laughed loudly while watching a funny cartoon about a clever mouse.
cartoon.z: 孩子们一边看一部关于聪明老鼠的搞笑动画片，一边大声笑着。

cartridge.s: Please replace the ink cartridge before you print the final report.
cartridge.z: 打印最终报告之前，请更换墨盒。

case.s: In this case, the teacher asked us to hand in our reports by Friday.
case.z: 在这种情况下，老师要求我们在周五前交报告。

cash.s: I don't have enough cash with me, so can I pay by card?
cash.z: 我身上没带足够的现金，所以可以刷卡支付吗？

cassette.s: My father still keeps his old cassette tapes in a box under the bed.
cassette.z: 我父亲仍然把他的旧磁带保存在床底下的一个盒子里。

castle.s: The old castle on the hill attracts thousands of visitors every summer.
castle.z: 山上的那座古老城堡每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

casual.s: She wore casual clothes to the party instead of a formal dress.
casual.z: 她穿着休闲服去参加聚会，而不是正式的礼服。

catalog.s: She opened the library catalog to find books about ancient history.
catalog.z: 她打开图书馆目录，寻找关于古代历史的书籍。

catalogue.s: She spent the afternoon browsing the catalogue for books on modern art.
catalogue.z: 她花了一下午翻阅现代艺术书籍的目录。

catalyst.s: The new policy acted as a catalyst for rapid economic growth in the region.
catalyst.z: 新政策成为该地区经济快速增长的催化剂。

catch.s: She ran fast to catch the bus before it left the station.
catch.z: 她跑得很快，想在公交车离站前赶上它。

category.s: Please place each book into the correct category before putting it on the shelf.
category.z: 请把每本书放入正确的类别，然后再放到书架上。

cater.s: The new cafeteria tries to cater to students who prefer vegetarian meals.
cater.z: 新食堂努力满足喜欢素食的学生的需求。

cattle.s: The farmer keeps about fifty cattle on his land near the river.
cattle.z: 这位农民在河边自己的土地上养了大约五十头牛。

cause.s: Heavy rain caused serious flooding in several villages along the river.
cause.z: 大雨导致河边几个村庄发生了严重的洪水。

caution.s: Please use caution when crossing this busy street during rush hour.
caution.z: 高峰时段过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cautious.s: She remained cautious about signing the contract before reading every detail.
cautious.z: 在阅读每个细节之前，她对签署合同仍持谨慎态度。

cease.s: The heavy rain finally ceased, and students hurried back to their dormitories.
cease.z: 大雨终于停了，学生们匆匆赶回宿舍。

ceiling.s: The ceiling of the old library was decorated with beautiful paintings.
ceiling.z: 旧图书馆的天花板上装饰着美丽的画作。

celebrate.s: We plan to celebrate her graduation with a small dinner at home.
celebrate.z: 我们打算在家办一顿小型晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

cell.s: Scientists found that a single cell can divide into two identical cells.
cell.z: 科学家发现，一个单细胞可以分裂成两个相同的细胞。

cement.s: The workers used cement to fix the broken wall of the old building.
cement.z: 工人们用水泥修补了那座旧建筑破损的墙壁。

census.s: The government conducts a census every ten years to count the population.
census.z: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查以统计人口数量。

centimetre.s: The table is about two centimetres thick, so it fits easily under the window.
centimetre.z: 这张桌子大约两厘米厚，所以很容易放在窗户下面。

central.s: The library is located in a central position on campus, making it easy for students to reach.
central.z: 图书馆位于校园的中心位置，学生们很容易到达。

centre.s: The new library stands at the centre of the campus and attracts many students.
centre.z: 新图书馆位于校园的中心，吸引了许多学生。

certain.s: She is certain that regular exercise will improve her overall health.
certain.z: 她确信经常锻炼会改善她的整体健康状况。

certainly.s: She will certainly pass the exam if she keeps practicing every day.
certainly.z: 如果她坚持每天练习，她肯定会通过考试。

certainty.s: She spoke with such certainty that everyone believed her prediction about the election.
certainty.z: 她说话如此笃定，以至于大家都相信了她对选举的预测。

certificate.s: She received a certificate after completing the online course successfully.
certificate.z: 她成功完成在线课程后获得了一张证书。

certification.s: She earned a teaching certification after completing two years of practical training.
certification.z: 她完成了两年的实践培训后获得了教学资格证书。

chain.s: She always chains her bike to the fence before going to class.
chain.z: 她上课前总是把自行车用链条锁在栅栏上。

chair.s: She pulled up a chair and sat down beside the window.
chair.z: 她拉过一把椅子，在窗边坐了下来。

chairman.s: The chairman opened the meeting by welcoming all the new members warmly.
chairman.z: 主席在会议开始时热情地欢迎了所有新成员。

challenge.z: 学习一门新语言可能是一个真正的挑战，但它也是值得的。

chamber.s: The judge entered the chamber and asked everyone to remain silent.
chamber.z: 法官走进议事厅，要求所有人保持安静。

channel.s: She channels her energy into studying every evening after dinner.
channel.z: 她每天晚饭后都把精力投入到学习中。

chaos.z: 突然停电后，整个办公室陷入了彻底的混乱。

chap.z: 隔壁那位老伙计总是面带友善的微笑跟我们打招呼。

character.s: Her honest character impressed everyone at the meeting.
character.z: 她诚实的品格给会上的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

characteristic.s: Patience is a characteristic that every good teacher should develop.
characteristic.z: 耐心是每位好老师都应培养的一种特质。

characterize.s: Long working hours and low pay often characterize jobs in the service industry.
characterize.z: 长时间工作和低薪往往是服务业工作的特点。

charcoal.s: We grilled the meat over hot charcoal until it was golden brown.
charcoal.z: 我们用炽热的木炭烤肉，直到它变成金黄色。

charge.s: The hotel will charge you an extra fee if you check out late.
charge.z: 如果你延迟退房，酒店会向你收取额外费用。

charity.s: She spends every weekend helping at a local charity that supports homeless families.
charity.z: 她每个周末都在一家帮助无家可归家庭的当地慈善机构帮忙。

charming.s: The old town is charming, with narrow streets and small cafés on every corner.
charming.z: 这座老城很迷人，狭窄的街道上每个角落都有小咖啡馆。

charter.s: The city council signed a charter to protect the local environment.
charter.z: 市议会签署了一份保护当地环境的宪章。

chatter.s: The constant chatter of the students made it hard for me to focus on my reading.
chatter.z: 学生们不停的叽叽喳喳声让我很难专心阅读。

cheat.s: Students who cheat on exams may face serious punishment from the university.
cheat.z: 考试作弊的学生可能会受到大学的严厉处罚。

cheerful.s: She stayed cheerful even after hearing the bad news about the project.
cheerful.z: 即使听到关于这个项目的坏消息，她依然保持愉快。

cheese.s: She added some cheese to the salad and mixed it well.
cheese.z: 她在沙拉里加了一些奶酪并充分搅拌。

chemical.s: The factory must reduce the amount of chemical waste it releases into the river.
chemical.z: 这家工厂必须减少排放到河里的化学废物量。

chemist.s: The chemist carefully mixed two chemicals in the laboratory before the experiment.
chemist.z: 化学家在实验前仔细地在实验室里混合了两种化学物质。

chemistry.s: She studied chemistry in college and now works in a laboratory.
chemistry.z: 她在大学学习化学，现在在一家实验室工作。

cheque.z: 她开了一张付房租的支票，递给了房东。

cherish.s: I cherish the quiet mornings I spend reading before the rest of the family wakes up.
cherish.z: 我珍惜在家人醒来之前安静读书的早晨。

cherry.s: She put a fresh cherry on top of the chocolate cake.
cherry.z: 她在巧克力蛋糕上面放了一颗新鲜的樱桃。

chestnut.s: She roasted some chestnuts over the fire and shared them with her friends.
chestnut.z: 她在火上烤了一些栗子，并与朋友们分享。

chew.s: The little boy chewed his food slowly while watching cartoons after school.
chew.z: 放学后，那个小男孩一边看动画片一边慢慢地咀嚼食物。

chief.z: 他失败的主要原因是缺乏周密的计划。

childhood.s: She spent most of her childhood playing in the countryside with her cousins.
childhood.z: 她童年的大部分时间都和表兄妹们在乡下玩耍。

childish.z: 当所有人都知道真相时，拒绝承认自己的错误是幼稚的。

chinese.z: 她学中文已经三年了，现在能读简单的小说。

chop.z: 她迅速把蔬菜切碎，然后把它们加入沸腾的汤里。

christian.z: 作为一名虔诚的基督徒，她每个周日早上都和家人一起去教堂。

christmas.s: The whole family gathered around the tree to open presents on Christmas morning.
christmas.z: 圣诞节早晨，全家人围在圣诞树旁打开礼物。

chronic.z: 她患慢性背痛已经十多年了。

chronically.s: She has been chronically short of sleep since the baby was born.
chronically.z: 自从孩子出生以来，她一直长期睡眠不足。

chunk.z: 她把蛋糕切成小块，这样每个人都能分到一块。

church.s: The old church at the end of our street is always full on Sunday mornings.
church.z: 我们街道尽头的那座老教堂在周日早晨总是坐满了人。

cigaret.z: 课间短暂休息时，他走到外面抽了一支烟。

cigarette.s: He stepped outside to smoke a cigarette after the long meeting.
cigarette.z: 漫长的会议结束后，他走到外面抽了一支烟。

circle.s: The children sat in a circle on the floor and shared their stories.
circle.z: 孩子们围坐在地板上围成一圈，分享着他们的故事。

crime.z: 警方正在努力减少市中心的犯罪。

criminal.s: The police finally arrested the criminal who had robbed three banks last year.
criminal.z: 警方最终逮捕了去年抢劫三家银行的罪犯。

criminology.s: She decided to study criminology because she wanted to understand why people commit crimes.
criminology.z: 她决定学习犯罪学，因为她想了解人们犯罪的原因。

crisis.s: The company faced a serious financial crisis and had to cut costs quickly.
crisis.z: 公司面临严重的财务危机，不得不迅速削减成本。

criteria.s: The committee listed several criteria for selecting the best candidate for the job.
criteria.z: 委员会列出了挑选该职位最佳候选人的几条标准。

criterion.s: The most important criterion for choosing a roommate is honesty.
criterion.z: 选择室友最重要的标准是诚实。

critic.s: The film critic praised the director's latest work for its bold storytelling.
critic.z: 这位影评人称赞导演的最新作品叙事大胆。

critical.s: It is critical that students develop strong time management skills before entering college.
critical.z: 学生在进入大学之前培养良好的时间管理技能是至关重要的。

criticism.s: The manager accepted the criticism calmly and promised to improve the team's working conditions.
criticism.z: 经理平静地接受了批评，并承诺改善团队的工作条件。

crooked.s: The old wooden fence was so crooked that it looked like it might fall down.
crooked.z: 那道旧木栅栏歪得厉害，看起来好像随时会倒塌。

cropland.s: The government is protecting cropland to ensure enough food for the growing population.
cropland.z: 政府正在保护耕地，以确保不断增长的人口有足够的粮食。

crossing.s: Look both ways before crossing the busy street near the school.
crossing.z: 过学校附近那条繁忙的马路之前，要向两边看。

crown.s: The queen wore a golden crown during the ceremony at the palace.
crown.z: 女王在宫殿的仪式上戴着一顶金冠。

crucial.s: Getting enough sleep before the exam is crucial for good performance.
crucial.z: 考试前获得充足的睡眠对取得好成绩至关重要。

cruelty.s: The cruelty of the punishment shocked everyone in the small village.
cruelty.z: 这种惩罚的残酷让村里的每个人都感到震惊。

crystallize.s: Years of hard work finally crystallized into a clear and practical plan.
crystallize.z: 多年的努力最终凝聚成一个清晰而切实可行的计划。

cubic.s: The new refrigerator takes up about two cubic meters of space in the kitchen.
cubic.z: 新冰箱在厨房里占了大约两立方米的空间。

cuckoo.s: Every spring, the cuckoo sings loudly in the forest behind our house.
cuckoo.z: 每年春天，杜鹃鸟都会在我们屋后的森林里大声鸣叫。

cucumber.s: She sliced a fresh cucumber and added it to the salad for lunch.
cucumber.z: 她切了一根新鲜的黄瓜，把它加进午餐的沙拉里。

cue.s: The teacher's nod was a cue for the students to begin the discussion.
cue.z: 老师的点头是学生们开始讨论的信号。

cultivate.s: Reading widely helps students cultivate the habit of thinking independently.
cultivate.z: 广泛阅读有助于学生培养独立思考的习惯。

cunning.s: The cunning fox found a clever way to open the garbage bin.
cunning.z: 那只狡猾的狐狸找到了一个巧妙的方法打开垃圾桶。

curb.s: The government introduced new rules to curb air pollution in big cities.
curb.z: 政府出台了新规定，以抑制大城市的空气污染。

cure.s: Scientists are still searching for an effective cure for this rare disease.
cure.z: 科学家们仍在寻找治愈这种罕见疾病的有效方法。

curiosity.s: Her curiosity about how machines work led her to study engineering in college.
curiosity.z: 她对机器运作方式的好奇心促使她在大学学习工程学。

curious.s: The curious student stayed after class to ask the teacher more questions about the experiment.
curious.z: 这个好奇的学生下课后留下来向老师询问更多关于这个实验的问题。

curly.s: She has curly hair and always wears a bright smile.
curly.z: 她有一头卷发，总是带着灿烂的笑容。

currency.s: The value of the local currency fell sharply against the dollar last month.
currency.z: 上个月，当地货币对美元的汇率大幅下跌。

current.s: The current economic situation has made it harder for young people to find jobs.
current.z: 当前的经济形势使年轻人更难找到工作。

currently.s: She is currently working on a research project about climate change.
currently.z: 她目前正在做一个关于气候变化的研究项目。

curriculum.s: The school has updated its curriculum to include more practical courses.
curriculum.z: 学校已更新课程设置，加入了更多实用课程。

curve.s: The road curves sharply to the left as it climbs the hill.
curve.z: 这条路在爬坡时向左急转弯。

customary.s: It is customary to remove your shoes before entering a traditional Japanese home.
customary.z: 进入传统的日本家庭前脱鞋是一种习俗。

cutter.s: She used a sharp cutter to open the heavy cardboard box.
cutter.z: 她用一把锋利的切割刀打开了那个沉重的纸箱。

cycle.s: Many students cycle to campus every morning to save money and stay healthy.
cycle.z: 许多学生每天早上骑自行车去校园，既省钱又保持健康。

dairy.s: She avoids dairy products because they make her feel sick.
dairy.z: 她避免食用乳制品，因为那会让她感到不适。

damage.s: The heavy rain caused serious damage to the crops in the fields.
damage.z: 大雨对田里的庄稼造成了严重损害。

dampen.s: The unexpected bad news did not dampen her enthusiasm for the project.
dampen.z: 这个意外的坏消息并没有削弱她对这个项目的热情。

dangerous.s: Driving too fast on wet roads is extremely dangerous for everyone.
dangerous.z: 在湿滑的道路上超速行驶对每个人来说都极其危险。

dare.s: She did not dare to tell her parents about the mistake she had made.
dare.z: 她不敢把自己犯的错误告诉父母。

daring.s: Her daring decision to study abroad surprised all her classmates.
daring.z: 她出国留学的勇敢决定让所有同学都感到惊讶。

database.s: The university keeps a large database of student records for easy access.
database.z: 大学维护着一个大型的学生记录数据库，以便于查阅。

datum.s: The researcher collected every datum carefully before analyzing the results.
datum.z: 研究人员在分析结果之前仔细收集了每一个数据。

deafen.s: The sudden explosion was loud enough to deafen anyone standing nearby.
deafen.z: 那次突然的爆炸声大得足以让附近站着的任何人震聋。

deal.s: She learned to deal with pressure calmly during her first year at college.
deal.z: 她在大学第一年学会了冷静地应对压力。

dealer.s: The dealer offered a fair price for the used car.
dealer.z: 经销商为这辆二手车给出了公道的价格。

dean.s: The dean announced that the university would open a new library next year.
dean.z: 院长宣布大学明年将开设一座新图书馆。

death.s: The sudden death of the old tree surprised everyone in the village.
death.z: 那棵老树的突然死亡让村里的每个人都感到惊讶。

debate.s: Students spent two hours in class debating whether online learning is more effective than traditional teaching.
debate.z: 学生们在课堂上花了两个小时辩论在线学习是否比传统教学更有效。

debt.s: After graduating, she worked two jobs to pay off her student debt.
debt.z: 毕业后，她打两份工来偿还学生贷款债务。

decade.s: She spent nearly a decade working on her research before publishing the results.
decade.z: 她花了近十年时间进行研究，然后才发表成果。

decay.s: Without proper care, the old wooden bridge will continue to decay over time.
decay.z: 如果没有适当的维护，这座旧木桥会随着时间继续腐朽。

deceit.s: His deceit became obvious when the truth about the missing money finally came out.
deceit.z: 当失踪的钱的真相最终浮出水面时，他的欺骗行为变得显而易见。

decency.s: He treated everyone with decency, even those who disagreed with him.
decency.z: 他体面地对待每个人，甚至是那些与他意见相左的人。

decent.s: He earns a decent salary and can afford a comfortable apartment downtown.
decent.z: 他挣着一份不错的薪水，能在市中心租得起一套舒适的公寓。

deception.s: His calm smile was just a clever deception to hide his real intentions.
deception.z: 他平静的微笑只是一种巧妙的欺骗，用来掩盖他的真实意图。

decidedly.s: The committee's response to the proposal was decidedly negative from the start.
decidedly.z: 委员会对该提案的回应从一开始就明显是否定的。

decision.s: She made the difficult decision to leave her job and study abroad.
decision.z: 她做出了艰难的决定，辞去工作出国留学。

decisive.s: Her decisive action during the emergency saved everyone in the building.
decisive.z: 她在紧急情况下的果断行动救了楼里的每一个人。

declaration.s: The two countries signed a joint declaration to protect the ocean environment.
declaration.z: 两国签署了一份联合声明，以保护海洋环境。

declare.s: The government declared a state of emergency after the severe storm hit the coast.
declare.z: 严重的风暴袭击海岸后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。

decline.s: The number of students who read printed newspapers has declined sharply in recent years.
decline.z: 近年来，阅读纸质报纸的学生人数急剧下降。

decode.s: It took the scientists several hours to decode the secret message hidden in the letter.
decode.z: 科学家们花了几个小时才破解出信件中隐藏的秘密信息。

decompose.s: Bacteria help decompose dead leaves and other organic matter in the soil.
decompose.z: 细菌帮助分解土壤中的枯叶和其他有机物。

decorate.s: She spent the whole weekend trying to decorate her new apartment before the guests arrived.
decorate.z: 她花了整个周末设法在客人到来之前装饰她的新公寓。

decorative.s: She bought a decorative vase to brighten up her living room.
decorative.z: 她买了一个装饰花瓶来让客厅更明亮。

decrease.s: The number of students walking to school has decreased steadily over the past few years.
decrease.z: 在过去几年里，步行上学的学生人数持续下降。

dedicate.s: She decided to dedicate her weekends to helping students improve their writing skills.
dedicate.z: 她决定把周末的时间用来帮助学生提高写作能力。

deduce.s: From the evidence, the detective could deduce that the thief had entered through the window.
deduce.z: 根据证据，侦探推断出小偷是从窗户进来的。

deduction.s: The tax deduction lowered his monthly expenses by a surprising amount.
deduction.z: 这项税收扣除让他的每月开支意外减少了不少。

deed.s: She is remembered for her kind deeds rather than her famous words.
deed.z: 人们记住的是她的善行，而不是她著名的言辞。

deem.s: Many students deem regular exercise essential for maintaining good health.
deem.z: 许多学生认为定期锻炼对保持健康至关重要。

deepen.s: Reading widely can deepen your understanding of different cultures and traditions.
deepen.z: 广泛阅读能够加深你对不同文化和传统的理解。

default.s: When the team failed to agree, they used the default plan already on the table.
default.z: 当团队未能达成一致时，他们采用了桌上已有的默认方案。

defeat.s: Our team refused to accept defeat and kept working hard until the project succeeded.
defeat.z: 我们团队拒绝接受失败，一直努力工作，直到项目成功。

defence.s: The new law provides stronger defence for workers who report unsafe conditions.
defence.z: 新法律为举报不安全状况的工人提供了更有力的保护。

defendant.s: The defendant refused to answer any questions during the trial.
defendant.z: 被告在审判期间拒绝回答任何问题。

defensive.s: He became defensive when his teacher questioned the quality of his work.
defensive.z: 当老师质疑他的工作质量时，他变得爱辩解起来。

deferential.s: The young intern spoke in a deferential tone when addressing the senior manager.
deferential.z: 这位年轻实习生在称呼资深经理时用了一种恭敬的语气。

defiance.s: The students showed open defiance of the new dress code by wearing casual clothes.
defiance.z: 学生们穿着休闲服装，公开违抗新的着装规定。

deficiency.s: A deficiency of vitamin C can lead to serious health problems.
deficiency.z: 缺乏维生素C会导致严重的健康问题。

define.s: The teacher asked us to define the word clearly in our own sentences.
define.z: 老师要求我们用自己造的句子清楚地给这个词下定义。

definitely.s: She will definitely pass the exam if she keeps practicing every day.
definitely.z: 如果她坚持每天练习，她肯定会通过考试。

definition.s: The teacher gave a clear definition of the new term before the discussion.
definition.z: 老师在讨论前对这个新术语给出了清晰的定义。

definitive.s: The committee needs a definitive answer before the project can move forward.
definitive.z: 委员会需要在一个项目推进之前得到一个明确的答复。

deflect.s: She used humor to deflect attention from her embarrassing mistake during the meeting.
deflect.z: 她用幽默转移了大家对她在会议上尴尬错误的注意。

deflection.s: The engineer noticed a slight deflection of the beam under the heavy load.
deflection.z: 工程师注意到横梁在重载下发生了轻微的偏转。

deforestation.s: Deforestation has destroyed the natural homes of countless animals and plants.
deforestation.z: 森林砍伐摧毁了无数动植物的自然家园。

deform.s: The intense heat caused the plastic bottle to deform and lose its original shape.
deform.z: 高温使塑料瓶变形，失去了原来的形状。

deformation.s: The metal bar showed slight deformation after being exposed to intense heat.
deformation.z: 金属棒在暴露于高温后出现了轻微的变形。

defy.s: The young athlete chose to defy his coach's advice and changed his training plan.
defy.z: 这名年轻运动员选择违抗教练的建议，改变了自己的训练计划。

degeneration.s: Years of poor diet and lack of exercise can lead to the degeneration of muscles.
degeneration.z: 多年的不良饮食和缺乏锻炼会导致肌肉退化。

degradation.s: The degradation of air quality in cities has raised serious public health concerns.
degradation.z: 城市空气质量的恶化引发了严重的公共卫生担忧。

degree.s: She earned a master's degree in economics before starting her career in banking.
degree.z: 她在开始从事银行业工作之前获得了经济学硕士学位。

delay.s: Heavy traffic caused a long delay on our way to the airport.
delay.z: 交通拥堵使我们在去机场的路上耽搁了很久。

delegation.s: The manager sent a small delegation to attend the international conference on climate change.
delegation.z: 经理派出一个小型代表团参加关于气候变化的国际会议。

delete.s: Please delete all the old files from your computer before you install the new software.
delete.z: 安装新软件之前，请删除电脑上所有旧文件。

deliberate.s: She spoke in a slow, deliberate way so everyone could follow her argument.
deliberate.z: 她说话缓慢而从容，以便每个人都能跟上她的论证。

deliberately.s: She deliberately left the meeting early to avoid answering difficult questions.
deliberately.z: 她故意提前离开会议，以避免回答棘手的问题。

delicate.s: The delicate balance between work and family life is often difficult to maintain.
delicate.z: 工作与家庭生活之间的微妙平衡往往难以维持。

delight.s: The children squealed with delight when they saw the snow falling outside.
delight.z: 孩子们看到外面下雪时高兴得尖叫起来。

delightful.s: We spent a delightful afternoon walking along the river and talking about old times.
delightful.z: 我们度过了一个愉快的下午，沿着河边散步，聊着过去的时光。

deliver.s: The company promised to deliver the goods to our office before noon.
deliver.z: 公司承诺在中午之前把货物送到我们的办公室。

delivery.s: The restaurant offers free delivery for orders over twenty dollars.
delivery.z: 这家餐厅对超过二十美元的订单提供免费配送。

delusion.s: He still lives under the delusion that success will come without hard work.
delusion.z: 他仍然抱有幻想，认为不努力就能获得成功。

demand.s: The growing demand for skilled workers has changed how universities design their courses.
demand.z: 对熟练工人日益增长的需求改变了大学设计课程的方式。

democracy.s: In a true democracy, citizens have the right to vote and express their opinions freely.
democracy.z: 在真正的民主国家，公民有权投票并自由表达意见。

democratic.s: The small country held its first democratic election after decades of strict military rule.
democratic.z: 这个国家在数十年严格的军事统治之后举行了首次民主选举。

demonstrate.s: The teacher demonstrated how to solve the difficult problem step by step.
demonstrate.z: 老师一步一步地演示了如何解决这道难题。

demonstration.s: The teacher gave a simple demonstration of the experiment before the students tried it.
demonstration.z: 老师在学生尝试之前对这个实验做了简单的演示。

denationalize.s: The government decided to denationalize several state-owned enterprises to improve efficiency.
denationalize.z: 政府决定将几家国有企业私有化以提高效率。

denial.s: His denial of the mistake only made the situation worse for everyone involved.
denial.z: 他否认错误只会让所有相关人员的处境变得更糟。

denote.s: On this map, red circles denote areas at high risk of flooding.
denote.z: 在这张地图上，红色圆圈表示洪水高风险区域。

dense.s: The morning fog was so dense that drivers could hardly see the road ahead.
dense.z: 早晨的雾太浓了，司机们几乎看不清前方的路。

density.s: The high density of buildings in the city center makes traffic very congested.
density.z: 市中心建筑密度很高，导致交通非常拥堵。

dental.s: She visits the dental clinic twice a year to keep her teeth healthy.
dental.z: 她每年去牙科诊所两次，以保持牙齿健康。

dentist.s: I was so nervous before my appointment that the dentist had to calm me down.
dentist.z: 预约之前我紧张得不得了，牙医不得不安慰我。

deny.s: She could not deny that the results of the experiment surprised her.
deny.z: 她无法否认，实验的结果让她感到惊讶。

depart.s: The train will depart from the station at eight tomorrow morning.
depart.z: 火车明天早上八点将从车站出发。

department.s: She works in the sales department and often travels abroad for business.
department.z: 她在销售部工作，经常出差到国外谈生意。

departure.s: Her sudden departure from the meeting surprised all of her colleagues.
departure.z: 她突然离开会议让所有同事都感到惊讶。

dependant.s: As a dependant, she could not sign the rental agreement without her parents.
dependant.z: 作为受抚养人，没有父母她无法签署租房协议。

dependent.s: Many elderly people become financially dependent on their children after they retire.
dependent.z: 许多老年人在退休后在经济上变得依赖子女。

deposition.s: The lawyer took a sworn deposition from the witness before the trial began.
deposition.z: 律师在审判开始前对证人进行了宣誓证词采集。

depress.s: The rainy weather and endless bad news began to depress everyone in the office.
depress.z: 阴雨天气和接连不断的坏消息开始让办公室里的每个人感到沮丧。

depressed.s: She felt deeply depressed after failing the important exam last week.
depressed.z: 上周重要考试失利后，她感到非常沮丧。

depressing.s: The constant rain and gray skies made the whole week feel depressing.
depressing.z: 连绵的阴雨和灰暗的天空让整整一周都令人感到压抑。

depression.s: Regular exercise can help reduce stress and prevent depression in college students.
depression.z: 定期锻炼有助于减轻压力，预防大学生患上抑郁症。

deprivation.s: Long-term sleep deprivation can seriously affect a student's memory and learning ability.
deprivation.z: 长期睡眠不足会严重影响学生的记忆力和学习能力。

deprive.s: The new policy may deprive many students of the chance to study abroad.
deprive.z: 这项新政策可能会剥夺许多学生出国留学的机会。

deputy.s: The manager sent his deputy to attend the important meeting in his place.
deputy.z: 经理派他的副手代替他参加那个重要的会议。

derivation.s: The derivation of this formula took the professor nearly an hour to explain.
derivation.z: 教授花了将近一个小时来解释这个公式的推导过程。

derive.s: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek roots.
derive.z: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语词根。

descendant.s: Many people believe they are descendants of ancient farmers who settled in this valley.
descendant.z: 许多人认为他们是定居在这个山谷的古代农民的后代。

descent.s: The hikers began their slow descent down the mountain before sunset.
descent.z: 徒步者在日落前开始缓慢下山。

description.s: The police asked the witness for a detailed description of the suspect's appearance.
description.z: 警方要求目击者详细描述嫌疑人的外貌。

descriptive.s: Her essay gives a vivid and descriptive account of life in the countryside.
descriptive.z: 她的文章生动而细致地描述了乡村生活。

deserve.s: After months of hard work, she finally got the promotion she truly deserved.
deserve.z: 经过几个月的努力工作，她终于得到了她真正应得的晋升。

design.s: She spent months designing a simple device that helps elderly people open jars easily.
design.z: 她花了几个月时间设计一种简单的装置，帮助老年人轻松打开罐子。

designate.s: The school designated a quiet room for students to study before exams.
designate.z: 学校指定了一间安静的房间供学生在考试前学习。

desirable.s: A quiet neighborhood with good public transport is highly desirable for young families.
desirable.z: 一个安静且公共交通便利的社区对年轻家庭来说非常理想。

desire.s: She had a strong desire to improve her English before the exam.
desire.z: 她非常渴望在考试前提高自己的英语水平。

desperate.s: She was desperate for a quiet place to study before the final exam.
desperate.z: 期末考试前，她迫切需要一个安静的地方学习。

destine.s: She always believed she was destined to become a writer one day.
destine.z: 她一直相信自己注定有一天会成为作家。

destined.s: She always believed she was destined to become a great writer one day.
destined.z: 她一直相信自己注定有一天会成为一位伟大的作家。

destroy.s: The fire destroyed most of the old library and several nearby houses.
destroy.z: 大火烧毁了这座旧图书馆的大部分以及附近的几座房屋。

destruction.s: The powerful earthquake caused widespread destruction across the small coastal town.
destruction.z: 这场强烈的地震给整个沿海小镇造成了广泛的破坏。

destructive.s: The storm was so destructive that many families lost their homes overnight.
destructive.z: 这场风暴破坏性极强，许多家庭一夜之间失去了家园。

detached.s: She felt strangely detached from the celebrations around her and quietly left the party.
detached.z: 她感到与周围的庆祝活动莫名地疏离，于是悄悄离开了聚会。

detail.s: She described every detail of the accident clearly to the police.
detail.z: 她向警方清楚地描述了这起事故的每一个细节。

detailed.s: The professor gave a detailed explanation of how the experiment should be carried out.
detailed.z: 教授详细解释了这项实验应该如何进行。

detect.s: Doctors can detect early signs of the disease through a simple blood test.
detect.z: 医生可以通过简单的血液检查发现这种疾病的早期迹象。

detection.s: Early detection of the disease greatly increases the patient's chances of a full recovery.
detection.z: 疾病的早期发现大大提高了患者完全康复的机会。

detective.s: The detective carefully examined the room for any clues.
detective.z: 侦探仔细检查了房间，寻找任何线索。

detector.s: The smoke detector on the ceiling began to beep loudly in the middle of the night.
detector.z: 天花板上的烟雾探测器在半夜开始大声发出哔哔声。

deterioration.s: The doctor warned that the deterioration of his health was caused by lack of sleep.
deterioration.z: 医生警告说，他健康的恶化是由缺乏睡眠引起的。

determination.s: Her determination to finish the project on time impressed everyone in the team.
determination.z: 她按时完成项目的决心给团队里的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

determine.s: Researchers use several methods to determine the age of ancient rocks.
determine.z: 研究人员使用几种方法来确定古老岩石的年龄。

develop.s: The company plans to develop a new software application for language learners.
develop.z: 这家公司计划为语言学习者开发一款新的软件应用。

development.s: The rapid development of technology has changed the way we live and work.
development.z: 科技的迅速发展改变了我们生活和工作的方式。

developmental.s: Regular exercise is important for a child's developmental progress.
developmental.z: 定期锻炼对儿童的发育进步很重要。

deviation.s: Any deviation from the safety rules must be reported to the manager immediately.
deviation.z: 任何对安全规定的偏离都必须立即向经理报告。

device.s: She uses a small device to track her daily steps and heart rate.
device.z: 她用一个小设备来记录每天的步数和心率。

devil.s: She joked that her little brother was a little devil who never sat still.
devil.z: 她开玩笑说她的弟弟是个永远坐不住的小恶魔。

devise.s: The team devised a simple plan to cut costs without reducing quality.
devise.z: 团队设计了一个简单的方案，在不降低质量的情况下削减成本。

devote.s: She decided to devote most of her free time to studying English before the exam.
devote.z: 她决定在考试前把大部分空闲时间用来学习英语。

devotion.s: Her devotion to teaching has earned her the respect of students and colleagues.
devotion.z: 她对教学的热忱赢得了学生和同事的尊敬。

dialect.s: Older people in that village still speak a dialect that young people cannot understand.
dialect.z: 那个村子里的老人仍然讲一种年轻人听不懂的方言。

dictate.s: The company's strict rules dictate how employees should dress and behave at work.
dictate.z: 公司严格的规定决定了员工在工作中的着装和行为方式。

dictation.s: The teacher gave us a short dictation to test our spelling skills.
dictation.z: 老师给我们做了一段简短的听写，来测试我们的拼写能力。

dictator.s: The country suffered for decades under a cruel dictator who ignored the people's needs.
dictator.z: 这个国家在一个无视人民需求的残酷独裁者统治下遭受了数十年的苦难。

diet.s: She has kept a healthy diet by eating more vegetables and less junk food.
diet.z: 她通过多吃蔬菜少吃垃圾食品来保持健康的饮食。

difference.s: There is a big difference between knowing a word and actually using it.
difference.z: 认识一个单词和真正使用它之间有很大的差别。

different.s: Students from different backgrounds often learn in different ways and at different speeds.
different.z: 来自不同背景的学生往往以不同的方式、不同的速度学习。

differentiate.s: Teachers should differentiate between students who need help and those who simply lack confidence.
differentiate.z: 老师应该区分需要帮助的学生和那些仅仅缺乏自信的学生。

differentiation.s: Clear differentiation between the two products helps customers choose the right one.
differentiation.z: 两种产品之间的清晰区分有助于顾客选择合适的那一款。

difficulty.s: Many students find it difficult to balance study and part-time work.
difficulty.z: 许多学生发现很难平衡学习和兼职工作。

diffuse.s: The pleasant smell of fresh coffee slowly diffused through the entire office.
diffuse.z: 新鲜咖啡的宜人香气慢慢弥漫了整个办公室。

digital.s: Many students now prefer digital textbooks because they are cheaper and easier to carry.
digital.z: 现在许多学生更喜欢电子教材，因为它们更便宜，也更便于携带。

dignity.s: Every patient should be treated with dignity and respect, regardless of their background.
dignity.z: 每位患者都应受到尊重和尊严对待，无论其背景如何。

dilemma.s: She faced a difficult dilemma about whether to accept the job offer or stay near her family.
dilemma.z: 她面临一个艰难的困境：是接受这份工作邀请，还是留在家人身边。

diligence.s: Her diligence in reviewing notes every evening helped her pass the exam easily.
diligence.z: 她每天晚上复习笔记的勤奋帮助她轻松通过了考试。

diligent.s: She is a diligent student who reviews her notes every evening after class.
diligent.z: 她是一个勤奋的学生，每天课后晚上都会复习笔记。

diminish.s: The noise from the street gradually diminished as the night went on.
diminish.z: 随着夜色渐深，街上的噪音逐渐减弱了。

dioxide.s: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen during the day.
dioxide.z: 植物在白天从空气中吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。

dip.s: She dipped her brush into the paint and began to color the wall.
dip.z: 她把刷子蘸进油漆里，开始给墙壁上色。

diplomatic.s: She gave a diplomatic answer that avoided offending either side.
diplomatic.z: 她给出了一个圆滑的回答，避免了冒犯任何一方。

direct.s: The teacher directed the students to hand in their essays before Friday.
direct.z: 老师指示学生在周五之前交上他们的论文。

direction.s: She asked a stranger for directions to the nearest train station.
direction.z: 她向一位陌生人询问去最近火车站的方向。

directly.s: The new policy directly affects how much money students spend on their meals.
directly.z: 这项新政策直接影响学生在饮食上花费的金额。

director.s: The director asked us to finish the report before Friday.
director.z: 主任要求我们在周五之前完成这份报告。

dirty.s: He put on his dirty clothes and went outside to wash the car.
dirty.z: 他穿上脏衣服，到外面去洗车。

disadvantage.s: One major disadvantage of living far from campus is the long daily commute.
disadvantage.z: 住在离校园很远的地方的一大缺点是每天通勤时间很长。

disagreement.s: There was a serious disagreement between the two departments about the new budget.
disagreement.z: 两个部门之间就新预算存在严重的分歧。

disappear.s: My keys seem to disappear whenever I am already running late.
disappear.z: 每当我快要迟到的时候，我的钥匙似乎就不见了。

disappearance.s: The sudden disappearance of the old bookstore surprised everyone in the neighborhood.
disappearance.z: 那家旧书店的突然消失让社区里的每个人都感到惊讶。

disappoint.s: I was disappointed to learn that the concert had been canceled.
disappoint.z: 得知音乐会被取消，我很失望。

disappointing.s: The exam results were disappointing, so she decided to study harder next term.
disappointing.z: 考试成绩令人失望，所以她决定下学期更加努力学习。

disapproval.s: Her parents expressed strong disapproval when she decided to drop out of college.
disapproval.z: 当她决定从大学退学时，她的父母表达了强烈的反对。

disaster.s: The heavy rain caused a serious disaster that destroyed many homes in the village.
disaster.z: 大雨造成了一场严重的灾难，摧毁了村里的许多房屋。

disastrous.s: The heavy rain had a disastrous effect on the small town's crops.
disastrous.z: 这场大雨对小镇的农作物造成了灾难性的影响。

discard.s: Many people discard old clothes without thinking about the environmental cost.
discard.z: 许多人丢弃旧衣服时并不考虑环境代价。

discern.s: It is difficult to discern the truth when rumors spread so quickly online.
discern.z: 当谣言在网上传播得如此之快时，很难辨别真相。

discipline.s: Learning a new language requires patience and strict discipline every single day.
discipline.z: 学习一门新语言需要每天保持耐心和严格的自律。

disclose.s: The company refused to disclose how much money it spent on the project.
disclose.z: 公司拒绝透露它在这个项目上花了多少钱。

disconnect.s: She decided to disconnect from social media for a week to focus on her studies.
disconnect.z: 她决定一周内断开与社交媒体的联系，以便专心学习。

discourse.s: The professor encouraged students to join the discourse on climate change during class.
discourse.z: 教授鼓励学生在课堂上参与有关气候变化的讨论。

discovery.s: The scientist made an important discovery while studying the behavior of wild birds.
discovery.z: 这位科学家在研究野生鸟类的行为时做出了一项重要发现。

discrete.s: The teacher divided the class into several discrete groups for the project.
discrete.z: 老师把班级分成几个各自独立的小组来完成这个项目。

discriminate.s: It is illegal for employers to discriminate against workers because of their age.
discriminate.z: 雇主因年龄而歧视员工是违法的。

discrimination.s: The new law aims to end discrimination against older workers in the job market.
discrimination.z: 这项新法律旨在消除就业市场中对年长员工的歧视。

discussion.s: The students had a long discussion about the new library rules.
discussion.z: 学生们就新的图书馆规定进行了长时间的讨论。

disease.s: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease and improve your overall health.
disease.z: 规律运动可以降低患心脏病的风险，并改善你的整体健康状况。

disengagement.s: The teacher noticed the student's disengagement from class discussions and tried to help.
disengagement.z: 老师注意到这名学生对课堂讨论的疏离，并试图提供帮助。

disgrace.s: He felt deep disgrace after cheating on the final exam.
disgrace.z: 期末考试作弊后，他深感耻辱。

disguise.s: He tried to disguise his nervousness with a confident smile.
disguise.z: 他试图用自信的微笑来掩饰自己的紧张。

dishonest.s: The manager was fired because he had been dishonest about the company's profits.
dishonest.z: 经理被解雇了，因为他在公司利润问题上不诚实。

dishonour.s: He would rather lose the game than dishonour his team by cheating.
dishonour.z: 他宁愿输掉比赛，也不愿作弊而使他的团队蒙羞。

dishwasher.s: After dinner, he loaded the dirty plates into the dishwasher and started it.
dishwasher.z: 晚饭后，他把脏盘子放进洗碗机并启动了它。

disillusion.s: The disappointing internship left him disillusioned with the company and its promises.
disillusion.z: 那次令人失望的实习使他对这家公司及其承诺不再抱有幻想。

disintegration.s: The gradual disintegration of the old bridge forced the town to build a new one.
disintegration.z: 旧桥的逐渐崩塌迫使小镇修建一座新桥。

dislike.s: Many students dislike waking up early for classes on cold winter mornings.
dislike.z: 许多学生不喜欢在寒冷的冬日早晨早起上课。

dismiss.s: The manager dismissed the suggestion without giving it any serious thought.
dismiss.z: 经理没有认真考虑就否定了这个建议。

disorder.s: The doctor said that stress can cause serious sleep disorders in young adults.
disorder.z: 医生说压力可能导致年轻人出现严重的睡眠障碍。

disorderly.s: The crowd became disorderly when the concert was suddenly cancelled.
disorderly.z: 演唱会突然取消时，人群变得秩序混乱。

dispensable.s: In today's job market, no employee should feel dispensable, no matter how small their role seems.
dispensable.z: 在如今的就业市场中，无论员工的角色看起来多么微不足道，都不应觉得自己是可有可无的。

displacement.s: The war caused the displacement of thousands of families from their homes.
displacement.z: 战争导致成千上万个家庭流离失所。

display.s: The new museum will display ancient pottery from the region.
display.z: 新博物馆将展出该地区的古代陶器。

displease.s: The unexpected delay in the project began to displease both the manager and the clients.
displease.z: 项目中意外的延误开始让经理和客户都感到不满。

disposable.s: Many young people prefer disposable cups because they are cheap and convenient.
disposable.z: 许多年轻人喜欢一次性杯子，因为它们便宜又方便。

disposal.s: The safe disposal of household waste is a serious problem in many cities.
disposal.z: 家庭垃圾的安全处理在许多城市是一个严重的问题。

disproportionately.s: The new tax policy places a disproportionately heavy burden on low-income families.
disproportionately.z: 新税收政策给低收入家庭带来了不成比例的沉重负担。

dispute.s: The two neighbors had a serious dispute over the boundary of their gardens.
dispute.z: 这两位邻居因花园边界问题发生了严重的争执。

dissatisfaction.s: Many students expressed dissatisfaction with the new cafeteria menu.
dissatisfaction.z: 许多学生对新的食堂菜单表示不满。

dissatisfy.s: The final results of the experiment dissatisfied the entire research team.
dissatisfy.z: 实验的最终结果让整个研究团队感到不满。

disservice.s: Ignoring the warning labels on the machine would do a great disservice to your own safety.
disservice.z: 忽视机器上的警告标签将对你自己的人身安全造成极大伤害。

dissipate.s: The morning fog began to dissipate as the sun rose over the quiet town.
dissipate.z: 随着太阳在安静的小镇上空升起，晨雾开始消散。

distant.s: Although he lives in a distant city, we still talk on the phone every week.
distant.z: 虽然他住在一座遥远的城市，我们仍然每周通电话。

distinction.s: Students should learn to make a clear distinction between facts and opinions.
distinction.z: 学生应该学会清楚地区分事实和观点。

distinctive.s: The old building has a distinctive style that makes it easy to recognize.
distinctive.z: 这座老建筑有着独特的风格，很容易辨认。

distinctly.s: She spoke so distinctly that everyone in the back row heard every word clearly.
distinctly.z: 她说话如此清晰，后排的每个人都清楚地听到了每一个字。

distinguish.s: It is often hard to distinguish between the twins because they look so similar.
distinguish.z: 人们常常很难分辨这对双胞胎，因为他们长得太像了。

distinguished.s: She is a distinguished professor who has devoted her life to cancer research.
distinguished.z: 她是一位杰出的教授，毕生致力于癌症研究。

distort.s: Newspapers sometimes distort the facts to attract more readers.
distort.z: 报纸有时会歪曲事实以吸引更多读者。

distortion.s: Excessive social media use can cause a serious distortion of how young people view reality.
distortion.z: 过度使用社交媒体会严重扭曲年轻人对现实的看法。

distract.s: Loud music can distract students and make it hard to focus on their homework.
distract.z: 吵闹的音乐会让学生分心，使他们难以专心做作业。

distracted.s: She felt distracted during the lecture because her phone kept buzzing.
distracted.z: 上课时她总是分心，因为她的手机不停地响。

distraction.s: Studying in a noisy café is difficult because every conversation becomes a distraction.
distraction.z: 在嘈杂的咖啡馆里学习很困难，因为每一次交谈都会让人分心。

distribution.s: The uneven distribution of wealth remains a serious problem in many developing countries.
distribution.z: 财富分配不均仍然是许多发展中国家面临的严重问题。

district.s: She works in a busy commercial district near the city center.
district.z: 她在市中心附近一个繁忙的商业区工作。

disturb.s: Please do not disturb your classmates while they are studying in the library.
disturb.z: 当你的同学在图书馆学习时，请不要打扰他们。

disturbance.s: The loud disturbance outside the library made it hard for students to concentrate.
disturbance.z: 图书馆外巨大的干扰声让学生们很难集中注意力。

ditch.s: The driver had to ditch the car and swim to the shore.
ditch.z: 司机不得不弃车游向岸边。

diverge.s: The two researchers' opinions began to diverge sharply after they reviewed the new data.
diverge.z: 两位研究人员在审阅新数据后，意见开始出现明显分歧。

diverse.s: Our university offers diverse courses that help students develop a wide range of skills.
diverse.z: 我们大学提供多样化的课程，帮助学生培养广泛的技能。

diversion.s: The new park offers a welcome diversion for families living in the crowded city.
diversion.z: 这座新公园为住在拥挤城市里的家庭提供了一个令人愉快的消遣场所。

diversity.s: The diversity of cultures in this city makes it a fascinating place to live.
diversity.z: 这座城市文化的多样性使它成为一个迷人的居住地。

division.s: The division of labor among team members made the project much more efficient.
division.z: 团队成员之间的分工使这个项目效率大大提高。

divorce.s: She decided to divorce her husband after ten years of unhappiness.
divorce.z: 在十年不幸福的婚姻之后，她决定与丈夫离婚。

doctoral.s: She is writing her doctoral thesis on the effects of climate change.
doctoral.z: 她正在撰写关于气候变化影响的博士论文。

doctrine.s: The new doctrine changed how teachers approach reading in class.
doctrine.z: 这一新理念改变了教师在课堂上处理阅读教学的方式。

document.s: Please keep all the important documents in a safe place.
document.z: 请把所有重要文件放在安全的地方。

documentary.s: We watched a documentary about climate change in our geography class yesterday.
documentary.z: 我们昨天在地理课上观看了一部关于气候变化的纪录片。

domain.s: Researchers in this domain are working to develop cleaner sources of energy.
domain.z: 这一领域的研究人员正致力于开发更清洁的能源。

domestic.s: Many families argue that domestic chores should be shared equally among all members.
domestic.z: 许多家庭认为家务应该由所有成员平均分担。

dominant.s: English is still the dominant language at international conferences and academic journals.
dominant.z: 英语仍然是国际会议和学术期刊上的主导语言。

dominate.s: A few large companies dominate the smartphone market and control most of the profits.
dominate.z: 少数几家大公司主导着智能手机市场，并掌控着大部分利润。

domination.s: The team's domination of the game was clear from the first ten minutes.
domination.z: 这支球队对比赛的统治从开场十分钟就显而易见。

donate.s: Many students donate their old books to the school library every year.
donate.z: 许多学生每年都把旧书捐给学校图书馆。

donation.s: She made a generous donation to help the children in the poor village.
donation.z: 她慷慨捐款，帮助那个贫困村庄的孩子们。

donor.s: The hospital thanked every blood donor who helped save lives during the emergency.
donor.z: 医院感谢每一位在紧急情况下帮助挽救生命的献血者。

doom.s: Poor planning and a lack of funding doomed the project from the very start.
doom.z: 糟糕的规划加上资金短缺，这个项目从一开始就注定失败。

dorm.s: My roommate and I often study together in our dorm until midnight.
dorm.z: 我和室友经常在宿舍一起学习到午夜。

dot.s: A small dot on the map marks the village where she was born.
dot.z: 地图上的一个小点标记着她出生的那个村庄。

doubtful.s: She was doubtful about the plan, so she asked several questions before agreeing.
doubtful.z: 她对这个计划持怀疑态度，所以在同意之前问了几个问题。
