fabric.z: 她选择了一种柔软的棉质面料为派对做一条连衣裙。

fabrication.s: The journalist was fired for publishing a complete fabrication about the mayor.
fabrication.z: 那名记者因发表关于市长的彻头彻尾的捏造报道而被解雇。

facet.s: The report examines every facet of the problem before suggesting a solution.
facet.z: 这份报告在提出解决方案之前审视了问题的每一个方面。

facilitate.s: The new online system will facilitate communication between students and teachers.
facilitate.z: 新的在线系统将促进学生与教师之间的沟通。

facility.s: The new sports facility offers students a great place to exercise and relax.
facility.z: 新的体育设施为学生提供了一个锻炼和放松的好地方。

factor.s: Cost is an important factor when students choose which university to attend.
factor.z: 当学生选择上哪所大学时，费用是一个重要因素。

fade.s: The memory of that difficult summer gradually faded as the years passed by.
fade.z: 随着岁月流逝，那个艰难夏天的记忆逐渐淡去了。

fahrenheit.s: The weather report said the temperature would drop to forty degrees Fahrenheit tonight.
fahrenheit.z: 天气预报说今晚气温将降到华氏四十度。

failure.s: His repeated failure to meet the deadline surprised everyone in the office.
failure.z: 他反复未能按时完成任务，这让办公室里的每个人都很惊讶。

faint.s: The smell of smoke was so faint that we hardly noticed it at first.
faint.z: 烟味太淡了，我们起初几乎没注意到。

fairly.s: The test was fairly difficult, but most students finished it on time.
fairly.z: 这次考试相当难，但大多数学生都按时完成了。

fairy.s: My little sister believes a fairy lives in the garden behind our house.
fairy.z: 我妹妹相信我们家屋后的花园里住着一位仙女。

faith.s: She never lost faith in her ability to pass the difficult exam.
faith.z: 她从未对自己通过这场艰难考试的能力失去信心。

faithful.s: She has remained faithful to her promise despite many difficulties.
faithful.z: 尽管困难重重，她仍然信守自己的承诺。

fake.s: She could tell the handbag was fake because the leather felt cheap and thin.
fake.z: 她能看出这个手提包是假的，因为皮革摸起来又廉价又薄。

false.s: Many people believe that false information spreads faster than the truth online.
false.z: 许多人认为虚假信息在网上传播得比真相更快。

falsehood.s: The witness was accused of telling a falsehood to protect his friend.
falsehood.z: 这名证人被指控为了保护朋友而撒谎。

familiar.s: The song sounds familiar, but I cannot remember where I first heard it.
familiar.z: 这首歌听起来很耳熟，但我想不起来第一次是在哪里听到的。

famous.s: The small restaurant near our campus is famous for its homemade noodles.
famous.z: 我们校园附近的那家小餐馆以其自制面条而闻名。

fancy.s: She wore a fancy dress to the party and everyone praised her taste.
fancy.z: 她穿了一条华丽的裙子去参加聚会，大家都称赞她的品味。

fantasize.s: Many teenagers fantasize about becoming famous singers or actors one day.
fantasize.z: 许多青少年幻想有一天能成为著名的歌手或演员。

fantastic.s: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely fantastic.
fantastic.z: 从山顶看到的景色简直太棒了。

fantasy.s: She often escapes into a fantasy world when her daily work feels too stressful.
fantasy.z: 当日常工作让她感到压力太大时，她常常逃入幻想世界。

fare.s: The bus fare has increased again this year, which upsets many daily commuters.
fare.z: 今年公交车费又涨了，这让许多日常通勤者感到不满。

farmer.s: The farmer works hard in the fields from early morning until sunset.
farmer.z: 这位农民从清晨到日落一直在田里辛勤劳作。

fascinating.s: The science museum's new exhibit about deep-sea creatures is truly fascinating.
fascinating.z: 科学博物馆关于深海生物的新展览确实非常吸引人。

fascination.s: His fascination with ancient history led him to read dozens of books about it.
fascination.z: 他对古代历史的着迷促使他读了大量相关书籍。

fashion.s: She always dresses in a stylish fashion that catches everyone's attention.
fashion.z: 她总是以时尚的方式穿着打扮，吸引每个人的注意。

fashionable.s: She always wears fashionable clothes to work because she cares about her appearance.
fashionable.z: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服，因为她很在意自己的外表。

fastener.s: She checked every fastener on the backpack before the long hike.
fastener.z: 长途徒步之前，她检查了背包上的每一个扣件。

fatal.s: A single careless mistake in the experiment proved fatal to the entire project.
fatal.z: 实验中的一个粗心错误对整个项目来说是致命的。

fate.s: She believes that hard work, not fate, decides how our lives turn out.
fate.z: 她认为决定我们人生走向的是努力，而不是命运。

faultless.s: Her faultless pronunciation impressed everyone at the English speech contest.
faultless.z: 她在英语演讲比赛中完美无瑕的发音给每个人留下了深刻印象。

faulty.s: The report was delayed because the faulty machine kept stopping during production.
faulty.z: 由于那台有故障的机器在生产过程中不断停机，报告被推迟了。

favor.s: Most students favor studying in the library because it is quiet and comfortable.
favor.z: 大多数学生更喜欢在图书馆学习，因为那里安静又舒适。

favorable.s: The new library schedule is favorable for students who study late in the evening.
favorable.z: 新的图书馆时间表对晚上学习到很晚的学生很有利。

favour.s: Most students favour studying in the library because it is quiet and comfortable.
favour.z: 大多数学生更喜欢在图书馆学习，因为那里安静又舒适。

favourable.s: The new library rules are favourable to students who study late at night.
favourable.z: 新的图书馆规定对深夜学习的学生有利。

favourite.s: My favourite subject in college is history because the stories are fascinating.
favourite.z: 我在大学里最喜欢的科目是历史，因为那些故事很吸引人。

fear.s: Many students fear making mistakes when they speak English in front of the class.
fear.z: 许多学生在全班面前说英语时害怕犯错。

fearful.s: Many students feel fearful before taking a difficult exam.
fearful.z: 许多学生在参加困难的考试前会感到害怕。

fearless.s: The fearless firefighter rushed into the burning building to save a trapped child.
fearless.z: 那位无畏的消防员冲进燃烧的建筑去救一名被困的孩子。

fearlessly.s: She fearlessly spoke up in class even when her answer might be wrong.
fearlessly.z: 即使她的答案可能是错的，她仍然无所畏惧地在课堂上发言。

feasibility.s: Before starting the project, the team spent two weeks studying its feasibility.
feasibility.z: 在开始这个项目之前，团队花了两周时间研究其可行性。

feasible.s: It is not feasible to finish the whole project within such a short time.
feasible.z: 在这么短的时间内完成整个项目是不可行的。

federal.s: The federal government announced new rules to protect clean drinking water.
federal.z: 联邦政府宣布了保护清洁饮用水的新规定。

fee.s: The students had to pay an extra fee for using the laboratory equipment.
fee.z: 学生们必须为使用实验室设备支付额外费用。

feeble.s: The old man's voice was so feeble that we could hardly hear him.
feeble.z: 那位老人的声音如此微弱，我们几乎听不见他说话。

feed.s: She feeds her cat twice a day before leaving for work.
feed.z: 她每天上班前喂猫两次。

feedback.s: The teacher gave us helpful feedback on our essays before the final exam.
feedback.z: 老师在期末考试前对我们的论文给出了有用的反馈。

feeling.s: She had a strange feeling that someone was watching her from behind.
feeling.z: 她有一种奇怪的感觉，觉得有人在背后看着她。

fell.s: The old tree fell during the storm and blocked the road.
fell.z: 那棵老树在暴风雨中倒下了，堵住了道路。

fellow.s: My fellow students helped me prepare for the important exam last week.
fellow.z: 我的同学们上周帮我准备了那场重要的考试。

fellowship.s: She joined a weekly fellowship group to discuss books and share life experiences.
fellowship.z: 她加入了一个每周一次的联谊小组，一起讨论书籍、分享生活经历。

female.s: The female scientists in our lab often share their research experiences with younger students.
female.z: 我们实验室的女科学家经常与年轻学生分享她们的研究经验。

femininity.s: The designer's new collection celebrates femininity through soft colors and flowing fabrics.
femininity.z: 这位设计师的新系列通过柔和的色彩和飘逸的面料来颂扬女性气质。

ferrous.s: The old factory recycled ferrous metals such as iron and steel from discarded machines.
ferrous.z: 这家旧工厂从废弃机器中回收铁和钢等黑色金属。

fertility.s: The fertility of the soil in this region has declined due to years of overuse.
fertility.z: 由于多年过度使用，该地区土壤的肥力已经下降。

fertilizer.s: Farmers should avoid using too much fertilizer, or the soil will be damaged.
fertilizer.z: 农民应避免使用过多化肥，否则土壤会受到损害。

fetch.s: Could you please fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen?
fetch.z: 你能从厨房给我拿一杯水来吗？

fever.s: She stayed home from class because a high fever made it hard to concentrate.
fever.z: 她因为高烧难以集中注意力而没去上课。

fibre.s: Eating enough fibre every day helps keep your digestive system healthy and regular.
fibre.z: 每天摄入足够的纤维有助于保持消化系统健康和规律。

fiction.s: She prefers reading fiction to watching movies because it lets her imagine the characters.
fiction.z: 她更喜欢读小说而不是看电影，因为读小说能让她想象出人物的样子。

field.s: She decided to work in the field of medicine after volunteering at a hospital.
field.z: 在医院做志愿者后，她决定从事医学领域的工作。

fierce.s: The competition for jobs in big cities has become increasingly fierce in recent years.
fierce.z: 近年来，大城市里的求职竞争变得越来越激烈。

fighter.s: The young fighter trained hard every day to prepare for the championship.
fighter.z: 这位年轻的拳手每天刻苦训练，为锦标赛做准备。

figure.s: The sales figures for last quarter were much higher than we expected.
figure.z: 上个季度的销售数据远高于我们的预期。

filament.s: The thin filament inside the light bulb broke, so the lamp stopped working.
filament.z: 灯泡里细小的灯丝断了，所以灯不亮了。

file.s: Please save the report as a PDF file before sending it to the manager.
file.z: 请先把报告保存为PDF文件，然后再发送给经理。

fill.s: Please fill the bottle with clean water before you leave the lab.
fill.z: 离开实验室前，请把瓶子装满干净的水。

filth.s: The kitchen was covered in filth after the party ended.
filth.z: 聚会结束后，厨房里满是污秽。

final.s: The students are preparing for their final exams next week.
final.z: 学生们正在为下周的期末考试做准备。

finally.s: After months of hard work, she finally passed the difficult exam.
finally.z: 经过几个月的努力，她终于通过了那场困难的考试。

finance.s: She studies finance at university because she wants to work in a bank.
finance.z: 她在大学学习金融，因为她想在一家银行工作。

financial.s: The company is facing serious financial problems after losing its biggest customer.
financial.z: 失去最大的客户后，这家公司正面临严重的财务问题。

finding.s: The researchers published their findings in a well-known academic journal last month.
finding.z: 研究人员上个月在一家知名学术期刊上发表了他们的研究结果。

fine.s: She had to pay a fine for returning the library book two weeks late.
fine.z: 她因逾期两周归还图书馆的书而不得不缴纳罚款。

finely.s: The chef chopped the herbs finely before adding them to the soup.
finely.z: 厨师在把香草加入汤之前将其切得很细。

fire.s: The fire spread quickly through the old wooden house before firefighters arrived.
fire.z: 消防员到达之前，大火迅速蔓延了那座旧木屋。

firework.s: The children watched the colorful fireworks light up the night sky.
firework.z: 孩子们看着五彩缤纷的烟花照亮了夜空。

firm.s: The company has a firm policy against using phones during meetings.
firm.z: 公司有严格的规定，禁止在会议期间使用手机。

firmness.s: Her firmness on the issue convinced everyone that she would not change her mind.
firmness.z: 她在这个问题上的坚定让所有人都相信她不会改变主意。

fiscal.s: The government announced new fiscal policies to reduce the budget deficit next year.
fiscal.z: 政府宣布了新的财政政策，以减少明年的预算赤字。

fisherman.s: The old fisherman returned to the harbor before the storm arrived.
fisherman.z: 那位老渔夫在暴风雨来临前回到了港口。

fission.s: Scientists studied how nuclear fission releases a huge amount of energy in a short time.
fission.z: 科学家研究了核裂变如何在短时间内释放出巨大的能量。

fitness.s: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining physical fitness.
fitness.z: 规律锻炼和均衡饮食对保持身体健康至关重要。

fitting.s: It is fitting that the whole class celebrated her hard work with a small party.
fitting.z: 全班同学办了一个小型聚会来庆祝她的努力，这是很合适的。

fix.s: The mechanic promised to fix my car before the end of the day.
fix.z: 机械师答应在一天结束前修好我的车。

fixture.s: The old wooden table has been a fixture in our kitchen for over twenty years.
fixture.z: 那张旧木桌二十多年来一直是我們厨房里固定不变的摆设。

flake.s: She brushed a few white flakes of snow from her coat before entering the warm room.
flake.z: 她在进入温暖的房间之前，拂去了外套上的几片白色雪花。

flannel.s: He wore a soft flannel shirt to stay warm during the cold winter mornings.
flannel.z: 在寒冷的冬日早晨，他穿着一件柔软的法兰绒衬衫来保暖。

flash.s: A bright flash of lightning lit up the whole sky during the storm.
flash.z: 暴风雨中一道明亮的闪电照亮了整个天空。

flask.s: She poured the hot coffee into a small flask before leaving for the hike.
flask.z: 出发去徒步前，她把热咖啡倒进了一个小保温瓶里。

flat.s: She found a small flat near the university and moved in last week.
flat.z: 她在大学附近找到了一套小公寓，上周搬了进去。

flatten.s: The workers used a heavy machine to flatten the wet ground before building the road.
flatten.z: 工人们用重型机器在修路前把湿地面压平。

flavour.s: This soup has a rich flavour that reminds me of my grandmother's cooking.
flavour.z: 这汤味道浓郁，让我想起祖母做的菜。

flaw.s: The engineer discovered a serious flaw in the design before production began.
flaw.z: 工程师在生产开始前发现了设计中的一个严重缺陷。

flee.s: Many residents were forced to flee their homes when the floodwaters rose rapidly.
flee.z: 洪水迅速上涨时，许多居民被迫逃离家园。

flexibility.s: Yoga helps improve flexibility and reduces the risk of injury during exercise.
flexibility.z: 瑜伽有助于提高柔韧性，并降低运动时受伤的风险。

flight.s: Our flight to Beijing was delayed for two hours because of heavy snow.
flight.z: 由于大雪，我们飞往北京的航班延误了两个小时。

flow.s: The river flows slowly through the quiet village before reaching the sea.
flow.z: 这条河缓缓流过宁静的村庄，然后汇入大海。

flu.s: She stayed home from class for a week because she had the flu.
flu.z: 她因为得了流感，一周没去上课。

fluctuation.s: Small fluctuations in temperature can affect the results of the experiment.
fluctuation.z: 温度的微小波动会影响实验结果。

fluently.s: She speaks English so fluently that everyone thinks she grew up abroad.
fluently.z: 她英语说得如此流利，以至于每个人都以为她是在国外长大的。

fluorescent.s: The office installed fluorescent lights to save energy and brighten the room.
fluorescent.z: 办公室安装了荧光灯以节省能源并照亮房间。

flux.s: The job market is in a state of constant flux, so workers must keep learning new skills.
flux.z: 就业市场处于不断变化的状态，因此员工必须不断学习新技能。

foam.s: White foam covered the surface of the river near the factory.
foam.z: 白色的泡沫覆盖了工厂附近河水的表面。

focus.s: She turned off her phone so she could focus on studying for the final exam.
focus.z: 她关掉了手机，以便能专心为期末考试复习。

fold.s: She carefully folded the letter and placed it inside the envelope.
fold.z: 她小心地把信折好，放进了信封里。

folk.s: Many folk songs have been passed down from generation to generation in this village.
folk.z: 这个村子里有许多民歌世代相传。

follower.s: She has thousands of followers on social media who enjoy her daily posts.
follower.z: 她在社交媒体上有数千名粉丝，他们喜欢她每天发布的帖子。

following.s: Following the instructions carefully, she finished the experiment before noon.
following.z: 她仔细遵照说明，在中午前完成了实验。

foolish.s: It was foolish of him to ignore the warning signs and continue driving.
foolish.z: 他忽视警告标志继续开车，真是太愚蠢了。

foothold.s: The small company gained a foothold in the foreign market after years of hard work.
foothold.z: 经过多年的努力，这家小公司终于在海外市场站稳了脚跟。

footnote.s: The professor added a footnote to explain the source of the data.
footnote.z: 教授加了一个脚注来解释数据的来源。

footpath.s: We walked along the narrow footpath beside the river until sunset.
footpath.z: 我们沿着河边狭窄的小路一直走到日落。

footstep.s: I heard soft footsteps behind me as I walked home alone last night.
footstep.z: 昨晚我独自走回家时，听到身后有轻柔的脚步声。

force.s: The strong wind forced the students to cancel their outdoor activities today.
force.z: 大风迫使学生们取消了今天的户外活动。

fore.s: The fore part of the ship was damaged by the heavy waves.
fore.z: 船的前部被巨浪损坏了。

forecast.s: Experts forecast that online sales will continue to grow rapidly next year.
forecast.z: 专家预测明年网上销售额将继续快速增长。

forefinger.s: She pointed her forefinger at the map to show us the shortest route.
forefinger.z: 她用食指指着地图，给我们指出最短的路线。

foreigner.s: Many foreigners visit the city every year to learn about Chinese culture.
foreigner.z: 每年有许多外国人来这座城市了解中国文化。

foremost.s: Safety is our foremost concern when we design new equipment for students.
foremost.z: 当我们为学生设计新设备时，安全是我们最重要的考虑。

foresee.s: Few experts could foresee how quickly the online market would change.
foresee.z: 很少有专家能预见到网络市场会变化得如此之快。

foreseeable.s: The company failed to prepare for the foreseeable risks of the new project.
foreseeable.z: 公司未能为新项目可预见的风险做好准备。

forge.s: She managed to forge a strong friendship with her roommate during their first year at college.
forge.z: 在大学第一年，她设法与室友建立了牢固的友谊。

forgive.s: She decided to forgive her friend for the careless mistake.
forgive.z: 她决定原谅朋友那个粗心的错误。

form.s: Students must fill out a form before they can borrow books from the library.
form.z: 学生必须先填写一张表格，才能从图书馆借书。

formal.s: She wore a formal dress to the interview and impressed everyone with her confidence.
formal.z: 她穿了一件正式的连衣裙去面试，她的自信给每个人都留下了深刻印象。

format.s: Please format the report so that all the tables and headings look consistent.
format.z: 请把报告排版，使所有表格和标题看起来保持一致。

formation.s: The formation of good study habits takes time and steady effort.
formation.z: 良好学习习惯的形成需要时间和持续的努力。

former.s: The former manager still visits the office to see his old colleagues.
former.z: 前任经理仍然会来办公室看望他的老同事们。

formerly.s: This building was formerly a factory, but now it serves as a public library.
formerly.z: 这座建筑以前是一家工厂，但现在作为公共图书馆使用。

formidable.s: The young lawyer faced a formidable opponent in the final round of the debate.
formidable.z: 这位年轻律师在辩论的最后一轮遇到了一位强劲的对手。

formula.s: The scientist wrote the formula on the board before explaining the experiment.
formula.z: 科学家在解释实验之前把公式写在了黑板上。

formulate.s: The committee will formulate a new policy to reduce air pollution in cities.
formulate.z: 委员会将制定一项新政策来减少城市空气污染。

formulation.s: The formulation of a clear research question is the first step in any academic study.
formulation.z: 提出一个明确的研究问题是任何学术研究的第一步。

forsake.s: She promised never to forsake her old friends after becoming famous.
forsake.z: 她答应成名后绝不会抛弃老朋友。

forthcoming.s: The details of the forthcoming meeting will be announced next week.
forthcoming.z: 即将举行的会议的细节将于下周公布。

fortress.s: The old castle on the hill once served as a fortress against enemy attacks.

geographic.z: 这项研究考察地理因素如何影响当地气候和农业。

geometry.z: 学过几何学的学生通常更容易解决关于形状和空间的问题。

hunger.z: 贫困地区的许多儿童仍然每天忍受饥饿。

hungry.s: After studying all morning, the students were too hungry to focus on the lecture.
hungry.z: 学习了一整个上午后，学生们饿得无法专心听课。

hunt.s: The police continued to hunt for the missing child throughout the night.
hunt.z: 警方整夜继续搜寻那个失踪的孩子。

hurrah.s: The students gave a loud hurrah when the teacher announced the canceled exam.
hurrah.z: 当老师宣布取消考试时，学生们大声欢呼。

hush.s: A sudden hush fell over the crowded hall as the speaker walked to the stage.
hush.z: 当演讲者走上舞台时，拥挤的大厅里突然安静下来。

hustle.s: She had to hustle to finish her essay before the deadline.
hustle.z: 她不得不加快速度，在截止日期前完成论文。

hydraulic.s: The hydraulic system failed, so the workers could not lift the heavy machine.
hydraulic.z: 液压系统失灵了，所以工人们无法抬起那台沉重的机器。

hydrocarbon.s: Burning hydrocarbons such as gasoline releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
hydrocarbon.z: 燃烧汽油等碳氢化合物会向大气中释放二氧化碳。

hymn.s: The whole village stood quietly and sang a beautiful hymn during the morning service.
hymn.z: 整个村庄在晨间礼拜时静静地站着，唱起了一首优美的赞美诗。

hypothesis.s: The researchers tested their hypothesis with a series of simple experiments.
hypothesis.z: 研究人员通过一系列简单的实验验证了他们的假设。

icy.s: The road became icy after the sudden drop in temperature overnight.
icy.z: 夜间气温骤降后，路面变得结冰了。

ideal.s: Finding a quiet place to study is ideal before final exams begin.
ideal.z: 在期末考试开始前，找到一个安静的地方学习是最理想的。

idealism.s: Her youthful idealism faded as she learned how difficult real change could be.
idealism.z: 随着年龄增长，她认识到真正的改变有多么困难，年轻时的理想主义也随之消退。

ideally.s: Ideally, students should review their notes within a day of each lecture.
ideally.z: 理想情况下，学生应该在每次讲座后一天内复习笔记。

identical.s: The two brothers wore identical shirts to the party, so everyone thought they were twins.
identical.z: 两兄弟穿着完全相同的衬衫去参加聚会，所以大家都以为他们是双胞胎。

identification.s: Please bring a photo identification card when you take the exam.
identification.z: 考试时请携带带照片的身份证明。

identify.s: Scientists can identify the cause of the disease by studying these tiny cells.
identify.z: 科学家可以通过研究这些微小的细胞来识别这种疾病的病因。

identity.s: Many students struggle to find their own identity during their first year at college.
identity.z: 许多学生在大学第一年努力寻找自己的身份认同。

ideological.s: The debate over social media often reflects a deeper ideological divide between generations.
ideological.z: 关于社交媒体的争论往往反映了代际之间更深层次的意识形态分歧。

ideologically.s: The two parties are ideologically divided on how to reform the health care system.
ideologically.z: 两党在如何改革医疗体系上存在意识形态分歧。

ideology.s: The new government tried to promote its political ideology through the education system.
ideology.z: 新政府试图通过教育体系来推广其政治意识形态。

idleness.s: Constant idleness during the summer holiday made him feel restless and unproductive.
idleness.z: 暑假期间持续的闲散让他感到烦躁不安、一事无成。

ignorance.s: His ignorance of basic safety rules caused a serious accident at the factory.
ignorance.z: 他对基本安全规则的忽视在工厂造成了一起严重事故。

ignore.s: Many students ignore the teacher's advice and stay up late before exams.
ignore.z: 许多学生忽视老师的建议，在考试前熬夜。

illegal.s: It is illegal to park your car in front of the hospital entrance.
illegal.z: 把车停在医院入口前面是违法的。

illiterate.s: Many older villagers remain illiterate and need help reading official documents.
illiterate.z: 许多年长的村民仍是文盲，需要别人帮忙阅读官方文件。

illness.s: Her sudden illness forced her to miss several important classes this semester.
illness.z: 她突发的疾病迫使她这学期缺了好几节重要的课。

illuminate.s: The new streetlights illuminate the entire road, making it much safer for pedestrians at night.
illuminate.z: 新路灯照亮了整条道路，使行人夜间出行安全了许多。

illusion.s: The mirror on the wall creates the illusion that the small room is twice as large.
illusion.z: 墙上的镜子营造出一种错觉，让这个小房间看起来大了一倍。

illustrate.s: The teacher used simple pictures to illustrate her point about climate change.
illustrate.z: 老师用简单的图片来说明她关于气候变化的观点。

illustration.s: The teacher used a simple illustration to explain how the machine works.
illustration.z: 老师用一幅简单的插图来解释这台机器是如何运作的。

image.s: The company spent millions improving its public image after the scandal.
image.z: 丑闻发生后，该公司花了数百万美元来改善其公众形象。

imaginary.s: As a child, she often talked to an imaginary friend in the garden.
imaginary.z: 小时候，她经常在花园里和一个想象中的朋友说话。

imagination.s: Children who read stories regularly tend to develop a stronger imagination than those who do not.
imagination.z: 经常读故事的孩子往往比不读故事的孩子拥有更丰富的想象力。

imaginative.s: The children wrote an imaginative story about a city floating in the sky.
imaginative.z: 孩子们写了一个关于漂浮在天空中的城市的故事，富有想象力。

imbalance.s: The imbalance between work and family life often causes serious stress for young employees.
imbalance.z: 工作与家庭生活之间的不平衡常常给年轻员工带来严重的压力。

imitate.s: Young children often imitate the behavior of their parents without realizing it.
imitate.z: 幼儿常常会不知不觉地模仿父母的行为。

imitation.s: Children learn many social behaviors through imitation of the adults around them.
imitation.z: 孩子们通过模仿周围的成年人来学习许多社会行为。

immeasurable.s: The teacher's kindness had an immeasurable effect on her students' lives.
immeasurable.z: 老师的善意对学生的人生产生了不可估量的影响。

immediate.s: She called the doctor for immediate help when her son's fever suddenly got worse.
immediate.z: 当儿子的高烧突然加重时，她立刻打电话向医生求助。

immediately.s: Please call me immediately if you have any problems with the assignment.
immediately.z: 如果你对这个作业有任何问题，请立刻给我打电话。

immensely.s: The professor's lecture was immensely helpful, so students stayed late to ask more questions.
immensely.z: 教授的讲座非常有用，因此学生们留下来问了更多问题。

immerse.s: She immersed herself in her studies for weeks before the final exam.
immerse.z: 期末考试前，她连续几周全身心投入到学习中。

immersive.s: The immersive virtual reality game made players feel like they were truly inside another world.
immersive.z: 这款沉浸式虚拟现实游戏让玩家感觉自己真的置身于另一个世界之中。

immigrant.s: Many immigrants work hard to build a better life for their families in the new country.
immigrant.z: 许多移民努力奋斗，为了家人在新的国家创造更美好的生活。

immigration.s: The new policy on immigration has sparked heated debate across the country.
immigration.z: 新的移民政策在全国引发了激烈的争论。

immobile.s: The injured driver remained immobile until the ambulance arrived at the scene.
immobile.z: 受伤的司机一动不动，直到救护车到达现场。

immortal.s: The ancient hero was believed to be immortal, so people built a temple in his honor.
immortal.z: 人们相信这位古代英雄是不朽的，因此为他建造了一座神庙。

immune.s: Children who have had the virus are usually immune to it for life.
immune.z: 感染过这种病毒的孩子通常会对它终身免疫。

impact.s: The new policy had a significant impact on students' daily lives.
impact.z: 这项新政策对学生的日常生活产生了重大影响。

impair.s: Lack of sleep can seriously impair your ability to concentrate during exams.
impair.z: 睡眠不足会严重损害你在考试期间的注意力。

impartial.s: A good judge must remain impartial when listening to both sides of the story.
impartial.z: 一个好的法官在听取双方陈述时必须保持公正。

impermanency.s: The impermanency of life teaches us to cherish every moment we have.
impermanency.z: 生命无常，教导我们珍惜所拥有的每一刻。

impermanent.s: She accepted that happiness is impermanent and learned to enjoy every moment.
impermanent.z: 她接受了幸福是无常的，并学会了享受每一个瞬间。

implement.s: The company plans to implement a new policy to reduce waste next month.
implement.z: 公司计划下个月实施一项新政策以减少浪费。

implementation.s: The successful implementation of the new policy requires cooperation from all departments.
implementation.z: 新政策的成功实施需要所有部门的合作。

implication.s: The new policy has serious implications for small businesses across the country.
implication.z: 新政策对全国各地的小企业有着严重的影响。

implore.s: She implored her professor to give her one more day to finish the essay.
implore.z: 她恳求教授多给她一天时间完成这篇论文。

imply.s: His silence seemed to imply that he disagreed with the plan.
imply.z: 他的沉默似乎暗示他不同意这个计划。

import.s: The country imports most of its oil from abroad, which makes its economy vulnerable to price changes.
import.z: 该国大部分石油依靠进口，这使其经济容易受到价格波动的影响。

importance.s: Many students underestimate the importance of regular review before final exams.
importance.z: 许多学生低估了期末考试前定期复习的重要性。

impose.s: The government decided to impose stricter rules on companies that pollute the environment.
impose.z: 政府决定对污染环境的公司实施更严格的规定。

impression.s: Her calm and confident manner left a strong impression on the interviewers.
impression.z: 她沉着自信的举止给面试官们留下了深刻的印象。

impressive.s: Her presentation was so impressive that the whole class stayed quiet for a moment.
impressive.z: 她的演讲如此令人印象深刻，以至于全班都安静了片刻。

improper.s: Wearing improper clothes to a formal interview may leave a bad impression.
improper.z: 穿着不合适的衣服去正式面试可能会留下不好的印象。

improve.s: Regular exercise can greatly improve both your physical health and your mood.
improve.z: 规律的锻炼能大大改善你的身体健康和情绪。

improvement.s: The new manager made a noticeable improvement in the team's work efficiency.
improvement.z: 新经理使团队的工作效率有了明显的提高。

impulse.s: She bought the expensive dress on impulse and regretted it the next day.
impulse.z: 她一时冲动买下了那条昂贵的裙子，第二天就后悔了。

impulsive.s: She made an impulsive decision to buy the expensive dress without checking her budget.
impulsive.z: 她没有查看预算就冲动地决定买下那条昂贵的裙子。

impurity.s: Even a tiny impurity in the water can affect the results of the experiment.
impurity.z: 即使水中有一点点杂质，也会影响实验结果。

inaccessible.s: The village is inaccessible by car because the only road was destroyed by the flood.
inaccessible.z: 这个村庄无法开车到达，因为唯一的道路被洪水冲毁了。

inaccurate.s: The report was inaccurate because the data had been collected in a hurry.
inaccurate.z: 这份报告不准确，因为数据是匆忙收集的。

inaction.s: The government's inaction on climate change has worried many young people.
inaction.z: 政府在气候变化问题上的不作为令许多年轻人感到担忧。

inadequacy.s: Many students feel a sense of inadequacy when they compare themselves with top classmates.
inadequacy.z: 许多学生在与顶尖同学比较时会产生一种不足感。

inadequate.s: The training was inadequate, so the workers could not handle the new equipment safely.
inadequate.z: 培训不足，因此工人们无法安全地操作新设备。

inanimate.s: The children treated the inanimate dolls as if they were alive.
inanimate.z: 孩子们把这些没有生命的玩偶当作活人一样对待。

inappropriate.s: It is inappropriate to wear casual clothes to a formal job interview.
inappropriate.z: 穿休闲服去参加正式的工作面试是不合适的。

inasmuch.s: Inasmuch as the data were incomplete, the researchers delayed their final conclusions.
inasmuch.z: 由于数据不完整，研究人员推迟了最终结论。

incalculable.s: The damage caused by the flood was incalculable, leaving thousands of families homeless.
incalculable.z: 洪水造成的损失无法估量，使数千个家庭无家可归。

incapable.s: He was incapable of hiding his excitement when he heard the good news.
incapable.z: 听到这个好消息时，他无法掩饰自己的兴奋。

incense.s: She lit a stick of incense before the old family photograph.
incense.z: 她在旧全家福前点燃了一根香。

incentive.s: The company offers a cash bonus as an incentive for employees to meet their sales targets.
incentive.z: 公司提供现金奖金作为激励，鼓励员工完成销售目标。

inch.s: The workers moved the heavy table forward inch by inch until it reached the wall.
inch.z: 工人们一点一点地把沉重的桌子向前移动，直到它靠到墙边。

incidence.s: The incidence of obesity among young people has increased sharply in recent years.
incidence.z: 近年来，年轻人中肥胖的发生率急剧上升。

incident.s: The police are investigating a strange incident that happened near the school last night.
incident.z: 警方正在调查昨晚在学校附近发生的一起奇怪事件。

incidentally.s: Incidentally, I found your missing keys under the sofa this morning.
incidentally.z: 顺便说一下，我今天早上在沙发下面找到了你丢失的钥匙。

inclination.s: She has a strong inclination to avoid risky decisions when she is under pressure.
inclination.z: 她在压力之下有强烈的倾向去避免冒险的决定。

inclusive.s: The new policy is designed to be inclusive of students from all backgrounds.
inclusive.z: 这项新政策旨在包容来自各种背景的学生。

income.s: Her monthly income is barely enough to cover rent and food in the city.
income.z: 她的月收入勉强够支付城市里的房租和伙食费。

incomparable.s: Her dedication to helping students made her an incomparable teacher in the eyes of everyone.
incomparable.z: 她对帮助学生的奉献使她在所有人眼中成为一位无可比拟的老师。

incompatibility.s: The incompatibility between the two software systems caused major delays in the project.
incompatibility.z: 这两个软件系统之间的不兼容导致项目严重延误。

incompatible.s: The new software is incompatible with older computers, so we cannot install it.
incompatible.z: 这款新软件与旧电脑不兼容，所以我们无法安装它。

incompetence.s: The manager's incompetence led to serious delays and widespread complaints from the customers.
incompetence.z: 经理的无能导致了严重的延误和顾客的广泛投诉。

incompetent.s: The new manager was clearly incompetent and could not handle even simple tasks.
incompetent.z: 这位新经理显然不称职，连简单的任务都处理不了。

incomplete.s: The report was incomplete because several important details were missing.
incomplete.z: 这份报告不完整，因为缺少了几个重要的细节。

incorrect.s: The teacher marked the answer incorrect because it contained a careless mistake.
incorrect.z: 老师把那个答案判为错误，因为它包含一个粗心的错误。

increasingly.s: People are increasingly concerned about the impact of social media on mental health.
increasingly.z: 人们越来越担心社交媒体对心理健康的影响。

incur.s: If you park here illegally, you will incur a heavy fine.
incur.z: 如果你在这里违章停车，你将会被处以高额罚款。

independence.s: Learning to manage money wisely is an important step toward financial independence.
independence.z: 学会明智地管理金钱是迈向经济独立的重要一步。

independent.s: College students should learn to be independent and manage their own time wisely.
independent.z: 大学生应该学会独立，并明智地管理自己的时间。

independently.s: She learned to work independently and solve problems without asking for help.
independently.z: 她学会了独立工作，并在遇到问题时自己解决，而不去求助。

index.s: The index at the back of the book helps readers find topics quickly.
index.z: 书后的索引帮助读者快速找到相关主题。

india.s: She plans to travel to India next summer to study its traditional music.
india.z: 她计划明年夏天去印度学习那里的传统音乐。

indian.s: She cooked an Indian meal with rice, beans, and fresh vegetables for dinner.
indian.z: 她做了一顿印度饭，有米饭、豆子和新鲜蔬菜作为晚餐。

indicate.s: The sudden drop in sales indicates that customers are losing interest in this product.
indicate.z: 销量的突然下降表明顾客正在对这款产品失去兴趣。

indication.s: The dark clouds are a clear indication that a heavy storm is coming soon.
indication.z: 乌云是即将有一场大暴雨的明显迹象。

indicative.s: Her calm reaction was indicative of how well she had prepared for the interview.
indicative.z: 她平静的反应表明她为这次面试做了多么充分的准备。

indifferent.s: Many students seem indifferent to the news because they are busy with exams.
indifferent.z: 许多学生似乎对新闻漠不关心，因为他们忙于考试。

indignation.s: She could not hide her indignation when she learned that the company had ignored the workers' complaints.
indignation.z: 当她得知公司无视工人们的投诉时，她无法掩饰自己的愤怒。

indirect.s: The report offers only an indirect answer to the question of rising costs.
indirect.z: 这份报告对成本上升的问题只给出了间接的回答。

indiscriminately.s: The company was accused of cutting down trees indiscriminately across the forest.
indiscriminately.z: 该公司被指控在森林中肆意砍伐树木。

individual.s: Each individual in the group was asked to share a personal opinion.
individual.z: 小组中的每个人都必须分享自己的个人观点。

indoors.s: Because of the heavy rain, the children stayed indoors and played board games all afternoon.
indoors.z: 由于大雨，孩子们待在室内玩了一下午的棋盘游戏。

induce.s: The doctor warned that smoking can induce serious lung diseases over time.
induce.z: 医生警告说，吸烟久而久之会诱发严重的肺部疾病。

induction.s: New employees must attend a week of induction training before they start work.
induction.z: 新员工在开始工作前必须参加为期一周的入职培训。

indulge.s: Many students indulge in video games on weekends instead of reviewing their lessons.
indulge.z: 许多学生周末沉迷于电子游戏，而不是复习功课。

industrial.s: The rapid industrial growth of this region has created thousands of new jobs.
industrial.z: 该地区快速的工业增长创造了数千个新的就业机会。

industrialize.s: Many developing countries hope to industrialize quickly to create more jobs and raise living standards.
industrialize.z: 许多发展中国家希望迅速实现工业化，以创造更多就业机会并提高生活水平。

industrious.s: She is an industrious student who spends hours studying in the library every day.
industrious.z: 她是一个勤奋的学生，每天花好几个小时在图书馆学习。

industry.s: The new factory has brought many jobs to the local industry.
industry.z: 这家新工厂为当地产业带来了许多就业机会。

ineffective.s: The old teaching method proved ineffective, so the school adopted a new approach.
ineffective.z: 旧的教学方法被证明效果不佳，因此学校采用了一种新方法。

inefficient.s: The old filing system is so inefficient that we waste hours searching for simple documents.
inefficient.z: 旧的归档系统效率极低，我们浪费好几个小时去寻找简单的文件。

inescapable.s: The feeling of pressure before final exams seems inescapable for most students.
inescapable.z: 对大多数学生来说，期末考试前的压力感似乎无法逃避。

inevitable.s: With so many delays, it was inevitable that the project would finish late.
inevitable.z: 由于出现了这么多延误，项目推迟完成是不可避免的。

inevitably.s: As technology advances, some traditional jobs will inevitably disappear.
inevitably.z: 随着技术的进步，一些传统职业将不可避免地消失。

inexhaustible.s: Her energy for helping students seemed inexhaustible, even after a long day of teaching.
inexhaustible.z: 她帮助学生的精力似乎取之不尽，即使教了一整天课之后也是如此。

inexpensive.s: This small restaurant serves inexpensive meals that many students can afford.
inexpensive.z: 这家小餐馆提供许多学生都负担得起的便宜饭菜。

infant.s: The infant slept peacefully in her mother's arms while the family waited at the clinic.
infant.z: 当一家人在诊所等候时，这个婴儿在她母亲的怀里安静地睡着了。

infectious.s: Her laughter was so infectious that everyone in the room began to smile.
infectious.z: 她的笑声极具感染力，房间里的每个人都开始微笑起来。

infer.s: From her tone, I could infer that she was not satisfied with the result.
infer.z: 从她的语气中，我可以推断出她对结果并不满意。

inference.s: From these few clues, she made a reasonable inference about what had happened.
inference.z: 根据这几条线索，她对发生的事情做出了合理的推断。

inferior.s: Many students feel inferior when they compare their grades with those of top classmates.
inferior.z: 许多学生在把自己的成绩与顶尖同学的成绩比较时会感到自卑。

inferiority.s: Constant comparison with classmates can damage a student's confidence and create feelings of inferiority.
inferiority.z: 不断与同学比较会损害学生的自信心，并产生自卑感。

isolate.z: 新的安全规定可能会使需要额外帮助的员工受到孤立。

isolation.z: 许多学生初次搬到大城市上大学时会感到一种孤立感。

it.z: 我找到了你提到的那本书，但它已经卖完了。

italian.z: 她在暑假期间跟室友学会了做意大利菜。

item.z: 离开商店前，她核对了购物清单上的每一项。

japan.z: 制作漆器的技艺是几个世纪前从日本传入的。

jaw.z: 他在一次自行车事故中摔断了下颌，好几周都无法说话。

jealous.z: 当她最好的朋友而不是她获得奖学金时，她感到嫉妒。

jealousy.s: Her jealousy grew stronger every time he praised his talented new colleague.
jealousy.z: 每次他称赞那位有才华的新同事时，她的嫉妒心就更强一些。

jean.z: 她昨晚穿着一件褪色的牛仔夹克去听音乐会。

jesus.s: Many people around the world read stories about Jesus in religious books.
jesus.z: 世界上许多人会在宗教书籍中阅读关于耶稣的故事。

jewellery.s: She keeps her jewellery in a small wooden box on the dressing table.
jewellery.z: 她把珠宝首饰放在梳妆台上的一个小木盒里。

jewish.s: She found a Jewish cookbook at the bookstore and bought it for her friend.
jewish.z: 她在书店找到一本犹太食谱，并买给了她的朋友。

jingle.s: The little bells on the cat's collar jingle softly whenever it walks around the house.
jingle.z: 每当猫在房子里走动时，它项圈上的小铃铛就会轻轻作响。

joint.z: 两家公司签署了一项联合协议，共同开发新能源技术。

jolly.s: The jolly old man told funny stories that made everyone laugh during the party.
jolly.z: 那位快活的老人讲了有趣的故事，让派对上的每个人都笑了。

journal.s: She writes in her journal every night before going to bed.
journal.z: 她每天晚上睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

journalist.z: 那位年轻记者在写文章之前采访了几位目击者。

joy.s: The children shouted with joy when they saw the first snow of the year.
joy.z: 孩子们看到今年的第一场雪时高兴地欢呼起来。

joyful.s: The children were joyful when they heard the news about the school trip.
joyful.z: 孩子们听到学校旅行的消息时感到非常高兴。

judge.s: Please do not judge him before you know the whole story.
judge.z: 在了解全部情况之前，请不要评判他。

judgement.s: You should not make a judgement before hearing both sides of the story.
judgement.z: 在听完事情的双方说法之前，你不应该下判断。

jug.s: She poured fresh milk from the jug into two cups for breakfast.
jug.z: 她把新鲜牛奶从壶里倒进两个杯子作为早餐。

junk.s: He decided to throw away all the junk in the garage before moving to a new apartment.
junk.z: 他决定在搬到新公寓前把车库里的所有废旧杂物都扔掉。

jupiter.s: Through a small telescope, Jupiter appears as a bright disk with faint bands.
jupiter.z: 通过小型望远镜，木星呈现为一个带有淡淡条纹的明亮圆盘。

jury.s: The jury took three days to reach a verdict in the robbery case.
jury.z: 陪审团花了三天时间才在抢劫案中做出裁决。

justice.s: The judge promised that everyone in the small town would receive equal justice under the law.
justice.z: 法官承诺，小镇上的每个人都会在法律面前获得平等的公正对待。

justifiable.s: Her anger was justifiable because he had broken his promise twice.
justifiable.z: 她的愤怒是合理的，因为他已经两次违背诺言。

justification.s: There is no justification for treating employees so unfairly.
justification.z: 如此不公平地对待员工是没有任何正当理由的。

justified.s: She felt fully justified in complaining about the poor service at the restaurant.
justified.z: 她觉得完全有理由抱怨那家餐厅糟糕的服务。

justify.s: The teacher asked him to justify his answer with clear evidence from the text.
justify.z: 老师要求他用文中的明确证据来证明自己的答案。

keen.s: She is keen to improve her English before the final exam.
keen.z: 她渴望在期末考试前提高自己的英语水平。

keenly.s: She keenly felt the pressure of the approaching final exams and studied late every night.
keenly.z: 她敏锐地感受到期末考试临近的压力，每晚都学习到很晚。

keeper.z: 她是所有办公室钥匙的保管人，对每个房间都很熟悉。

kernel.z: 他的论点的核心是教育应该对所有人开放。

kilometre.s: The nearest hospital is only one kilometre away from our school.
kilometre.z: 最近的医院离我们学校只有一公里远。

kilowatt.s: This new air conditioner uses less than one kilowatt of electricity per hour.
kilowatt.z: 这台新空调每小时耗电不到一千瓦。

kindle.s: A good teacher can kindle a lifelong love of learning in students.
kindle.z: 一位好老师能激发学生对学习的终身热爱。

kindness.s: Her kindness to the new students made them feel welcome on campus.
kindness.z: 她对新生们的友善让他们在校园里感到受欢迎。

kinetic.s: The rolling ball has kinetic energy that increases as it speeds up.
kinetic.z: 滚动的球具有动能，随着速度加快，其动能也会增加。

kingdom.s: The old king ruled his kingdom wisely for over forty years.
kingdom.z: 这位老国王英明地统治他的王国四十多年。

kit.s: She packed a small kit with bandages, scissors, and medicine before the trip.
kit.z: 旅行前，她把绷带、剪刀和药品装进了一个小工具箱里。

knit.z: 我奶奶喜欢在冬天为全家人编织温暖的毛衣。

knowledge.z: 她对当地历史的了解帮助团队提前完成了项目。

lab.z: 学生在化学实验室工作时必须戴护目镜。

label.z: 服药前请仔细阅读标签。

laboratory.z: 学生们整个下午都在实验室里检测他们的样本。

laborious.z: 手工抄录所有数据是一项耗时数天的繁重工作。

labour.z: 这台新机器减少了农场所需的体力劳动。

lack.s: Many students lack the confidence to speak English in front of a large audience.
lack.z: 许多学生缺乏在众多观众面前说英语的信心。

ladder.s: He climbed the ladder carefully to reach the books on the top shelf.
ladder.z: 他小心地爬上梯子去拿最上层架子上的书。

lag.s: Some students lag behind in class because they spend too much time on their phones.
lag.z: 有些学生因为花太多时间玩手机而在课堂上落后。

lame.z: 受伤后，他瘸着腿走了好几个星期。

landing.s: The plane made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
landing.z: 尽管风很大，飞机还是平稳地着陆了。

landlady.z: 女房东要求我们在每月月底前交房租。

lane.z: 周末早晨，沿河的自行车道上挤满了骑车的人。

lantern.z: 她在门上挂了一盏红纸灯笼来迎接新年。

largely.s: The success of the project depends largely on how well the team cooperates.
largely.z: 这个项目的成功在很大程度上取决于团队合作的好坏。

latent.s: The teacher helped students discover their latent talents through creative projects.
latent.z: 老师通过创意项目帮助学生发现他们潜在的才能。

later.s: She promised to call me later after finishing her homework.
later.z: 她答应做完作业后晚点给我打电话。

lathe.z: 工人们用一台车床把金属加工成光滑的圆形零件。

latin.s: Many English words come from Latin, which makes them easier to remember.
latin.z: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语，这使得它们更容易记住。

lattice.s: The garden gate was made of a wooden lattice covered with climbing roses.
lattice.z: 花园的门是由木制格子做成的，上面爬满了玫瑰。

laughter.s: The room was filled with laughter when the teacher told a funny story.
laughter.z: 当老师讲了一个有趣的故事时，房间里充满了笑声。

launch.s: The company plans to launch its new product next month.
launch.z: 公司计划下个月推出它的新产品。

lawsuit.s: The company faced a costly lawsuit after it failed to protect customers' personal data.
lawsuit.z: 该公司因未能保护客户的个人数据而面临一场代价高昂的诉讼。

lawyer.s: She hired a lawyer to review the contract before signing it.
lawyer.z: 她在签署合同前聘请了一位律师来审阅合同。

lay.s: She decided to lay the documents on the table before the meeting began.
lay.z: 她决定在会议开始前把文件放在桌子上。

layout.s: The new office layout makes it much easier for employees to communicate with each other.
layout.z: 新的办公室布局使员工之间交流起来容易多了。

leader.s: A good leader listens carefully to the concerns of every team member.
leader.z: 一位优秀的领导者会认真倾听每位团队成员的关切。

leadership.s: Her strong leadership helped the team finish the project ahead of schedule.
leadership.z: 她强有力的领导帮助团队提前完成了项目。

leading.s: She is a leading expert in the field of environmental science.
leading.z: 她是环境科学领域的顶尖专家。

leak.s: The company promised to find out who leaked the secret report to the press.
leak.z: 公司承诺要查出是谁把这份秘密报告泄露给了媒体。

leakage.z: 工程师们发现管道上有一处小泄漏，并立即进行了修补。

lean.z: 长跑之后，她不得不靠在墙上喘口气。

learned.z: 在繁忙的学期里，她学会了明智地管理时间。

learning.s: Online learning has become an important part of college education in recent years.
learning.z: 近年来，在线学习已成为大学教育的重要组成部分。

lecture.s: She took careful notes during the lecture on modern history.
lecture.z: 她在现代史讲座上认真做了笔记。

legal.s: It is not legal to park your car on this street during rush hour.
legal.z: 在高峰时段把车停在这条街上是不合法的。

legalize.s: Some countries have legalized the use of marijuana for medical purposes.
legalize.z: 一些国家已将大麻的医疗用途合法化。

legislation.s: The new legislation aims to protect workers from unfair treatment in the workplace.
legislation.z: 这项新立法旨在保护员工在工作场所免受不公平待遇。

legislator.z: 这位立法者提出了一项新法案，以改善农村地区的公共交通。

legitimate.z: 她昨天缺席那个重要会议有正当的理由。

leisure.z: 许多学生把闲暇时间用来读小说或和朋友一起运动。

length.z: 这座桥的长度让每个走过它的人都感到惊讶。

lengthen.s: The days lengthen quickly as spring approaches and the weather gets warmer.
lengthen.z: 随着春天的临近和天气变暖，白昼迅速变长。

lengthy.z: 教授在下课前对这个理论做了冗长的解释。

leopard.z: 这只豹子一边捕食，一边悄无声息地穿过高高的草丛。

lessen.s: Taking the subway instead of driving every day can lessen air pollution in the city.
lessen.z: 每天乘坐地铁而不是开车可以减轻城市的空气污染。

lever.z: 他用力拉下杠杆，沉重的门慢慢打开了。

levy.s: The city plans to levy a new tax on plastic bags next year.
levy.z: 该市计划明年对塑料袋征收一项新税。

liability.z: 如果修理费用不断累积，拥有一辆旧车可能会成为严重的经济负担。

liar.z: 没有人会相信一个说谎者，即使他终于说了实话。

liberal.z: 这位新教授在教育上持有开明的观点，鼓励学生质疑一切。

liberation.z: 洗衣机的发明给忙碌的家庭主妇带来了极大的解放。

librarian.z: 图书管理员帮我找到了几本对研究论文有用的书。

license.s: You need a valid license to drive a car on public roads.
license.z: 你需要有效的驾照才能在公共道路上开车。

lie.s: She decided to lie about her age to get the job.
lie.z: 她决定谎报年龄以获得那份工作。

lifetime.s: She spent a lifetime learning how to forgive herself and others.
lifetime.z: 她花了一生的时间学习如何原谅自己和他人。

lighten.s: The good news lightened her mood and she smiled at everyone.
lighten.z: 这个好消息让她的心情轻松起来，她对每个人都笑了。

lighter.s: She bought a small lighter to light the candles on the birthday cake.
lighter.z: 她买了一个小打火机来点燃生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。

lightly.s: She touched the baby's cheek lightly and smiled with great tenderness.
lightly.z: 她轻轻地摸了摸婴儿的脸颊，温柔地笑了。

likelihood.s: The likelihood of passing the exam increases if you review your notes every day.
likelihood.z: 如果你每天复习笔记，通过考试的可能性就会增加。

likely.s: It is likely that the exam will be postponed because of the heavy snow.
likely.z: 由于大雪，考试很可能会推迟。

likeness.s: The portrait showed a striking likeness of the old man's gentle smile.
likeness.z: 这幅肖像生动地展现了那位老人温和笑容的相似之处。

limb.s: After the fall, he could not move his injured limb without sharp pain.
limb.z: 摔倒之后，他只要一动受伤的肢体就会感到剧烈疼痛。

limestone.s: The old church was built with limestone taken from a nearby quarry.
limestone.z: 这座古老的教堂是用附近采石场开采的石灰岩建成的。

limit.s: The company decided to limit the time employees spend on personal calls during work hours.
limit.z: 公司决定限制员工在上班时间打私人电话的时长。

limitation.s: Every method has its limitations, so researchers must interpret the results with care.
limitation.z: 每种方法都有其局限性，因此研究人员必须谨慎解读结果。

limited.s: The number of seats in this classroom is limited, so please arrive early.
limited.z: 这间教室的座位数量有限，所以请早点到。

line.s: Please stand in line and wait for your turn to board the bus.
line.z: 请排队等候，轮到你时再上车。

linear.s: The teacher explained the linear relationship between the two variables using a simple graph.
linear.z: 老师用一张简单的图表解释了这两个变量之间的线性关系。

lining.s: The jacket has a soft cotton lining that keeps you warm in winter.
lining.z: 这件夹克有柔软的棉质衬里，冬天能让你保暖。

link.s: Scientists have found a clear link between regular exercise and better mental health.
link.z: 科学家发现，经常锻炼与更好的心理健康之间存在明显的联系。

lip.z: 她在等待考试成绩时紧张地咬着嘴唇。

listener.s: A good listener always pays close attention to what the speaker is saying.
listener.z: 一个好的倾听者总是密切关注说话者所说的内容。

literacy.s: Basic computer literacy is now required for most office jobs.
literacy.z: 现在大多数办公室工作都要求具备基本的电脑操作能力。

literally.s: He was so tired that he literally fell asleep at his desk.
literally.z: 他太累了，真的在书桌上睡着了。

literary.s: She spends her weekends reading literary magazines and writing short stories.
literary.z: 她周末都在阅读文学杂志和写短篇小说。

literature.s: She spends every weekend reading English literature to improve her vocabulary and writing skills.
literature.z: 她每个周末都阅读英国文学，以提高自己的词汇量和写作能力。

living.s: The cost of living in big cities keeps rising every year.
living.z: 大城市的生活成本每年都在不断上涨。

loan.z: 这个学生借了一笔小额贷款来支付这学期的学费。

lobby.z: 几个学生在酒店大堂等候，想请经理帮忙。

lobbyist.z: 那位游说者会见了数位参议员，讨论新的环境法案。

locality.z: 这个小地方的居民齐心协力改善他们的本地公园。

locate.s: Please locate the nearest exit before the fire alarm goes off.
locate.z: 请在火警响起之前找到最近的出口。

location.s: The location of the new library makes it easy for students to reach on foot.
location.z: 新图书馆的位置使学生们步行前往很方便。

locust.z: 一大群蝗虫在几小时内毁掉了村里的庄稼。

lodging.z: 新学期开始前，学生们在校园附近寻找便宜的住处。

logic.z: 她的论证如此清晰，以至于连她的对手也无法质疑其中的逻辑。

logical.z: 她的解释如此合乎逻辑，以至于大家很快就接受了这个新计划。

loom.z: 一场艰难的考试迫在眉睫，所以学生们学习到深夜。

loosely.s: The rules were loosely enforced, so students often arrived late without any punishment.

lovely.z: 天气非常好，所以我们决定下课后沿着河边散步。

luxurious.z: 这间酒店房间如此豪华，以至于她决定多住一晚。

luxury.z: 对大多数学生来说，在高级餐厅吃饭是他们很少能负担得起的奢侈品。

magnetism.z: 这座古镇的魅力每年夏天都吸引着成千上万的游客。

magnify.s: The new microscope can magnify tiny cells up to a thousand times.
magnify.z: 这台新显微镜能将微小的细胞放大一千倍。

mainframe.z: 这家银行仍然依靠一台大型计算机每天处理数百万笔交易。

mainly.z: 这门课程主要是为想提高写作能力的学生设计的。

maintenance.s: Regular maintenance of the equipment can prevent serious accidents at work.
maintenance.z: 定期维护设备可以防止工作中发生严重事故。

major.z: 选择一个与你兴趣相符的专业能让大学生活愉快得多。

majority.z: 大多数学生支持图书馆的新开放时间。

malfunction.z: 咖啡机开始发生故障，所以我们叫了技术人员来修理。

manage.z: 尽管日程繁忙，她还是设法按时完成了作业。

management.z: 良好的时间管理有助于学生平衡学业和社交活动。

manager.z: 新经理很快赢得了办公室里每个人的信任。

manner.s: She answered the question in a calm and polite manner.
manner.z: 她以平静而礼貌的方式回答了这个问题。

manuscript.z: 她花了整个周末修改手稿，然后才把它寄给期刊。

margin.z: 尽管今年生产成本上升，公司的利润率仍略有增长。

marriage.z: 他们的婚姻在多年坦诚的沟通中变得更加牢固。

married.z: 她嫁给一位善良的老师已经十多年了。

mars.z: 科学家们希望在未来几十年内将人类送上火星。

marvellous.s: The view from the top of the hill was absolutely marvellous in the early morning light.
marvellous.z: 清晨从山顶看到的景色真是美极了。

marvelous.s: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely marvelous.
marvelous.z: 从山顶看到的景色简直妙不可言。

massacre.s: The museum exhibit reminds visitors of the terrible massacre that happened in this village long ago.

master.z: 掌握一门外语需要多年的练习。

masterpiece.z: 这位年轻作家花了五年时间创作了一部小说，如今许多评论家称其为杰作。

material.z: 老师让我们为小组展示找一些有用的材料。

materialism.z: 许多年轻人正在摒弃物质主义，转而从有意义的经历中寻找幸福。

materialize.z: 经过多年的努力，她出国留学的梦想终于实现了。

mayor.z: 市长承诺在该市修建更多公园并改善公共交通。

meadow.s: The children ran happily through the green meadow behind their house.
meadow.z: 孩子们在屋后的绿色草地上快乐地奔跑。

meaning.s: Do you understand the meaning of this difficult word?
meaning.z: 你理解这个难词的意​​思吗？

meantime.z: 医生很快就会来看你，请在此期间稍等。

measurable.z: 新的教学方法使学生的阅读成绩有了可衡量的提高。

measure.s: The government took strict measures to reduce air pollution in major cities.
measure.z: 政府采取了严格措施来减少大城市的空气污染。

measurement.s: Accurate measurement of the room is necessary before we buy new furniture.
measurement.z: 在我们购买新家具之前，必须对房间进行精确测量。

mechanical.z: 这座旧钟因为内部的一个机械故障而停止运转了。

mechanics.z: 了解汽车运作的机械原理有助于驾驶员更好地保养车辆。

mechanism.z: 科学家们仍在努力弄清这种疾病背后的确切机制。

media.z: 社交媒体在当今年轻人获取新闻的方式中起着重要作用。

meditate.s: She likes to meditate for ten minutes every morning before starting her busy day.
meditate.z: 她喜欢每天早上在开始忙碌的一天之前冥想十分钟。

mediterranean.s: They spent their summer holiday sailing along the warm Mediterranean coast.
mediterranean.z: 他们沿着温暖的地中海海岸航行度过了暑假。

medium.s: She communicates with her students through a medium that feels natural and comfortable.
medium.z: 她通过一种自然且令人舒适的媒介与学生交流。

melancholy.z: 安静空旷的街道使她心中涌起一种深深的忧郁。

melt.z: 随着午后的阳光温暖了街道，雪开始迅速融化。

membership.z: 她申请成为当地健身俱乐部的会员以保持健康。

memo.z: 她在桌上留了一张简短的备忘录，提醒大家开会的事。

memorable.z: 那次去山区的旅行令人如此难忘，以至于我们至今还在谈论它。

memory.z: 她随身带笔记本记录重要细节，因为她的记忆力不太可靠。

mend.s: She learned to mend her old clothes instead of buying new ones.
mend.z: 她学会了缝补旧衣服，而不是买新的。

mental.z: 经常锻炼对身体健康和心理健康都有好处。

merciful.s: The judge was merciful and gave the young man a lighter sentence.
merciful.z: 法官很仁慈，给了这个年轻人较轻的判决。

mere.s: The mere thought of speaking in public makes him nervous.
mere.z: 仅仅想到在公众场合讲话就让他感到紧张。

merely.s: Success is not merely a matter of luck but the result of steady effort.
merely.z: 成功不仅仅是运气的问题，而是持续努力的结果。

merit.z: 委员会一致认为她的提案有足够的价值，值得进一步讨论。

mesh.z: 这两个部门合作得如此紧密，以至于他们的职责开始交织成一个整体。

messenger.z: 信使在中午之前把紧急包裹送到了我们的办公室。

metabolic.z: 经常锻炼可以提高你的代谢率，帮助你控制体重。

metal.s: The old bridge is made of metal and has lasted for over a hundred years.
metal.z: 这座旧桥是用金属建造的，已经使用了一百多年。

metre.z: 这个新游泳池长五十米，对所有学生开放。

metric.z: 公司使用多项指标来衡量员工每年的工作表现。

microcomputer.z: 学生们用一台微型计算机在截止日期前完成了编程作业。

mighty.z: 这条浩荡的河流穿过好几个国家，最后流入大海。

migrant.z: 许多外来务工人员离开家乡，到大城市寻找更好的工作。

migration.z: 许多鸟类在寒冷的冬天到来之前开始向南迁徙。

mild.z: 今天天气温和，所以我们可以步行去图书馆。

millionaire.z: 这位年轻的百万富翁决定把大部分财产捐给当地学校。

minority.z: 只有一小部分学生支持改变学校时间表的计划。
