miscalculation.z: 预算中的一个小小误算迫使团队推迟了整个项目。

mischief.s: The children got into mischief while their parents were busy cooking dinner.
mischief.z: 父母忙着做晚饭时，孩子们捣起乱来。

misconception.s: Many students have a misconception that memorizing words alone guarantees success in exams.
misconception.z: 许多学生有一种误解，认为仅仅背单词就能保证考试成功。

miser.s: The old miser refused to spend a single coin on his own meals.
miser.z: 那个老守财奴不肯为自己的饭菜花一枚硬币。

miserable.s: She felt miserable after spending the whole weekend alone in her empty apartment.
miserable.z: 她独自在空荡荡的公寓里度过整个周末后感到非常痛苦。

misery.s: The constant noise from the construction site caused great misery for the residents nearby.
misery.z: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音给附近的居民带来了极大的痛苦。

misguide.s: Advertisements that exaggerate the benefits of a product may misguide young consumers.
misguide.z: 夸大产品好处的广告可能会误导年轻消费者。

misguided.s: Her misguided attempt to help only made the situation more complicated.
misguided.z: 她出于好意的错误尝试反而让情况变得更复杂。

misinterpret.s: Students often misinterpret the question and lose points on the exam.
misinterpret.z: 学生常常误解题目，因而在考试中失分。

mislead.s: The advertisement was designed to mislead consumers about the true quality of the product.
mislead.z: 这则广告旨在误导消费者对该产品真实质量的判断。

misled.s: The advertisement misled many young people into buying products they did not need.
misled.z: 这则广告误导了许多年轻人购买他们并不需要的产品。

mismanagement.s: Poor mismanagement of the company's funds led to serious financial problems.
mismanagement.z: 公司资金管理不善导致了严重的财务问题。

mission.s: Her mission is to help poor children get a better education.
mission.z: 她的使命是帮助贫困儿童获得更好的教育。

misunderstand.s: Many students misunderstand the question and lose points on the exam.
misunderstand.z: 许多学生误解了这个问题，在考试中失了分。

mitten.s: She lost one mitten in the snow and had to walk home with a cold hand.
mitten.z: 她在雪地里丢了一只手套，只好用冻僵的手走回家。

mix.s: She likes to mix different fruits together to make a healthy breakfast.
mix.z: 她喜欢把不同的水果混合在一起，做成健康的早餐。

mixer.s: She bought a new mixer to prepare cakes for the family party.
mixer.z: 她买了一台新的搅拌机，为家庭聚会准备蛋糕。

mixture.s: The city's culture is a mixture of old traditions and modern ideas.
mixture.z: 这座城市的文化是古老传统与现代观念的混合。

moan.s: She let out a quiet moan when she heard the exam results.
moan.z: 听到考试结果时，她轻声呻吟了一下。

mob.s: An angry mob gathered outside the courthouse, demanding justice for the victim.
mob.z: 一群愤怒的暴徒聚集在法院外，要求为受害者伸张正义。

mobile.s: Many students keep their mobile phones in their bags during class.
mobile.z: 许多学生上课时把手机放在书包里。

mobility.s: Regular exercise greatly improves mobility in elderly people.
mobility.z: 规律锻炼能大大改善老年人的活动能力。

mock.s: The students decided to mock the new teacher's accent behind her back.
mock.z: 学生们决定在背后嘲笑新老师的口音。

mode.s: She switched her phone to silent mode before the important meeting began.
mode.z: 重要会议开始前，她把手机调成了静音模式。

moderate.s: Doctors suggest that we do moderate exercise for at least thirty minutes every day.
moderate.z: 医生建议我们每天进行至少三十分钟的适度运动。

moderately.s: She exercises moderately every day to stay healthy without feeling exhausted.
moderately.z: 她每天适度锻炼以保持健康，而不会感到筋疲力尽。

modernization.s: Rapid modernization has changed the way people live and work in many cities.
modernization.z: 快速的现代化改变了许多城市人们的生活和工作方式。

modernize.s: The company plans to modernize its old factories by installing new machines.
modernize.z: 公司计划通过安装新机器来实现旧工厂的现代化。

modest.s: She lives in a modest apartment near the campus and rarely spends money on luxury items.
modest.z: 她住在校园附近一套简朴的公寓里，很少花钱买奢侈品。

modesty.s: Her modesty prevented her from mentioning her own achievements during the interview.
modesty.z: 她的谦逊使她在面试中没有提及自己的成就。

modification.s: The engineer made a small modification to the design to improve safety.
modification.z: 工程师对设计做了一处小改动以提高安全性。

modify.s: The engineers had to modify the original design to reduce costs and improve safety.
modify.z: 工程师们不得不修改最初的设计，以降低成本并提高安全性。

modulate.s: Doctors can modulate the dose to reduce side effects for each patient.
modulate.z: 医生可以调节剂量以减轻每位患者的副作用。

module.s: Students can complete each module of the online course at their own pace.
module.z: 学生可以按照自己的节奏完成在线课程的每个模块。

moisture.s: The cream helps keep moisture in your skin during cold winter months.
moisture.z: 在寒冷的冬季，这款面霜有助于保持皮肤中的水分。

molecular.s: Scientists studied the molecular structure of the new drug before testing it on animals.
molecular.z: 科学家在动物身上测试这种新药之前，研究了它的分子结构。

molecule.s: A single molecule of water contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.z: 一个水分子包含两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

moment.s: She paused for a moment before answering the difficult question.
moment.z: 她停顿了片刻才回答那个难题。

momentary.s: She felt a momentary flash of doubt before signing the contract.
momentary.z: 在签署合同之前，她感到一阵短暂的疑虑。

momentum.s: The campaign gained momentum after several famous athletes supported it.
momentum.z: 在几位著名运动员支持之后，这项活动获得了发展势头。

monarch.s: The monarch ruled the country for over forty years with great wisdom.
monarch.z: 这位君主以非凡的智慧统治了这个国家四十多年。

monetary.s: The government offered monetary support to families affected by the flood.
monetary.z: 政府向受洪水影响的家庭提供了金钱援助。

monitor.s: Parents should monitor how much time their children spend on screens each day.
monitor.z: 父母应该监督孩子每天在屏幕上花费多少时间。

monk.s: The old monk spends every morning reading quietly in the temple garden.
monk.z: 那位老和尚每天早晨都在寺庙花园里安静地读书。

monopolize.s: The only grocery store in town tends to monopolize the local market and keep prices high.
monopolize.z: 镇上唯一的杂货店往往会垄断当地市场，并维持高价。

monopoly.s: The new regulations broke the company's monopoly on the local phone market.
monopoly.z: 新规定打破了该公司在当地电话市场上的垄断。

monster.s: As a child, he was afraid that a monster was hiding under his bed.
monster.z: 小时候，他害怕床底下藏着一只怪物。

monstrous.s: The new manager was shocked by the monstrous amount of paperwork left on his desk.
monstrous.z: 新经理被桌上留下的巨量文书工作吓了一跳。

month.s: She has been studying English for six months and can now read simple novels.
month.z: 她学英语已经六个月了，现在能读简单的小说。

monthly.s: She pays her rent monthly to avoid any late fees.
monthly.z: 她每月支付房租以避免产生滞纳金。

mood.s: The good news put everyone in the office in a cheerful mood.
mood.z: 这个好消息让办公室里的每个人都心情愉快。

moor.s: The small boat was tied safely to the moor near the quiet village.
moor.z: 小船被安全地系在安静村庄附近的停泊处。

moral.s: Teachers should help students develop strong moral values from an early age.
moral.z: 教师应当帮助学生从小学阶段就培养坚定的道德价值观。

morality.s: The novel raises serious questions about morality and the choices people make under pressure.
morality.z: 这部小说引发了关于道德以及人们在压力下所做选择的严肃思考。

moreover.s: The new library is well equipped; moreover, it stays open until midnight.
moreover.z: 新图书馆设备齐全；此外，它还开放到午夜。

mortality.s: Better medical care has greatly reduced infant mortality in many developing countries.
mortality.z: 更好的医疗护理大大降低了许多发展中国家的婴儿死亡率。

mortgage.s: They took out a mortgage to buy their first house in the city.
mortgage.z: 他们办理了抵押贷款，在城里买了第一套房子。

moslem.s: My neighbor is a Moslem who prays five times a day.
moslem.z: 我的邻居是一位每天祈祷五次的穆斯林。

mosque.s: The old mosque near the market attracts many visitors every Friday afternoon.
mosque.z: 市场附近那座古老的清真寺每周五下午都吸引许多游客。

moss.s: After the rain, thick green moss covered the old stone wall in the garden.
moss.z: 雨后，厚厚的绿色苔藓覆盖了花园里的旧石墙。

mostly.s: The students in this class are mostly from small towns and study hard every day.
mostly.z: 这个班的学生大多来自小城镇，每天都努力学习。

motel.s: We stayed at a cheap motel near the highway during our road trip.
motel.z: 我们在公路旅行期间住在高速公路附近的一家廉价汽车旅馆。

motion.s: The motion of the boat made several passengers feel sick.
motion.z: 船的晃动让几位乘客感到恶心。

motivate.s: Teachers should motivate students to ask questions instead of just memorizing answers.
motivate.z: 教师应该激励学生提问，而不是仅仅记住答案。

motivation.s: Without clear motivation, students often find it hard to finish their assignments on time.
motivation.z: 没有明确的动力，学生常常发现很难按时完成作业。

motive.s: The police could not find a clear motive for the attack.
motive.z: 警方无法找到这次袭击的明确动机。

mould.s: The damp walls were covered with black mould after the heavy rain.
mould.z: 大雨过后，潮湿的墙壁上长满了黑色的霉菌。

mountainous.s: The mountainous region makes it difficult to build new roads and railways.
mountainous.z: 多山的地区使得修建新的公路和铁路变得困难。

mournful.s: The mournful sound of the violin made everyone in the room fall silent.
mournful.z: 小提琴那悲伤的声音让房间里的每个人都安静了下来。

mouse.s: The little mouse quickly ran across the kitchen floor and hid behind the fridge.
mouse.z: 那只小老鼠迅速跑过厨房地板，躲到了冰箱后面。

mouthful.s: She took a big mouthful of soup and burned her tongue.
mouthful.z: 她喝了一大口汤，烫到了舌头。

move.s: We plan to move to a bigger apartment near the campus next month.
move.z: 我们计划下个月搬到校园附近一套更大的公寓。

movement.s: The slow movement of the clouds across the sky suggested that a storm was coming.
movement.z: 云朵在空中缓慢移动，预示着暴风雨即将来临。

muddy.s: After the heavy rain, the path to the library became muddy and slippery.
muddy.z: 大雨过后，通往图书馆的小路变得泥泞湿滑。

multicultural.s: Living in a multicultural city helps students understand and respect different traditions.
multicultural.z: 生活在一个多元文化的城市有助于学生理解和尊重不同的传统。

multiple.s: The report identifies multiple factors that contribute to climate change.
multiple.z: 该报告指出了导致气候变化的多个因素。

multiplication.s: Children usually learn multiplication tables before they start solving harder math problems.
multiplication.z: 孩子们通常在开始解决更难的数学题之前学习乘法表。

multiply.s: If you multiply the number of workers by their daily output, you get the total production.
multiply.z: 如果你把工人数量乘以他们的日产量，就能得到总产量。

murderer.s: The police finally caught the murderer after searching the neighborhood for three days.
murderer.z: 警方在附近搜寻了三天后，终于抓住了那名凶手。

murmur.s: She murmured a few words of comfort to the crying child.
murmur.z: 她低声对哭泣的孩子说了几句安慰的话。

muscular.s: Regular exercise keeps your heart healthy and your muscles strong and muscular.
muscular.z: 经常锻炼能让你的心脏保持健康，让你的肌肉强壮发达。

muse.s: She would often muse about the future while walking home from class.
muse.z: 她常常在放学走回家的路上思考未来。

musical.s: She has been taking musical lessons since she was five years old.
musical.z: 她从五岁起就一直在上音乐课。

musician.s: The young musician practiced the piano for hours before the concert.
musician.z: 这位年轻音乐家在音乐会前练习了几个小时的钢琴。

mustard.s: She added a little mustard to the sandwich for extra flavor.
mustard.z: 她往三明治里加了一点芥末以增加风味。

mute.s: Please press the mute button during the video call so we can hear the speaker clearly.
mute.z: 视频通话时请按下静音键，这样我们才能清楚地听到发言人的声音。

mutton.s: My grandmother cooked mutton with fresh vegetables for the family dinner.
mutton.z: 我奶奶为家庭晚餐做了羊肉配新鲜蔬菜。

mutual.s: A good friendship is always based on mutual trust and respect.
mutual.z: 良好的友谊总是建立在相互信任和尊重的基础上。

mutually.s: The two companies agreed to end their partnership mutually and without any conflict.
mutually.z: 两家公司同意在没有任何冲突的情况下双方共同终止合作。

mysterious.s: The old man told us a mysterious story about the house on the hill.
mysterious.z: 那位老人给我们讲了一个关于山上那座房子的神秘故事。

mysteriously.s: The old library door opened mysteriously during the night, frightening everyone inside.
mysteriously.z: 旧图书馆的门在夜里神秘地打开了，吓坏了里面的每一个人。

mystery.s: The detective spent years trying to solve the mystery behind the old house.
mystery.z: 侦探花了多年时间试图解开那所老房子背后的谜团。

myth.s: It is a common myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
myth.z: 认为我们只使用了大脑的百分之十是一个常见的错误观念。

narration.s: The documentary's calm narration made the complex history easy to follow.
narration.z: 这部纪录片平静的解说使复杂的历史变得容易理解。

narrative.s: The film's narrative follows a young teacher who changes a small village.
narrative.z: 这部电影的叙事讲述了一位改变小村庄的年轻教师。

narrow.s: The roads in the old town are too narrow for two cars to pass.
narrow.z: 老城区的道路太窄了，两辆车无法并排通过。

nasty.s: The medicine left a nasty taste in my mouth that lasted for hours.
nasty.z: 这药在我嘴里留下了一股难闻的味道，持续了好几个小时。

nation.s: The whole nation celebrated the victory with great joy and pride.
nation.z: 整个国家满怀喜悦和自豪地庆祝这场胜利。

national.s: The new policy aims to protect the national interests of every citizen.
national.z: 这项新政策旨在保护每一位公民的国家利益。

nationality.s: The form asks you to write your name, date of birth, and nationality.
nationality.z: 这张表格要求你填写姓名、出生日期和国籍。

native.s: She speaks English almost like a native after living abroad for ten years.
native.z: 在国外生活十年后，她的英语说得几乎像母语者一样。

natural.s: It is natural for students to feel nervous before a big exam.
natural.z: 学生在大型考试前感到紧张是很自然的。

naturally.s: She naturally became the leader of the group because of her confidence.
naturally.z: 由于她的自信，她自然而然地成为了团队的领导者。

nature.s: Spending time in nature helps students reduce stress and improve their mood.
nature.z: 在大自然中度过时光有助于学生减轻压力、改善情绪。

naval.s: The country spends a large part of its budget on naval defense each year.
naval.z: 这个国家每年将很大一部分预算用于海军防御。

navigation.s: Modern sailors rely on satellite navigation to find their way across the open sea.
navigation.z: 现代水手依靠卫星导航在广阔的海洋上找到方向。

nearly.s: She had nearly finished her essay when the power suddenly went out.
nearly.z: 她快要写完论文时，突然停电了。

necessarily.s: A higher price does not necessarily mean that the product is of better quality.
necessarily.z: 更高的价格并不一定意味着产品的质量更好。

necessitate.s: The heavy rain will necessitate changing the outdoor event to next week.
necessitate.z: 大雨将使得户外活动不得不改到下周举行。

necessity.s: Many students realize that regular exercise is a necessity for maintaining good health.
necessity.z: 许多学生意识到，定期锻炼是保持良好健康的必要之举。

needless.s: There is no needless waste of paper if everyone prints on both sides.
needless.z: 如果每个人都双面打印，就不会有不必要的纸张浪费。

needy.s: The charity provides free meals and warm clothes to needy families in the community.
needy.z: 这家慈善机构为社区里的贫困家庭提供免费餐食和保暖衣物。

negative.s: Staying up late every night has a negative effect on your health and grades.
negative.z: 每天晚上熬夜对你的健康和成绩都有负面影响。

neglect.s: Many students neglect their health while preparing for important exams.
neglect.z: 许多学生在准备重要考试时忽视了自己的健康。

negotiate.s: She learned to negotiate calmly with her manager about the deadline.
negotiate.z: 她学会了就截止日期与经理冷静协商。

negotiation.s: The two sides finally reached an agreement after hours of difficult negotiation.
negotiation.z: 经过数小时艰难的谈判，双方终于达成了协议。

negro.s: The word "Negro" is now considered outdated and offensive in modern English.
negro.z: “Negro”一词在现代英语中如今被认为过时且带有冒犯性。

neighborhood.s: The new café has become a popular gathering place for people in the neighborhood.
neighborhood.z: 这家新咖啡馆已成为附近居民喜爱的聚会场所。

neighbour.s: Our new neighbour often helps us carry heavy bags up the stairs.
neighbour.z: 我们的新邻居经常帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

neighbourhood.s: The children often play football with their friends in the neighbourhood park after school.
neighbourhood.z: 放学后，孩子们经常和朋友们在社区公园里踢足球。

neighbouring.s: The neighbouring families often share tools and help each other with small repairs.
neighbouring.z: 邻近的家庭经常共用工具，并在小修小补上互相帮助。

nerve.s: She took a deep breath to calm her nerves before the interview.
nerve.z: 面试前她深吸一口气让自己镇定下来。

nervous.s: She felt nervous before giving her first presentation to the class.
nervous.z: 她在向全班做第一次演讲之前感到紧张。

net.s: The fisherman pulled his heavy net onto the small boat at dawn.
net.z: 渔夫在黎明时分把他的重网拉上了小船。

network.s: She built a strong network of friends and colleagues during her first year at university.
network.z: 她在大学第一年建立了一个由朋友和同事组成的强大关系网。

neutral.s: The teacher tried to remain neutral while listening to both sides of the argument.
neutral.z: 老师在听取双方争论时尽量保持中立。

neutrality.s: The teacher reminded us to maintain neutrality when discussing controversial issues in class.
neutrality.z: 老师提醒我们在课堂上讨论有争议的问题时要保持中立。

neutron.s: A neutron has no electric charge and is found in the nucleus of an atom.
neutron.z: 中子不带电荷，存在于原子核中。

newly.s: The newly opened library offers students a quiet place to study.
newly.z: 新开放的图书馆为学生提供了一个安静的学习场所。

newsstand.s: She bought a newspaper at the small newsstand near the station every morning.
newsstand.z: 她每天早上都在车站附近的小报刊亭买一份报纸。

nickname.s: His friends gave him the nickname "Sunshine" because he always smiles.
nickname.z: 朋友们给他起了个绰号叫“阳光”，因为他总是面带微笑。

nightmare.s: I had a terrible nightmare last night and woke up sweating.
nightmare.z: 昨晚我做了一个可怕的噩梦，醒来时浑身是汗。

noble.s: Her noble decision to help the poor family impressed everyone in the small town.
noble.z: 她帮助那个贫困家庭的高尚决定给小城里的每个人留下了深刻印象。

noisy.s: The restaurant was so noisy that we could hardly hear each other.
noisy.z: 那家餐厅太吵了，我们几乎听不见彼此说话。

nonsense.s: Stop talking nonsense and start working on the project before the deadline.
nonsense.z: 别再说废话了，在截止日期前开始做这个项目吧。

norm.s: Working from home has become the norm for many office workers today.
norm.z: 如今，居家办公已成为许多上班族的常态。

normalization.s: The normalization of relations between the two sides took many years of patient talks.
normalization.z: 双方关系的正常化花了许多年耐心的谈判。

normally.s: I normally walk to class, but today I took the bus because it was raining.
normally.z: 我通常步行去上课，但今天因为下雨我坐了公交车。

northern.s: The northern part of the country is much colder than the south in winter.
northern.z: 该国北部地区冬天比南部冷得多。

notable.s: The report highlights several notable improvements in air quality over the past decade.
notable.z: 该报告强调了过去十年中空气质量方面几项显著的改善。

notably.s: The final exam was notably harder than the practice tests we had taken.
notably.z: 期末考试明显比我们做过的练习测试更难。

notation.s: The teacher explained the musical notation so clearly that every student could follow it.
notation.z: 老师把乐谱符号解释得非常清楚，每个学生都能看懂。

note.s: She left a short note on the table before leaving for work.
note.z: 她上班前在桌上留了一张简短的便条。

noted.s: She noted the key points from the lecture in her notebook.
noted.z: 她把讲座的要点记在了笔记本上。

noticeable.s: There was a noticeable improvement in her grades after she started studying every evening.
noticeable.z: 她开始每天晚上学习之后，成绩有了明显的提高。

notification.s: Students receive a notification on their phones when the exam results are posted online.
notification.z: 考试成绩在网上公布时，学生们会在手机上收到通知。

notion.s: She rejected the notion that success depends mainly on luck rather than hard work.
notion.z: 她否定了成功主要取决于运气而非努力这一观念。

notoriously.s: This city is notoriously crowded during the morning rush hour.
notoriously.z: 这座城市在早高峰时段以拥挤出名。

nought.s: All our careful planning came to nought when the storm destroyed the stage.
nought.z: 当暴风雨摧毁了舞台时，我们所有精心的筹划都化为泡影。

nourishment.s: Children need proper nourishment to grow strong and stay healthy.
nourishment.z: 孩子们需要适当的营养才能强壮成长并保持健康。

novel.s: She borrowed a novel from the library and finished it in two days.
novel.z: 她从图书馆借了一本小说，两天就读完了。

novelty.s: At first the novelty of online classes excited students, but soon they missed real classrooms.
novelty.z: 起初，网课的新鲜感让学生们很兴奋，但很快他们就开始怀念真实的教室了。

nowhere.s: After searching for hours, we were nowhere near finding the missing keys.
nowhere.z: 找了几个小时之后，我们离找到丢失的钥匙还差得远。

nuclear.s: The government is investing heavily in nuclear power to reduce carbon emissions.
nuclear.z: 政府正在大力投资核能以减少碳排放。

nucleus.s: The nucleus contains most of the cell's genetic material and controls its activities.
nucleus.z: 细胞核包含细胞的大部分遗传物质并控制其活动。

nuisance.s: The constant noise from the construction site has become a real nuisance to nearby residents.
nuisance.z: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音已经成为附近居民的一大困扰。

numerical.s: The researchers compared the numerical results from both experiments before drawing any conclusions.
numerical.z: 研究人员在得出结论之前比较了两个实验的数值结果。

nun.s: The nun teaches reading and writing to children in the small village school.
nun.z: 这位修女在小村庄的学校里教孩子们读书写字。

nursery.s: The little boy spends every morning at the nursery while his parents are at work.
nursery.z: 这个小男孩每天早上都在托儿所度过，而他的父母在上班。

nurture.s: Teachers should nurture students' curiosity rather than simply filling them with facts.
nurture.z: 教师应该培养学生的好奇心，而不是仅仅向他们灌输事实。

nut.s: She added a handful of nuts to the salad for extra crunch and flavor.
nut.z: 她在沙拉里加了一把坚果，以增加口感和风味。

nutrition.s: Good nutrition and regular exercise are essential for maintaining a healthy body.
nutrition.z: 良好的营养和规律的锻炼对于保持健康的身体至关重要。

nutritious.s: Eating a nutritious breakfast every morning helps students stay focused during their classes.
nutritious.z: 每天早上吃一顿有营养的早餐有助于学生在课堂上保持专注。

nylon.s: She packed a light nylon jacket because the weather forecast said it might rain.
nylon.z: 她带了一件轻便的尼龙夹克，因为天气预报说可能会下雨。

obedience.s: The dog's obedience surprised everyone when it followed every command without hesitation.
obedience.z: 这只狗的服从让所有人都感到惊讶，它毫不犹豫地执行了每一个命令。

obedient.s: The children were surprisingly obedient and followed every instruction their teacher gave them.
obedient.z: 孩子们出奇地听话，完全遵照老师给出的每一条指示。

obesity.s: Doctors warn that childhood obesity can lead to serious health problems later in life.
obesity.z: 医生警告说，儿童肥胖会在日后导致严重的健康问题。

obey.s: All students must obey the safety rules when working in the science laboratory.
obey.z: 所有学生在科学实验室操作时都必须遵守安全规则。

object.s: She strongly objected to the plan because it would cost too much money.
object.z: 她强烈反对这个计划，因为它会花费太多钱。

objection.s: The manager raised a strong objection to the new proposal during the meeting.
objection.z: 经理在会议上对这项新提案提出了强烈反对。

objective.s: The main objective of this study is to find a better way to teach vocabulary.
objective.z: 这项研究的主要目的是找到一种更好的词汇教学方法。

obligation.s: Every citizen has a legal obligation to pay taxes honestly and on time.
obligation.z: 每个公民都有诚实按时纳税的法律义务。

obscure.s: The professor's explanation was so obscure that few students understood his main point.
obscure.z: 教授的解释如此晦涩难懂，以至于很少有学生理解他的主要观点。

obscurity.s: After years of obscurity, the young writer finally published a novel that won wide praise.
obscurity.z: 在默默无闻多年之后，这位年轻作家终于出版了一部广受赞誉的小说。

observation.s: Her careful observation of the students helped her improve her teaching methods.
observation.z: 她对学生的仔细观察帮助她改进了教学方法。

observe.s: Scientists carefully observe the behavior of animals in their natural environment.
observe.z: 科学家们仔细观察动物在自然环境中的行为。

observer.s: The observer recorded every detail of the experiment in a small notebook.
observer.z: 观察者在一本小笔记本上记录了实验的每一个细节。

obstacle.s: Lack of confidence is often the biggest obstacle to learning a new language.
obstacle.z: 缺乏自信往往是学习一门新语言的最大障碍。

obstinate.s: My obstinate brother refused to change his plan despite everyone's advice.
obstinate.z: 我固执的哥哥不顾大家的建议，拒绝改变他的计划。

obtain.s: She worked hard to obtain a scholarship for her graduate studies abroad.
obtain.z: 她努力工作以获得出国读研的奖学金。

obvious.s: It was obvious from her smile that she had passed the difficult exam.
obvious.z: 从她的笑容可以明显看出，她通过了那场艰难的考试。

obviously.s: She was obviously nervous before the interview and kept checking her notes.
obviously.z: 面试前她显然很紧张，不停地查看笔记。

occasion.s: She bought a new dress for the special occasion.
occasion.z: 她为这个特殊的场合买了一条新裙子。

occasional.s: She makes occasional visits to her old friends in the countryside.
occasional.z: 她偶尔去乡下看望老朋友。

occasionally.s: She occasionally stays up late to finish her assignments before the deadline.
occasionally.z: 她偶尔会熬夜在截止日期前完成作业。

occupation.s: Her occupation as a nurse requires great patience and long hours.
occupation.z: 她作为护士的职业需要极大的耐心和漫长的工作时间。

occupy.s: Many students occupy their free time with part-time jobs to gain work experience.
occupy.z: 许多学生利用课余时间做兼职来积累工作经验。

occur.s: The accident occurred at the corner of the busy street early this morning.
occur.z: 事故今天清晨发生在繁忙街道的拐角处。

occurrence.s: The frequent occurrence of traffic jams makes commuting to work quite stressful.
occurrence.z: 交通拥堵的频繁发生使通勤上班变得相当有压力。

oceania.s: Many students hope to study the unique cultures of Oceania during their summer break.
oceania.z: 许多学生希望在暑假期间研究大洋洲独特的文化。

odd.s: It seemed odd that nobody noticed the broken window for three days.
odd.z: 似乎很奇怪，三天了都没有人注意到那扇破窗户。

odds.s: Despite the odds, she never gave up on her dream of becoming a doctor.
odds.z: 尽管困难重重，她从未放弃成为医生的梦想。

odour.s: A strange odour came from the kitchen, so we opened all the windows.
odour.z: 厨房里传来一股奇怪的气味，于是我们打开了所有的窗户。

of.s: She drank a cup of hot tea before starting her homework.
of.z: 她在开始做作业前喝了一杯热茶。

offence.s: He was warned that repeating the offence would lead to a serious punishment.
offence.z: 他被告知，再次犯下这一违法行为将导致严厉的惩罚。

offense.s: Driving after drinking is a serious offense that can lead to heavy fines.
offense.z: 酒后驾车是严重的违法行为，可能导致高额罚款。

offensive.s: His offensive remarks during the meeting made everyone feel uncomfortable and angry.
offensive.z: 他在会议上发表的冒犯性言论让每个人都感到不舒服和愤怒。

official.s: The official announced that the new policy would take effect next month.
official.z: 这位官员宣布新政策将于下个月生效。

oh.s: Oh, I completely forgot to bring my notebook to class today!
oh.z: 哦，我今天完全忘了带笔记本去上课！

ohm.s: The resistance of this wire is exactly one ohm, according to the meter.
ohm.z: 根据测量仪显示，这根导线的电阻正好是一欧姆。

oneself.s: Learning to rely on oneself is an important skill for college students.
oneself.z: 学会依靠自己是大学生的一项重要技能。

onto.s: She stepped onto the crowded platform just as the train doors began to close.
onto.z: 就在火车门开始关闭时，她踏上了拥挤的站台。

opening.s: The opening of the new library attracted hundreds of students and teachers.
opening.z: 新图书馆的开幕吸引了数百名师生。

opera.s: She fell in love with opera after her teacher played a famous recording in class.
opera.z: 老师在课堂上播放了一段著名的录音后，她就爱上了歌剧。

operate.s: The machine is easy to operate even for new employees.
operate.z: 这台机器即使是新员工也很容易操作。

operation.s: The hospital will begin its new operation next Monday morning.
operation.z: 这家医院将于下周一上午开始新的运营。

operational.s: The new booking system became fully operational after weeks of careful testing.
operational.z: 经过数周的仔细测试，新的预订系统全面投入运行。

operator.s: The operator answered the call quickly and connected me to the right department.
operator.z: 接线员迅速接听了电话，并把我转接到了正确的部门。

opinion.s: In my opinion, regular exercise is the best way to reduce stress.
opinion.z: 在我看来，规律锻炼是减轻压力的最佳方式。

opium.s: The history lesson explained how opium once caused serious social problems in the country.
opium.z: 历史课讲解了鸦片曾经在这个国家造成严重的社会问题。

opponent.s: She studied her opponent's moves carefully before the final match began.
opponent.z: 在决赛开始之前，她仔细研究了她对手的动作。

opportunity.s: Studying abroad gave her a valuable opportunity to experience a different culture.
opportunity.z: 出国留学给了她一个体验不同文化的宝贵机会。

oppose.s: Many students oppose the plan to raise tuition fees next year.
oppose.z: 许多学生反对明年提高学费的计划。

opposite.s: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from the library.
opposite.z: 银行在图书馆街对面的那一侧。

opposition.s: The new policy faced strong opposition from local residents who feared losing their homes.
opposition.z: 这项新政策遭到了当地居民的强烈反对，他们担心会失去自己的家园。

optical.s: The new optical instrument allows students to observe tiny cells clearly.
optical.z: 这台新的光学仪器让学生能够清晰地观察微小的细胞。

optimistic.s: Despite the bad weather, she remained optimistic about the trip.
optimistic.z: 尽管天气不好，她对这次旅行仍然保持乐观。

option.s: Students who study abroad have the option to work part-time during their holidays.
option.z: 出国留学的学生可以选择在假期做兼职工作。

optional.s: Taking this optional course can help you develop useful skills for the future.
optional.z: 选修这门可选课程能帮助你培养未来有用的技能。

oral.s: Students must pass an oral exam before they can graduate from the program.
oral.z: 学生必须通过口语考试才能从这个项目毕业。

orchard.s: The old farmer grows apples and pears in the orchard behind his house.
orchard.z: 那位老农在房子后面的果园里种植苹果和梨。

orchestra.s: The school orchestra will perform a famous symphony at the concert tonight.
orchestra.z: 学校管弦乐团将在今晚的音乐会上演奏一首著名的交响曲。

orderly.s: The students waited in an orderly line outside the dining hall.
orderly.z: 学生们在食堂外排着整齐有序的队伍等候。

ordinarily.s: She ordinarily walks to the office, but today she took the bus because of the rain.
ordinarily.z: 她通常步行去办公室，但今天因为下雨她坐了公交车。

organic.s: Many shoppers prefer organic vegetables because they believe these foods are safer and healthier.
organic.z: 许多购物者更喜欢有机蔬菜，因为他们认为这些食物更安全、更健康。

organism.s: Scientists discovered a tiny organism living deep in the ocean.
organism.z: 科学家发现了一种生活在深海中的微小生物。

organization.s: The organization holds a meeting every month to discuss its new plans.
organization.z: 该组织每月举行一次会议来讨论它的新计划。

oriental.s: She decorated her living room with oriental rugs and delicate silk curtains.
oriental.z: 她用东方地毯和精致的丝绸窗帘装饰客厅。

orientation.s: New students attend an orientation program to learn about campus life.
orientation.z: 新生参加入学介绍活动以了解校园生活。

origin.s: Scientists are still trying to discover the origin of the universe.
origin.z: 科学家们仍在努力探索宇宙的起源。

original.s: The original plan was too expensive, so we had to change it.
original.z: 最初的计划太贵了，所以我们不得不改变它。

originate.s: Many English words originate from Latin, so learning their roots can help you remember them.
originate.z: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语，因此学习它们的词根有助于记忆。

ornament.s: She placed a small glass ornament on the shelf beside the window.
ornament.z: 她把一个小玻璃装饰品放在窗边的架子上。

ornamental.s: The garden is filled with ornamental plants that add beauty but serve no practical purpose.
ornamental.z: 花园里满是观赏性植物，它们增添了美感，却没有实际用途。

ought.s: You ought to review your notes before the final exam.
ought.z: 你应该在期末考试前复习你的笔记。

outcome.s: The outcome of the experiment surprised everyone in the research team.
outcome.z: 实验的结果让研究团队中的每个人都感到惊讶。

outcry.s: The new tax on books caused a public outcry among local readers.
outcry.z: 对书籍征收的新税在当地读者中引发了公众的强烈抗议。

outdoors.s: Many students prefer to study outdoors when the weather is warm and sunny.
outdoors.z: 天气温暖晴朗时，许多学生更喜欢在户外学习。

outermost.s: The outermost layer of the atmosphere protects us from harmful radiation.
outermost.z: 大气层的最外层保护我们免受有害辐射的伤害。

outline.s: The professor asked us to write an outline before starting the research paper.
outline.z: 教授要求我们在开始写研究论文之前先写一个提纲。

outlive.s: Some old traditions can outlive the people who first created them.
outlive.z: 有些古老的传统会比最初创造它们的人存续得更久。

outnumber.s: In many large lectures, female students clearly outnumber male students in the classroom.
outnumber.z: 在许多大型讲座中，女生的人数明显超过课堂上的男生。

outperform.s: Studies show that students who sleep well tend to outperform those who stay up late.
outperform.z: 研究表明，睡眠充足的学生往往比熬夜的学生表现更出色。

outrage.s: Many people expressed outrage when the company raised prices during the crisis.
outrage.z: 当公司在危机期间提高价格时，许多人表达了愤怒。

outside.s: The children are playing outside in the garden while their parents prepare dinner.
outside.z: 孩子们正在外面的花园里玩耍，而他们的父母在准备晚饭。

outskirt.s: They bought a small house on the outskirt of the city to escape the noise.
outskirt.z: 他们在城市边缘买了一座小房子，以躲避噪音。

outsource.s: Many companies outsource their customer service to save money and focus on their main business.
outsource.z: 许多公司外包客户服务以节省资金并专注于主要业务。

outwards.s: The heavy metal door opens outwards, so please stand back while pushing it.
outwards.z: 这扇沉重的金属门是向外开的，所以推门时请往后退一点。

outweigh.s: The benefits of regular exercise far outweigh the risks of injury.
outweigh.z: 定期锻炼的好处远远超过受伤的风险。

overall.s: Overall, the students performed better this year than last year.
overall.z: 总体而言，学生们今年的表现比去年更好。

overcharge.s: The hotel overcharged us for breakfast, so we asked for a refund.
overcharge.z: 酒店多收了我们早餐费，所以我们要求退款。

overcome.s: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.z: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

overestimate.s: Many students overestimate how much they can memorize in one night before an exam.
overestimate.z: 许多学生高估了自己在考前一个晚上能记住多少内容。

overexcited.s: The children were so overexcited about the trip that they could hardly sleep.
overexcited.z: 孩子们对这次旅行太过兴奋，几乎睡不着觉。

overhang.s: A large tree branch overhangs the narrow path, so we have to duck.
overhang.z: 一根大树枝悬在狭窄的小路上方，我们不得不低头通过。

overhead.s: The overhead costs of running the factory have risen sharply this year.
overhead.z: 今年经营这家工厂的间接费用大幅上涨。

overlap.s: The two schedules overlap on Friday afternoon, so we need to choose one meeting.
overlap.z: 两个日程在周五下午有重叠，所以我们需要选择参加一个会议。

overload.s: Too much homework can overload students and make them feel stressed.
overload.z: 过多的家庭作业会让学生负担过重，使他们感到压力很大。

overlook.s: Students often overlook small mistakes when they check their answers too quickly.
overlook.z: 学生们检查答案太快时，常常忽视一些小错误。

overpass.s: Students often use the overpass to cross the busy road safely.
overpass.z: 学生们经常使用天桥安全地穿过繁忙的马路。

overseas.s: Many students hope to study overseas after finishing their degree at home.
overseas.z: 许多学生希望在国内完成学位后到海外留学。

overturn.s: The court decided to overturn the earlier ruling after new evidence emerged.
overturn.z: 在出现新证据后，法院决定推翻先前的裁决。

overweight.s: The doctor warned him that being overweight could lead to serious health problems later.
overweight.z: 医生警告他，体重超标可能会在以后引发严重的健康问题。

overwhelm.s: The heavy workload can overwhelm students who fail to manage their time well.
overwhelm.z: 繁重的工作量会让那些未能合理安排时间的学生不堪重负。

overwhelming.s: The support from her classmates was so overwhelming that she almost cried.
overwhelming.z: 同学们的支持如此热烈，以至于她差点哭了出来。

owing.s: Owing to the heavy rain, the outdoor concert was moved indoors.
owing.z: 由于大雨，户外音乐会改到了室内举行。

owner.s: The owner of the small bookstore knows almost every customer by name.
owner.z: 这家小书店的老板几乎能叫出每位顾客的名字。

ownership.s: The ownership of the land was transferred to the local community last year.
ownership.z: 这块土地的所有权去年被移交给了当地社区。

oxidize.s: When iron is exposed to moist air, it oxidizes and forms rust.
oxidize.z: 当铁暴露在潮湿的空气中时，它会氧化并形成铁锈。

oxygen.s: Plants release oxygen into the air during the process of photosynthesis.
oxygen.z: 植物在光合作用过程中将氧气释放到空气中。

oyster.s: She ordered a plate of fresh oysters and squeezed lemon juice over them.
oyster.z: 她点了一盘新鲜的生蚝，并挤上柠檬汁。

pace.s: She walked at a steady pace so everyone in the group could keep up.
pace.z: 她以平稳的步伐行走，这样队伍里的每个人都能跟得上。

pacific.s: The two nations finally reached a pacific settlement after months of tense negotiations.
pacific.z: 经过数月紧张的谈判，两国最终达成了和平的解决方案。

pack.s: We need to pack our bags tonight because the flight leaves early tomorrow morning.
pack.z: 我们今晚得收拾行李，因为明天一早的航班。

package.s: She carefully opened the package that had arrived from her grandmother.
package.z: 她小心地打开了从祖母那里寄来的包裹。

packet.s: She bought a packet of biscuits and shared it with her classmates.
packet.z: 她买了一包饼干，和同学们一起分享。

painful.s: It was painful to watch him struggle with the heavy boxes alone.
painful.z: 看着他一个人费力地搬那些沉重的箱子，真让人难受。

painter.s: The painter spent the whole afternoon mixing colors for the portrait.
painter.z: 这位画家花了一整个下午为这幅肖像画调色。

painting.s: She hung a beautiful painting of the sea above the fireplace in her living room.
painting.z: 她把一幅美丽的海景画挂在客厅的壁炉上方。

pal.s: She has been my closest pal since we started college together.
pal.z: 自从我们一起上大学以来，她一直是我最亲密的朋友。

panel.s: The panel of experts will discuss the new policy at the meeting today.
panel.z: 专家小组将在今天的会议上讨论这项新政策。

panic.s: She began to panic when she realized her passport was missing.
panic.z: 当她意识到护照不见了时，她开始惊慌失措。

panther.s: The black panther moved silently through the forest, watching every step of its prey.
panther.z: 黑豹悄无声息地穿过森林，注视着猎物的每一步。

pantry.s: She keeps extra rice and canned food in the small pantry next to the kitchen.
pantry.z: 她把多余的大米和罐头食品放在厨房旁边的小食品储藏室里。

parachute.s: The pilot told everyone to stay calm before opening the parachute.
parachute.z: 飞行员让大家在打开降落伞前保持冷静。

paradise.s: Many city workers dream of retiring to a quiet island paradise.
paradise.z: 许多城市上班族梦想着退休后去一个安静的岛屿天堂生活。

paradox.s: It is a paradox that the more we communicate online, the lonelier many people feel.
paradox.z: 一个悖论是，我们在网上交流得越多，许多人却感到越孤独。

paragraph.s: Please read the first paragraph carefully before you answer the questions.
paragraph.z: 请在回答问题之前仔细阅读第一段。

parallel.s: The two roads run parallel to each other for several miles before meeting at the bridge.
parallel.z: 这两条路彼此平行延伸了好几英里，然后在桥边汇合。

paralyse.s: The sudden power failure paralysed the entire subway system during rush hour.
paralyse.z: 突如其来的停电在高峰时段使整个地铁系统陷入瘫痪。

paralysis.s: The sudden paralysis of the city's transport system left thousands of commuters stranded on the roads.
paralysis.z: 城市交通系统的突然瘫痪让数千名通勤者被困在路上。

park.s: We decided to park the car near the library before the lecture started.
park.z: 我们决定在讲座开始前把车停在图书馆附近。

parliament.s: The new law was finally passed by parliament after months of heated debate.
parliament.z: 经过数月激烈辩论，这项新法律最终由议会通过。

partial.s: The teacher gave us only a partial explanation, so we still felt confused.
partial.z: 老师只给了我们部分的解释，所以我们仍然感到困惑。

participant.s: Every participant in the study received a small gift for completing the survey.
participant.z: 研究中的每位参与者都因完成调查而获得了一份小礼物。

particular.s: She is very particular about the food she eats and always checks the ingredients carefully.
particular.z: 她对吃的食物非常讲究，总是仔细查看配料。

particularly.s: She is particularly good at solving difficult math problems quickly.
particularly.z: 她特别擅长快速解决困难的数学题。

partly.s: The project failed partly because the team had too little time to prepare.
partly.z: 这个项目失败的部分原因是团队准备的时间太少。

partner.s: She asked her partner to help her move the heavy furniture into the new apartment.
partner.z: 她请她的伴侣帮她把沉重的家具搬进新公寓。

passenger.s: The passenger sitting next to me asked if I could open the window.
passenger.z: 坐在我旁边的乘客问我能不能把窗户打开。

passion.s: Her passion for teaching inspired many students to work harder.
passion.z: 她对教学的热情激励了许多学生更加努力学习。

passionate.s: She is passionate about protecting the environment and often joins local clean-up activities.
passionate.z: 她对保护环境充满热情，经常参加当地的清洁活动。

passive.s: He remained passive during the meeting and let others make all the decisions.
passive.z: 他在会议上保持被动，让其他人做出所有决定。

passively.s: She sat passively in the meeting and never shared her ideas with the team.
passively.z: 她在会议上被动地坐着，从未与团队分享自己的想法。

pasture.s: The farmer led his sheep to a green pasture near the river.
pasture.z: 农民把羊群带到河边一片绿色的牧场上。

patent.s: The company applied for a patent to protect its new design from being copied.
patent.z: 该公司申请了一项专利，以保护其新设计不被抄袭。

paternity.s: He took a paternity test to confirm that the child was really his.
paternity.z: 他做了亲子鉴定，以确认那个孩子真的是他的。

path.s: She followed a narrow path through the forest to reach the lake.
path.z: 她沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过森林到达湖边。

patience.s: Learning a new language requires patience and daily practice.
patience.z: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和每日练习。

patiently.s: She patiently explained the difficult grammar rules to her classmates after class.
patiently.z: 下课后，她耐心地向同学们解释了那些难懂的语法规则。

patriotic.s: Many young people feel deeply patriotic when they watch the national flag rise on important holidays.
patriotic.z: 许多年轻人在重要节日观看升国旗时会感到深深的爱国之情。

patrol.s: Security guards patrol the campus every night to keep students safe.
patrol.z: 保安每晚在校园巡逻，以保障学生的安全。

pattern.s: Scientists have discovered a clear pattern in the way these animals migrate each year.
pattern.z: 科学家们发现这些动物每年迁徙的方式存在明显的规律。

pause.s: She paused for a moment before answering the difficult question.
pause.z: 她在回答那个难题之前停顿了片刻。

pave.s: The city plans to pave the old road before winter arrives.
pave.z: 市政府计划在冬天到来之前把这条旧路铺好。

payment.s: She made the final payment on her new laptop last week.
payment.z: 她上周付清了新笔记本电脑的最后一笔款项。

peaceful.s: We spent a peaceful afternoon reading in the quiet garden.
peaceful.z: 我们在安静的园子里看书，度过了一个平静的下午。

peacock.s: The peacock spread its colorful tail feathers to attract a mate.
peacock.z: 孔雀展开色彩斑斓的尾羽来吸引配偶。

peak.s: Traffic reaches its peak during rush hour, so try to leave earlier.
peak.z: 交通在高峰时段达到顶峰，所以尽量早点出发。

peculiar.s: There is a peculiar smell coming from the old basement.
peculiar.z: 从旧地下室里传来一股奇怪的气味。

peculiarity.s: One peculiarity of this old house is its narrow staircase.
peculiarity.z: 这座老房子的一处奇特之处是它的楼梯很窄。

pedlar.s: The pedlar carried a heavy bag of goods from door to door in the village.
pedlar.z: 那个小贩背着沉重的一袋货物在村子里挨家挨户地走。

peer.s: She felt nervous when her peers asked her to present the group project.
peer.z: 当同龄人让她展示小组项目时，她感到很紧张。

pen.s: Please lend me a pen so I can sign this form.
pen.z: 请借我一支笔，好让我在这张表格上签字。

penalty.s: Drivers who ignore traffic rules may face a heavy penalty.
penalty.z: 无视交通规则的司机可能会面临重罚。

penetration.s: The penetration of smartphones into rural areas has changed how people shop.
penetration.z: 智能手机在农村地区的普及改变了人们的购物方式。

penny.s: He saved every penny he earned to buy his mother a birthday gift.
penny.z: 他把挣来的每一分钱都攒下来，给母亲买生日礼物。

pension.s: After retiring, she depends on a small pension to cover her daily living costs.
pension.z: 退休后，她依靠一笔微薄的养老金来支付日常生活开销。

per.s: The price of the tickets is twenty dollars per person.
per.z: 门票价格是每人二十美元。

perceive.s: Many students perceive the exam as a threat rather than a challenge.
perceive.z: 许多学生把考试视为威胁而不是挑战。

percent.s: Nearly sixty percent of the students said they preferred studying in the library.
percent.z: 近百分之六十的学生表示他们更喜欢在图书馆学习。

percentage.s: A large percentage of students spend more than two hours on their phones every day.
percentage.z: 很大比例的学生每天花两个多小时玩手机。

perception.s: Her perception of the problem changed after she read the report.
perception.z: 她读了那份报告后，对这个问题的看法改变了。

perfect.s: After months of practice, her pronunciation of English sounds almost perfect.
perfect.z: 经过几个月的练习，她的英语发音听起来几乎完美。

perfection.s: She practiced the piano piece every day, but achieving perfection seemed impossible.
perfection.z: 她每天练习那首钢琴曲，但要做到完美似乎是不可能的。

perform.s: The students will perform a short play at the school meeting tomorrow.
perform.z: 学生们明天将在学校会议上表演一个短剧。

performance.s: The audience praised her performance in the school play last night.
performance.z: 观众们称赞了她昨晚在学校戏剧中的表演。

perimeter.s: The guards walked around the perimeter of the building to check for any damage.
perimeter.z: 警卫们沿着大楼的周边走了一圈，检查是否有任何损坏。

period.s: She studied hard for a long period before taking the final exam.
period.z: 她在参加期末考试前努力学习了很长一段时间。

periodic.s: The doctor recommends periodic checkups to catch any health problems early.
periodic.z: 医生建议定期体检，以便及早发现任何健康问题。

periodical.s: She visits the library every week to read the latest periodicals on science.
periodical.z: 她每周都去图书馆阅读最新的科学期刊。

peripheral.s: Smartphones have become peripheral to my daily life since I started using a laptop.
peripheral.z: 自从我开始使用笔记本电脑以来，智能手机在我的日常生活中已变得次要。

permanent.s: The accident left him with a permanent scar on his left arm.
permanent.z: 那场事故在他的左臂上留下了一道永久的疤痕。

permissible.s: It is not permissible to use your phone during the exam.
permissible.z: 考试期间不允许使用手机。

permission.s: You need to ask your teacher for permission before leaving the classroom early.
permission.z: 提前离开教室之前，你需要征得老师的许可。

permit.s: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.z: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

perpendicular.s: The two walls meet at a right angle, so they are perfectly perpendicular to each other.
perpendicular.z: 这两面墙以直角相交，因此它们彼此完全垂直。

perpetual.s: The mountain village seems to live under a perpetual blanket of mist and quiet.
perpetual.z: 这个山村似乎永远笼罩在薄雾与宁静之中。

persist.s: She decided to persist in her research despite the many difficulties she faced.
persist.z: 尽管面临许多困难，她仍决定坚持自己的研究。

persistence.s: Her persistence in practicing speaking English every day finally paid off.
persistence.z: 她每天坚持练习说英语，最终得到了回报。

persistent.s: Her persistent efforts to improve her speaking skills finally paid off.
persistent.z: 她为提高口语水平而付出的坚持不懈的努力最终得到了回报。

personal.s: She keeps her personal opinions out of the discussion to stay fair.
personal.z: 为了保持公平，她不把个人观点带入讨论中。

personality.s: Her warm personality makes her popular among classmates and teachers.
personality.z: 她热情的性格使她在同学和老师中很受欢迎。

personnel.s: All new personnel must attend a safety training session before starting work.
personnel.z: 所有新员工在开始工作前都必须参加安全培训。

perspective.s: Traveling abroad gave her a fresh perspective on her own culture.
perspective.z: 出国旅行让她对自己的文化有了全新的视角。

persuade.s: She tried to persuade her roommate to join the study group before the exam.
persuade.z: 她试图说服室友在考试前加入学习小组。

persuasion.s: Her calm persuasion finally convinced the committee to change its original plan.
persuasion.z: 她冷静的劝说最终说服委员会改变了原来的计划。

persuasive.s: Her persuasive speech convinced most students to join the volunteer program.
persuasive.z: 她极具说服力的演讲说服了大多数学生加入志愿者项目。

pertinent.s: The professor asked several pertinent questions about the data before accepting our conclusion.
pertinent.z: 教授在接受我们的结论之前，就数据提出了几个相关问题。

pessimist.s: Even a pessimist like him smiled when the team finally won the game.
pessimist.z: 就连他这样一个悲观主义者，在球队终于赢得比赛时也露出了笑容。

pessimistic.s: She felt pessimistic about finding a job after graduation because of the weak economy.
pessimistic.z: 由于经济不景气，她对毕业后找到工作感到悲观。

petrol.s: The price of petrol has risen sharply, so many families now drive less.
petrol.z: 汽油价格大幅上涨，因此许多家庭现在开车更少了。

phase.s: The project will move into a new phase once the design is approved.
phase.z: 一旦设计获得批准，这个项目将进入一个新阶段。

phenomenon.s: Scientists are still trying to explain this strange natural phenomenon.
phenomenon.z: 科学家们仍在努力解释这一奇怪的自然现象。

philosopher.s: The philosopher spent years questioning what it truly means to live a good life.
philosopher.z: 这位哲学家花了多年时间探讨过上好日子究竟意味着什么。

philosophy.s: Her philosophy of life is to stay curious and keep learning every day.
philosophy.z: 她的人生哲学是保持好奇，每天不断学习。

phone.s: She forgot her phone at home and had to borrow a classmate's to call her parents.
phone.z: 她把手机忘在家里了，只好借同学的手机给父母打电话。

photoelectric.z: 光电效应解释了为什么某些金属在光照下会释放电子。

photograph.s: She keeps a photograph of her family on the desk while studying abroad.
photograph.z: 她在国外留学时把一张家人的照片放在书桌上。

photography.s: She took up photography as a hobby after buying her first camera.
photography.z: 她买了第一台相机后，就把摄影当作爱好。

phrase.s: She learned a useful phrase from her teacher and used it in the conversation.
phrase.z: 她从老师那里学到了一个有用的短语，并在对话中使用了它。

physical.s: Regular physical exercise helps students stay healthy and focused during long study hours.
physical.z: 规律的体育锻炼有助于学生在长时间学习期间保持健康和专注。

physically.s: Regular exercise keeps both your body and mind physically healthy.
physically.z: 经常锻炼能让你的身心都保持健康。

physician.s: The physician advised him to exercise regularly and reduce his salt intake.
physician.z: 医生建议他定期锻炼并减少盐的摄入。

physicist.s: The young physicist explained the difficult idea in a simple way.
physicist.z: 那位年轻的物理学家用简单的方式解释了这个难懂的概念。

pickle.s: She learned to pickle fresh vegetables so they could be stored through the winter.
pickle.z: 她学会了腌制新鲜蔬菜，以便能储存过冬。

picky.s: My roommate is so picky about food that he refuses to eat anything with onions in it.
picky.z: 我的室友对食物太挑剔了，只要有洋葱他就不吃。

picture.s: She hung a picture of her family on the living room wall.
picture.z: 她把一张全家福挂在了客厅的墙上。

piece.s: She cut the cake into eight equal pieces and gave one to each child.
piece.z: 她把蛋糕切成八等份，给每个孩子分了一块。

pier.s: We walked along the pier and watched the fishing boats return to the harbor.
pier.z: 我们沿着码头散步，看着渔船返回港口。

pile.s: She piled the dirty dishes in the sink after the party.
pile.z: 聚会结束后，她把脏盘子堆在水槽里。

pilgrim.s: Every year thousands of pilgrims travel long distances to visit the ancient temple.
pilgrim.z: 每年都有成千上万的朝圣者长途跋涉去参观这座古庙。

pineapple.s: She added fresh pineapple to the fruit salad and it tasted much sweeter.
pineapple.z: 她在水果沙拉里加了新鲜菠萝，味道甜多了。

pink.s: She wore a pink dress to the party and everyone complimented her on it.
pink.z: 她穿了一条粉色的连衣裙去参加聚会，大家都称赞她。

pioneer.s: She was a pioneer in the field of renewable energy research.
pioneer.z: 她是可再生能源研究领域的先驱。

pious.s: She remained pious throughout her life, attending church every Sunday without fail.
pious.z: 她一生都很虔诚，每个星期天都去教堂，从未间断。

pipe.s: The old water pipe burst last night and flooded the entire basement.
pipe.z: 昨晚旧水管破裂，淹没了整个地下室。

piston.s: The mechanic explained how the piston moves up and down inside the engine cylinder.
piston.z: 机械师解释了活塞如何在发动机气缸内上下运动。

planet.s: Scientists are searching for another planet that might support human life.
planet.z: 科学家们正在寻找另一颗可能支持人类生命的行星。

planetary.s: Scientists warn that planetary warming will cause serious problems for coastal cities.
planetary.z: 科学家警告说，全球变暖将给沿海城市带来严重问题。

plantation.s: The old plantation covered hundreds of acres and produced cotton for many years.
plantation.z: 这座古老的种植园占地数百英亩，多年来一直生产棉花。

plaster.s: The doctor cleaned the small wound and covered it with a piece of plaster.
plaster.z: 医生清理了那个小伤口，并用一块创可贴把它盖住了。

plastic.s: Many countries have banned plastic bags to protect the environment.
plastic.z: 许多国家已经禁止使用塑料袋以保护环境。

plate.s: She put the fresh fruit on a clean plate and carried it to the table.
plate.z: 她把新鲜水果放在一个干净的盘子上，然后端到了桌子上。

platform.s: The new online platform allows students to share their study materials easily.
platform.z: 这个新的在线平台让学生能够轻松分享学习资料。

plausible.s: Her explanation sounded plausible, but the evidence did not support it.
plausible.z: 她的解释听起来似乎有理，但证据并不支持。

player.s: The coach praised every player for their hard work during the match.
player.z: 教练表扬了每位球员在比赛中的努力。

plead.s: She began to plead with her manager for more time to finish the report.
plead.z: 她开始恳求经理多给她一些时间来完成报告。

pleasant.s: We had a pleasant afternoon walking along the river and talking about our plans.
pleasant.z: 我们沿着河边散步、谈论我们的计划，度过了一个愉快的下午。

pleasure.s: She finds great pleasure in reading novels after a long day at work.
pleasure.z: 她在漫长的一天工作后，从读小说中获得极大的乐趣。

pledge.s: The company pledged to reduce its carbon emissions by half within the next ten years.
pledge.z: 该公司承诺在未来十年内将碳排放量减少一半。

plentiful.s: Fresh fruit and vegetables are plentiful in local markets during the summer months.
plentiful.z: 夏季当地市场上新鲜水果和蔬菜供应充足。

plot.s: The detective uncovered a clever plot to steal the company's secret files.
plot.z: 侦探发现了一个窃取公司机密文件的巧妙阴谋。

pluck.s: She plucked a ripe apple from the tree and shared it with her friend.
pluck.z: 她从树上摘下一个熟苹果，和她的朋友一起分享。

plug.s: She forgot to plug in her laptop, so the battery died during the meeting.
plug.z: 她忘了给笔记本电脑插上电源，所以会议期间电池没电了。

plump.s: The plump oranges on the kitchen table looked sweet and ready to eat.
plump.z: 厨房桌子上那些圆润饱满的橙子看起来又甜又诱人。

plunder.s: The soldiers were ordered not to plunder the villages they passed through.
plunder.z: 士兵们被命令不得掠夺他们经过的村庄。

pluralism.s: The university encourages cultural pluralism by welcoming students from many different backgrounds.
pluralism.z: 这所大学通过欢迎来自不同背景的学生来鼓励文化多元化。

pneumatic.z: 机械师用气动钻松开了车轮上生锈的螺栓。

poet.z: 这位年轻的诗人经常在当地咖啡馆里向朋友们大声朗读他的新诗。

poetry.s: She reads poetry every evening to relax after a long day of classes.
poetry.z: 她每天晚上读诗，以在一天的课程后放松。

pointless.s: Arguing with him about the schedule is pointless because he never changes his mind.
pointless.z: 和他争论日程安排毫无意义，因为他从不改变主意。

poisonous.z: 有些野生蘑菇看起来无害，实际上却有毒，能致人死亡。

polar.s: The polar ice caps are melting faster than scientists expected.
polar.z: 极地冰盖正在以比科学家预期更快的速度融化。

polarity.s: The debate revealed a growing polarity between urban and rural opinions on the issue.
polarity.z: 这场辩论显示出城乡之间在该问题上的观点日益两极分化。

policeman.s: The policeman helped the lost child find his parents near the busy station.
policeman.z: 警察帮助那个迷路的孩子在繁忙的车站附近找到了他的父母。

policy.s: The new company policy allows employees to work from home twice a week.
policy.z: 公司的新政策允许员工每周在家工作两次。

political.s: Many students avoid political discussions during family dinners to keep the peace.
political.z: 许多学生在家庭聚餐时避免谈论政治话题，以保持和睦。

politician.s: The politician promised to improve public health care during the election campaign.
politician.z: 这位政治家在竞选期间承诺改善公共医疗保健。

politics.s: She decided to study politics because she wants to understand how governments make decisions.
politics.z: 她决定学习政治学，因为她想了解政府是如何做决策的。

poll.s: A recent poll shows that most students prefer studying in the library rather than in their dorms.
poll.z: 最近的一项民意调查显示，大多数学生更喜欢在图书馆学习，而不是在宿舍里。

pollutant.s: Air pollution from vehicles releases harmful pollutants that damage our health.
pollutant.z: 车辆造成的空气污染会释放有害污染物，损害我们的健康。

pollution.s: Air pollution in big cities is causing serious health problems for many people.
pollution.z: 大城市的空气污染正给许多人带来严重的健康问题。

polymer.s: This lightweight polymer is widely used in packaging because it is cheap and durable.
polymer.z: 这种轻质聚合物因廉价耐用而被广泛用于包装。

pope.s: The pope greeted the crowd from the balcony and offered a brief blessing.
pope.z: 教皇在阳台上向人群致意，并给予了简短的祝福。

popularity.s: The popularity of online courses has grown rapidly among college students in recent years.
popularity.z: 近年来，在线课程在大学生中迅速流行起来。

popularize.s: Schools should popularize basic computer skills among all students.
popularize.z: 学校应该在所有学生中普及基本的计算机技能。

population.s: The city's population has grown rapidly over the past ten years.
population.z: 这座城市的人口在过去十年里迅速增长。

pore.s: She spends hours studying the details of the contract until every pore of it is clear to her.
pore.z: 她花了好几个小时研究合同的细节，直到每个细节都对她清清楚楚。

pork.s: My mother cooked pork with vegetables for dinner last night.
pork.z: 我妈妈昨晚做了猪肉炒蔬菜当晚餐。

portable.s: This portable speaker is small enough to fit in your backpack.
portable.z: 这个便携式音箱小到可以放进你的背包里。

porter.s: The porter helped us carry our heavy luggage up to the hotel room.
porter.z: 行李员帮我们把沉重的行李搬到了酒店房间。

portion.s: She spends a large portion of her income on rent and food.
portion.z: 她把收入的很大一部分花在房租和食物上。

portrait.s: She hung a portrait of her grandmother above the fireplace in the living room.
portrait.z: 她在客厅的壁炉上方挂了一幅祖母的画像。

portray.s: The novel portrays life in a small village during the war.
portray.z: 这部小说描绘了战争期间一个小村庄的生活。

pose.s: The heavy rain posed a serious threat to the crops in the valley.
pose.z: 这场大雨对山谷里的庄稼构成了严重威胁。

position.s: She applied for a position as a research assistant at the university.
position.z: 她申请了那所大学研究助理的职位。

positive.s: She stayed positive even when the project faced serious problems.
positive.z: 即使项目面临严重问题，她仍然保持积极。

positively.s: Regular exercise can positively affect both your mood and your overall health.
positively.z: 经常锻炼可以对你的情绪和整体健康产生积极的影响。

possession.s: Her most valuable possession is the old watch her grandfather gave her.
possession.z: 她最珍贵的财产是祖父送给她的那块旧手表。

possibility.s: There is a strong possibility that the meeting will be postponed until next week.
possibility.z: 会议很有可能推迟到下周举行。

possibly.s: The flight may possibly be delayed because of the heavy snow tonight.
possibly.z: 由于今晚的大雪，航班可能会延误。

post.s: She posted the photos online before leaving for the airport.
post.z: 她在去机场之前把照片发到了网上。

postage.s: The postage for sending this heavy package overseas is surprisingly expensive.
postage.z: 把这个重包裹寄往海外的邮费贵得令人意外。

postal.s: The postal service delivers letters and packages to every household in the country.
postal.z: 邮政服务将信件和包裹递送到全国的每一户人家。

postdoctoral.s: After finishing her PhD, she began a postdoctoral position at a research institute in the city.
postdoctoral.z: 取得博士学位后，她在城市的一家研究所开始了博士后岗位的工作。

postgraduate.s: She decided to continue her studies as a postgraduate after finishing her degree.
postgraduate.z: 完成学位后，她决定作为一名研究生继续深造。

postman.s: The postman delivers letters and packages to our neighborhood every morning.
postman.z: 邮递员每天早上把信件和包裹送到我们社区。

postpone.s: Heavy rain forced the school to postpone the outdoor sports meeting until next Friday.
postpone.z: 大雨迫使学校将户外运动会推迟到下周五。

postulate.s: Scientists postulate that the universe began with a massive explosion.
postulate.z: 科学家们假设宇宙始于一次巨大的爆炸。

posture.s: Sitting with poor posture for hours can cause serious back pain.
posture.z: 长时间保持不良坐姿会导致严重的背痛。

potential.s: The new manager quickly recognized the potential of his young team.
potential.z: 新经理很快认可了他年轻团队的潜力。

potentially.s: Missing the deadline could potentially delay the entire project by several weeks.
potentially.z: 错过截止日期可能会使整个项目延迟数周。

poverty.s: Many families still struggle with poverty despite the country's rapid economic growth.
poverty.z: 尽管国家经济快速发展，许多家庭仍在与贫困作斗争。

power.s: The new manager has the power to change the whole team's working style.
power.z: 新经理有权改变整个团队的工作方式。

powerful.s: The new evidence proved so powerful that the jury changed its decision.
powerful.z: 新证据如此有力，以至于陪审团改变了决定。

practicable.s: It is not practicable to finish the whole report in one afternoon.
practicable.z: 在一个下午完成整份报告是不切实际的。

practical.s: Taking a practical approach to studying saves time and reduces stress before exams.
practical.z: 采取实用的学习方法可以节省时间并减轻考试前的压力。

practically.s: The new subway line makes it practically impossible to get lost downtown.
practically.z: 新开通的地铁线路使人在市中心几乎不可能迷路。

practice.s: Regular practice is the key to improving your spoken English.
practice.z: 经常练习是提高英语口语的关键。

practise.s: She practises speaking English with her roommate for an hour every evening.
practise.z: 她每天晚上和室友练习说英语一个小时。

pragmatic.s: She took a pragmatic approach to the problem instead of worrying about who was to blame.
pragmatic.z: 她采取务实的方法处理这个问题，而不是纠结于该怪谁。

prairie.s: Wild horses once roamed freely across the vast prairie, feeding on tall grasses.
prairie.z: 野马曾经在这片辽阔的大草原上自由驰骋，以高高的青草为食。

pray.s: Every night before bed, she prays for the health of her family.
pray.z: 每天晚上睡觉前，她都祈祷家人健康。

prayer.s: She said a quiet prayer before the difficult exam began.
prayer.z: 在艰难的考试开始前，她默默地祈祷了一番。

precede.s: The heavy rain was preceded by a strong wind that lasted all night.
precede.z: 那场大雨之前刮了一整夜的强风。

precedent.s: The court's decision set a legal precedent that many lawyers now cite.
precedent.z: 法院的判决开创了一个法律先例，如今许多律师都会援引它。

preceding.s: The preceding chapter explains the basic terms that students need for this course.
preceding.z: 前一章讲解了学生在本课程中需要的基本术语。

precipitate.s: The sudden drop in temperature may precipitate a sharp rise in energy demand.
precipitate.z: 气温骤降可能会促使能源需求急剧上升。

precision.s: The surgeon performed the operation with remarkable precision, leaving almost no visible scar.
precision.z: 这位外科医生以惊人的精确度完成了手术，几乎没有留下可见的疤痕。

preclude.s: Heavy rain may preclude us from holding the outdoor ceremony tomorrow.
preclude.z: 大雨可能会使我们无法在明天举行户外仪式。

predecessor.s: The new manager changed several rules that her predecessor had introduced.
predecessor.z: 新经理改变了她的前任所引入的几条规则。

predestine.s: Her early training seemed to predestine her for a career in music.
predestine.z: 她早年的训练似乎注定她将从事音乐事业。

predict.s: Scientists cannot predict exactly when the next earthquake will happen.
predict.z: 科学家无法准确预测下一次地震何时发生。

predictable.s: The train schedule is so predictable that I never worry about being late.
predictable.z: 火车时刻表非常可预测，我从不用担心迟到。

prediction.s: Her prediction about the exam results turned out to be surprisingly accurate.
prediction.z: 她对考试结果的预测出奇地准确。

predominant.s: In this region, agriculture remains the predominant source of income for most families.
predominant.z: 在该地区，农业仍然是大多数家庭的主要收入来源。

predominantly.s: The students in this major are predominantly female, though the number of men is rising.
predominantly.z: 这个专业的学生以女生为主，尽管男生人数正在增加。

preface.s: In the preface, the author explains why he wrote this book.
preface.z: 在序言中，作者解释了他写这本书的原因。

prefer.s: Most students prefer studying in the library because it is quiet and comfortable.
prefer.z: 大多数学生更喜欢在图书馆学习，因为那里安静又舒适。

preferable.s: Taking the train is often preferable to driving during the busy holiday season.
preferable.z: 在繁忙的假期期间，乘火车通常比开车更可取。

preference.s: She has a strong preference for reading paper books rather than e-books.
preference.z: 她非常偏爱读纸质书而不是电子书。

preferentially.s: During the experiment, the researchers preferentially selected the healthiest plants for further observation.
preferentially.z: 在实验中，研究人员优先挑选了最健康的植物进行进一步观察。

pregnancy.s: She had to give up her job during her pregnancy because of health problems.
pregnancy.z: 由于健康问题，她在怀孕期间不得不辞去工作。

pregnant.s: She was pregnant with her second child when she moved to a new city.
pregnant.z: 她搬到新城市时正怀着第二个孩子。

preindustrial.s: Before the preindustrial era, most families grew their own food and made their own clothes.
preindustrial.z: 在前工业化时代之前，大多数家庭自己种植食物并缝制衣服。

prejudice.s: Reading widely helps students overcome prejudice and understand people from different backgrounds.
prejudice.z: 广泛阅读有助于学生克服偏见，理解来自不同背景的人。

preliminary.s: The researchers presented their preliminary findings at the conference before the final report was published.
preliminary.z: 研究人员在最终报告发表之前，在会议上展示了他们的初步研究结果。

prematurely.s: The researchers warned that publishing the results prematurely could damage their reputation.
prematurely.z: 研究人员警告说，过早发表研究结果可能会损害他们的声誉。

premise.s: The whole argument rests on the premise that people act rationally.
premise.z: 整个论点建立在人们会理性行事这一前提之上。

preparation.s: Careful preparation before the exam helps students feel much more confident.
preparation.z: 考试前的认真准备能帮助学生感到更加自信。

preparatory.s: She took a preparatory course before starting her graduate studies abroad.
preparatory.z: 她在出国读研之前参加了一门预备课程。

prescient.s: Her prescient warning about the market crash saved the company from serious losses.
prescient.z: 她对市场崩盘的先见之明使公司免受了严重损失。

prescription.s: The doctor wrote a prescription for some medicine to help with my cough.
prescription.z: 医生开了一张药方，用来治疗我的咳嗽。

presence.s: Her calm presence made everyone feel relaxed during the difficult meeting.
presence.z: 在艰难的会议中，她镇定的存在让每个人都感到放松。

present.s: She was present at the meeting despite feeling unwell that morning.
present.z: 尽管那天早上她感到不舒服，她还是出席了会议。

presentation.s: She gave a clear presentation about climate change to the whole class.
presentation.z: 她向全班做了一个关于气候变化的清晰报告。

presently.s: She is presently working on a research project at the university.
presently.z: 她目前正在大学里做一个研究项目。

preservation.s: The preservation of historic buildings requires careful planning and strong public support.
preservation.z: 历史建筑的保护需要周密的规划和公众的大力支持。

preserve.s: We should preserve our cultural heritage for future generations to appreciate.
preserve.z: 我们应该为后代保护我们的文化遗产，让他们能够欣赏。

preset.s: You can preset the oven to start cooking automatically at seven in the morning.
preset.z: 你可以预设烤箱在早上七点自动开始烹饪。

preside.s: The senior professor will preside over the department meeting tomorrow afternoon.
preside.z: 这位资深教授将主持明天下午的系会议。

presidency.s: She wrote a book about her years during the presidency of the young leader.
presidency.z: 她写了一本书，讲述在那位年轻领导人担任总统期间她的那些岁月。

president.s: The president of the student union gave a short speech at the ceremony.
president.z: 学生会主席在典礼上作了简短的讲话。

press.s: She had to press the button twice before the old elevator finally started moving.
press.z: 她不得不按了两次按钮，那部旧电梯才终于开始移动。

pressure.s: Many students feel great pressure before the final exams each semester.
pressure.z: 许多学生在每个学期的期末考试前都感到很大的压力。

prestige.s: The university has gained international prestige for its excellent research and teaching.
prestige.z: 这所大学因其出色的研究和教学赢得了国际声望。

presumably.s: Presumably, the meeting was canceled because most of the staff were out sick.
presumably.z: 据推测，会议被取消了，因为大多数员工都生病请假了。

prevail.s: Common sense should prevail when we make important decisions under pressure.
prevail.z: 当我们在压力下做出重要决定时，常识应该占上风。

prevailing.s: The prevailing view among researchers is that regular exercise improves mental health.
prevailing.z: 研究人员中普遍的观点是，规律运动能改善心理健康。

prevalence.s: The prevalence of smart phones among college students has changed how they study and socialize.
prevalence.z: 智能手机在大学生中的普遍流行已经改变了他们学习和社交的方式。

prevalent.s: Smartphones have become increasingly prevalent among students in recent years.
prevalent.z: 近年来，智能手机在学生中变得越来越普遍。

prevent.s: Regular exercise can help prevent many serious health problems in later life.
prevent.z: 经常锻炼有助于预防晚年出现的许多严重健康问题。

preventable.s: Most experts agree that this type of disease is largely preventable through simple lifestyle changes.
preventable.z: 大多数专家一致认为，这种疾病在很大程度上可以通过简单的生活方式改变来预防。

prevention.s: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are important for the prevention of heart disease.
prevention.z: 规律运动和均衡饮食对于预防心脏病很重要。

preventive.s: Regular exercise is an effective preventive measure against many common diseases.
preventive.z: 定期锻炼是预防许多常见疾病的有效措施。

previous.s: She had no previous experience in teaching before she joined our school.
previous.z: 在加入我们学校之前，她没有任何教学经验。

previously.s: She had previously worked in a bank before she became a teacher.
previously.z: 她在成为老师之前曾在银行工作过。

prey.s: Small birds often fall prey to hungry cats at night.
prey.z: 小鸟在夜间常常成为饥饿的猫的猎物。

priceless.s: The look on her face when she opened the gift was priceless.
priceless.z: 她打开礼物时脸上的表情是无价的。

prick.s: She felt a sharp prick when the nurse gave her the injection.
prick.z: 护士给她打针时，她感到一阵尖锐的刺痛。

primarily.s: The course is primarily designed for students who want to improve their writing skills.
primarily.z: 这门课程主要是为想要提高写作能力的学生设计的。

prime.s: The prime reason for his success is years of hard work and careful planning.
prime.z: 他成功的主要原因是多年的努力和周密的计划。

primitive.s: Early humans used primitive tools made of stone and wood to survive.
primitive.z: 早期人类使用由石头和木头制成的原始工具来生存。

prince.s: The young prince promised to protect the village from danger.
prince.z: 年轻的王子承诺保护村庄免受危险。

princess.s: The little girl dressed up as a princess for the school play.
princess.z: 那个小女孩为学校的话剧打扮成了公主。

principal.s: The principal reason for his success is years of hard work.
principal.z: 他成功的主要原因是多年的努力。

principally.s: The new course is principally designed for students who want to improve their writing skills.
principally.z: 这门新课程主要是为想要提高写作能力的学生设计的。

principle.s: She refused to change her decision because it went against her basic principles.
principle.z: 她拒绝改变自己的决定，因为那违背了她的基本原则。

printer.s: The printer in our office stopped working just before the meeting began.
printer.z: 我们办公室的打印机在会议开始前刚好坏了。

prior.s: She had no prior experience with programming before she took the course.
prior.z: 在上这门课之前，她没有任何编程方面的先前经验。

prioritize.s: Students should prioritize their studies over part-time jobs during the exam period.
prioritize.z: 考试期间，学生应该优先考虑学业，而不是兼职工作。

priority.s: Finishing my essay is my top priority this weekend, so I will skip the party.
priority.z: 完成论文是我这个周末的首要任务，所以我会不参加聚会。

prism.s: The scientist used a glass prism to split white light into a rainbow of colors.
prism.z: 科学家用玻璃棱镜将白光分解成彩虹般的各种颜色。

prison.s: After ten years in prison, he finally returned home to his family.
prison.z: 在监狱服刑十年后，他终于回到家中与家人团聚。

prisoner.s: The prisoner was released after serving ten years in the local prison.
prisoner.z: 那名囚犯在当地监狱服刑十年后获释。

privacy.s: Many users worry that mobile apps collect too much personal data and invade their privacy.
privacy.z: 许多用户担心手机应用收集过多个人数据，侵犯他们的隐私。

private.s: She keeps her private diary locked in a drawer so nobody can read it.
private.z: 她把私人日记锁在抽屉里，这样就没有人能读到它。

privilege.s: She was born into a wealthy family, so education was always a privilege she took for granted.
privilege.z: 她出生在一个富裕家庭，所以教育对她来说一直是一种理所当然的特权。

privileged.s: Only a privileged few can afford to live in such an expensive neighborhood.
privileged.z: 只有少数享有特权的人才能负担得起住在如此昂贵的街区。

probability.s: There is a high probability that the meeting will be postponed until next week.
probability.z: 会议很有可能被推迟到下周。

probably.s: She will probably arrive late because the traffic is terrible today.
probably.z: 她可能会迟到，因为今天交通很糟糕。

probe.s: The committee decided to probe the causes of the sudden decline in sales.
probe.z: 委员会决定调查销售额突然下降的原因。

procedure.s: The teacher explained the procedure for submitting our final papers before the deadline.
procedure.z: 老师讲解了在截止日期前提交期末论文的程序。

proceed.s: After the meeting, we proceeded with the plan as agreed.
proceed.z: 会议结束后，我们按照约定继续推进该计划。

proceeding.s: The lawyer read the proceedings of the previous hearing carefully before the new trial began.
proceeding.z: 律师在新庭审开始前仔细阅读了上一次听证会的程序记录。

process.s: Learning a new language is a slow process that requires patience and daily practice.
process.z: 学习一门新语言是一个缓慢的过程，需要耐心和每天的练习。

processing.s: The new software speeds up the processing of large amounts of data.
processing.z: 这款新软件加快了大量数据的处理速度。

producer.s: The producer of the documentary spent two years filming in remote villages.
producer.z: 这部纪录片的制片人在偏远的村庄拍摄了两年。

production.s: The factory increased its production of electric cars by thirty percent last year.
production.z: 这家工厂去年将电动汽车的产量提高了百分之三十。

productive.s: Working in a quiet room helps me stay productive during long study sessions.
productive.z: 在安静的房间里学习有助于我在长时间的学习中保持高效。

productivity.s: Regular breaks during study hours can greatly improve your productivity.
productivity.z: 在学习时间中定期休息可以大大提高你的效率。
