rate.z: 过去两年里失业率急剧上升。

rather.s: The exam was rather difficult, so many students ran out of time.
rather.z: 这次考试相当难，所以许多学生都没做完。

rating.s: The new restaurant received a high rating from most of its customers.
rating.z: 这家新餐厅获得了大多数顾客的高评分。

rational.s: She stayed calm and made a rational decision instead of arguing with her angry colleague.
rational.z: 她保持冷静，做出了理性的决定，而不是和愤怒的同事争吵。

react.s: She did not react calmly when she heard the surprising news.
react.z: 当她听到这个令人惊讶的消息时，她没有冷静地做出反应。

reaction.s: Her unexpected reaction to the news surprised everyone in the room.
reaction.z: 她对这个消息出人意料的反应让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

reactor.s: Engineers shut down the reactor quickly after the alarm sounded.
reactor.z: 警报响起后，工程师们迅速关闭了反应堆。

reader.s: The magazine offers its readers practical advice on saving money and staying healthy.
reader.z: 这本杂志为读者提供关于省钱和保持健康的实用建议。

readily.s: Information about the exam is readily available on the university website.
readily.z: 关于考试的信息在大学网站上很容易就能查到。

reading.s: She spends an hour reading English newspapers every morning before class.
reading.z: 她每天早上上课前都会花一个小时读英文报纸。

readjust.s: It took her several weeks to readjust to life in a new city.
readjust.z: 她花了好几周才重新适应新城市的生活。

reaffirm.s: The manager took a moment to reaffirm his commitment to the project before the meeting ended.
reaffirm.z: 会议结束前，经理特意重申了他对这个项目的承诺。

realistic.s: Setting realistic goals is the first step toward achieving success in your studies.
realistic.z: 设定现实的目标是学业取得成功的第一步。

reality.s: The reality of student life is harder than most freshmen expect.
reality.z: 学生生活的现实比大多数新生预想的更难。

realization.s: The realization that she had forgotten her passport hit her at the airport.
realization.z: 在机场时，她突然意识到自己忘了带护照。

really.s: I really enjoyed the lecture because the professor explained everything clearly.
really.z: 我真的很喜欢这场讲座，因为教授把一切都解释得很清楚。

realm.s: New discoveries in space have greatly expanded our understanding of the physical realm.
realm.z: 太空中的新发现极大地拓展了我们对物理领域的认识。

reap.s: Students who review their notes regularly will reap the benefits during the final exam.
reap.z: 经常复习笔记的学生会在期末考试中获得好处。

rear.s: The kitchen is at the rear of the house, next to the garden.
rear.z: 厨房在房子的后部，紧挨着花园。

rearrange.s: We had to rearrange the furniture to make room for the new desk.
rearrange.z: 我们不得不重新摆放家具，以便为新书桌腾出空间。

reason.s: She gave a convincing reason for missing the important meeting yesterday.
reason.z: 她为昨天缺席重要会议给出了一个令人信服的理由。

reasonable.s: It is reasonable to ask for more time when the task is genuinely difficult.
reasonable.z: 当任务确实困难时，要求更多时间是合理的。

reassess.s: After failing the exam, she decided to reassess her study habits and daily routine.
reassess.z: 考试不及格后，她决定重新评估自己的学习习惯和日常作息。

rebellion.s: The new rules caused a peaceful rebellion among the students.
rebellion.z: 新规定在学生中引发了一场和平的反抗。

rebuild.s: After the earthquake, volunteers worked together to rebuild the damaged school in just three months.
rebuild.z: 地震后，志愿者们齐心协力，仅用三个月就重建了受损的学校。

rebuke.s: The manager rebuked his staff for arriving late to the important meeting.
rebuke.z: 经理因员工迟到参加重要会议而斥责了他们。

recall.s: I cannot recall where I left my keys this morning.
recall.z: 我想不起来今天早上把钥匙放在哪里了。

receipt.s: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
receipt.z: 请保留收据，以备你需要退鞋时使用。

receiver.s: The receiver of the letter was asked to sign and return it within a week.
receiver.z: 收信人被要求在一周内签字并寄回。

recent.s: Her recent research has attracted considerable attention from scholars in the field.
recent.z: 她最近的研究引起了该领域学者的广泛关注。

recently.s: She has recently started working at a local bank near her apartment.
recently.z: 她最近开始在她公寓附近的一家本地银行工作。

receptionist.s: The receptionist at the front desk politely answered all my questions about the hotel.
receptionist.z: 前台的接待员礼貌地回答了我关于酒店的所有问题。

recession.s: Many small businesses struggled to survive during the long economic recession.
recession.z: 在漫长的经济衰退期间，许多小企业艰难求生。

recharge.s: I need to recharge my phone before we leave for the airport.
recharge.z: 在我们出发去机场之前，我需要给手机充电。

recipient.s: The recipient of the award gave a short speech thanking his family and teachers.
recipient.z: 获奖者发表了简短的讲话，感谢他的家人和老师。

reciprocal.s: A healthy friendship depends on reciprocal trust and support between both people.
reciprocal.z: 健康的友谊取决于双方之间相互的信任与支持。

reckless.s: His reckless driving scared everyone in the car and almost caused a serious accident.
reckless.z: 他鲁莽的驾驶让车里的每个人都胆战心惊，还差点造成严重事故。

reckon.s: I reckon it will take us about two hours to finish the report.
reckon.z: 我估计我们大约需要两个小时才能完成这份报告。

reclaim.s: After the long exam, she went home to reclaim her quiet study space from her noisy roommates.
reclaim.z: 考试结束后，她回家从吵闹的室友那里夺回了自己安静的学习空间。

recognition.s: Her hard work finally received the recognition it deserved from the whole team.
recognition.z: 她的努力终于得到了整个团队应有的认可。

recommend.s: The doctor recommended that she take a short break from work to reduce stress.
recommend.z: 医生建议她短暂休假以减轻压力。

recommendation.s: My teacher wrote a strong recommendation for my scholarship application.
recommendation.z: 老师为我的奖学金申请写了一封有力的推荐信。

reconciliation.s: The two brothers finally reached a reconciliation after years of bitter arguing over money.
reconciliation.z: 兄弟俩在多年为钱激烈争吵后最终达成了和解。

recorder.s: She turned on the recorder before the interview began.
recorder.z: 采访开始前，她打开了录音机。

recover.s: It took her several weeks to recover fully from the serious illness.
recover.z: 她花了好几周才从这场重病中完全康复。

recovery.s: The doctor said that a full recovery would take several months of rest.
recovery.z: 医生说完全康复需要休息好几个月。

recreational.s: Many students enjoy recreational activities like swimming and hiking to reduce stress after class.
recreational.z: 许多学生喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动来缓解课后压力。

recruit.s: The company plans to recruit more engineers next year to support its growing projects.
recruit.z: 公司计划明年招聘更多工程师以支持其不断增长的项目。

recruiter.s: The recruiter asked me several questions about my past work experience.
recruiter.z: 招聘人员问了我几个关于我过去工作经验的问题。

rectangle.s: She drew a small rectangle on the paper and filled it with bright colors.
rectangle.z: 她在纸上画了一个小长方形，并用鲜艳的颜色把它涂满。

rectangular.s: The classroom has several rectangular tables arranged in neat rows.
rectangular.z: 教室里摆放着几张长方形的桌子，排列得很整齐。

rectify.s: The company promised to rectify the mistake quickly after customers complained online.
rectify.z: 顾客在网上投诉后，公司承诺迅速纠正这一错误。

recur.s: The same problem tends to recur whenever the team changes its leader.
recur.z: 每当团队更换领导时，同样的问题往往会再次出现。

recurrence.s: Doctors monitor patients closely to prevent a recurrence of the disease.
recurrence.z: 医生密切监测病人，以防疾病复发。

recyclable.s: Most of the packaging used for these products is recyclable and easy to process.
recyclable.z: 这些产品使用的大部分包装都是可回收的，而且易于处理。

recycle.s: We should recycle paper and plastic bottles to reduce waste in our daily life.
recycle.z: 我们应该回收纸张和塑料瓶，以减少日常生活中的浪费。

redefine.s: Social media has redefined how young people communicate with their friends.
redefine.z: 社交媒体重新定义了年轻人与朋友交流的方式。

reduce.s: We should reduce the amount of sugar we eat to stay healthy.
reduce.z: 我们应该减少糖的摄入量以保持健康。

reduction.s: The new policy led to a significant reduction in air pollution across major cities.
reduction.z: 新政策使主要城市的空气污染显著减少。

reed.s: The boy cut a reed from the riverbank to make a simple flute.
reed.z: 男孩从河岸上割下一根芦苇，做了一支简单的笛子。

reef.s: The divers explored the colorful coral reef and saw many strange fish.
reef.z: 潜水员探索了色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁，看到了许多奇特的鱼。

refer.s: Whenever you use a new word, you should refer to the dictionary to check its meaning.
refer.z: 每当你使用一个新单词时，都应该查阅词典来确认它的意思。

reference.s: The professor asked us to include a complete reference list at the end of our research paper.
reference.z: 教授要求我们在研究论文末尾附上一份完整的参考文献列表。

refinery.s: The new refinery near the coast processes thousands of barrels of oil every day.
refinery.z: 沿海的新炼油厂每天加工数千桶石油。

reflect.s: The survey results reflect the changing attitudes of young people toward work.
reflect.z: 调查结果反映了年轻人对工作的态度正在发生变化。

reflection.s: After a long day of work, she sat by the window in quiet reflection.
reflection.z: 工作了一整天后，她坐在窗边静静地沉思。

reflective.s: After the meeting, she became reflective and thought about what she could have said differently.
reflective.z: 会议结束后，她陷入沉思，想着自己本可以说些什么不同的话。

reflexion.s: After a long reflexion on the problem, she finally found a better solution.
reflexion.z: 经过对这个问题长时间的思考，她终于找到了一个更好的解决方案。

reform.s: The government promised to reform the education system to help more students succeed.
reform.z: 政府承诺改革教育体系，帮助更多学生取得成功。

refrain.s: She asked the students to refrain from talking during the exam.
refrain.z: 她要求学生考试期间不要讲话。

reframe.s: She tried to reframe the problem as an opportunity rather than a threat.
reframe.z: 她试图把这个重新表述为一个机会，而不是一种威胁。

refreshing.s: A cool drink on a hot afternoon is truly refreshing.
refreshing.z: 在炎热的下午喝一杯冷饮真是令人神清气爽。

refuel.s: The plane stopped at the airport to refuel before continuing its long flight.
refuel.z: 飞机在机场停下来加油，然后继续它的长途飞行。

refuge.s: During the heavy storm, the hikers found refuge in a small wooden cabin.
refuge.z: 在暴风雨中，徒步旅行者在一间小木屋里找到了避难所。

refugee.s: The refugee family finally found a safe home after fleeing their war-torn country.
refugee.z: 这个难民家庭在逃离战火纷飞的国家后终于找到了一个安全的家。

refusal.s: His refusal to accept the offer surprised everyone at the meeting.
refusal.z: 他拒绝接受这个提议，让会上所有人都感到惊讶。

regain.s: After a long rest, she finally regained her strength and returned to work.
regain.z: 经过长时间休息，她终于恢复了体力，重新回到工作岗位。

regard.s: Many students regard regular exercise as an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
regard.z: 许多学生把定期锻炼视为健康生活方式的重要组成部分。

regarding.s: She asked several questions regarding the new policy during the meeting.
regarding.z: 她在会议上就新政策提出了几个问题。

regenerate.s: After a long holiday, she felt her energy slowly regenerate and returned to work with fresh enthusiasm.
regenerate.z: 经过一个长假后，她感到精力慢慢恢复，带着全新的热情回到了工作岗位。

regenerative.s: Regenerative farming practices can restore soil health and reduce the need for chemical fertilizers.
regenerative.z: 再生农业实践能够恢复土壤健康，并减少对化肥的需求。

regime.s: The new government promised to reform the tax regime to help small businesses grow.
regime.z: 新政府承诺改革税收制度，以帮助小企业成长。

region.s: This region is famous for its mild climate and rich soil.
region.z: 这个地区以其温和的气候和肥沃的土壤而闻名。

register.s: You must register for the course before the deadline on Friday.
register.z: 你必须在周五截止日期前注册这门课程。

registration.s: Online registration for the new semester closes at the end of this week.
registration.z: 新学期的在线注册将于本周末截止。

regular.s: She takes regular exercise every morning to stay healthy and energetic.
regular.z: 她每天早上进行规律的锻炼，以保持健康和精力充沛。

regularity.s: The regularity of her daily exercise routine helped her stay healthy and focused.
regularity.z: 她日常锻炼的规律性帮助她保持健康和专注。

regularly.s: Students who exercise regularly usually find it easier to concentrate on their studies.
regularly.z: 经常锻炼的学生通常更容易集中精力学习。

regulate.s: New laws were introduced to regulate the use of plastic bags in supermarkets.
regulate.z: 新法律出台，以规范超市中塑料袋的使用。

regulation.s: The new safety regulations require all workers to wear helmets on site.
regulation.z: 新的安全规定要求所有工人在工地上佩戴头盔。

rehearsal.s: The whole team stayed late for a final rehearsal before the big performance.
rehearsal.z: 整个团队为了大型演出前的最后一次彩排而待到很晚。

reign.s: The queen's reign lasted for more than forty years and brought great changes.
reign.z: 女王的统治持续了四十多年，带来了巨大的变化。

reimbursement.s: She submitted the receipts to her manager and received full reimbursement for the business trip.
reimbursement.z: 她把收据交给经理，并获得了出差的全额报销。

rein.s: The new manager decided to rein in spending after the company's losses grew.
rein.z: 在公司的亏损增加后，新经理决定控制开支。

reinforce.s: The new evidence only served to reinforce our belief that the plan would work.
reinforce.z: 新的证据只是进一步增强了我们对这个计划会奏效的信心。

reject.s: The committee decided to reject the proposal because it was too expensive.
reject.z: 委员会决定拒绝该提案，因为它太昂贵了。

rejection.s: Her rejection of the job offer surprised everyone who knew her well.
rejection.z: 她拒绝这份工作的决定让所有熟悉她的人都感到惊讶。

relate.s: Many students find it hard to relate what they learn in class to real life.
relate.z: 许多学生发现很难把课堂上学到的知识与现实生活联系起来。

relation.s: The relationship between diet and health has attracted much attention in recent years.
relation.z: 近年来，饮食与健康之间的关系引起了广泛关注。

relationship.s: A healthy relationship with your classmates can make college life much more enjoyable.
relationship.z: 与同学保持健康的关系能让大学生活愉快得多。

relativity.s: Einstein's theory of relativity changed how scientists understand space, time, and gravity.
relativity.z: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了科学家对空间、时间和引力的理解。

release.s: The company will release its new software next month after months of testing.
release.z: 经过数月的测试，该公司将于下个月发布其新软件。

relegate.s: The manager decided to relegate the experienced player to the bench for the rest of the season.
relegate.z: 经理决定在本赛季剩余时间里把这位经验丰富的球员降为替补。

relevant.s: Please include only the information that is relevant to our discussion.
relevant.z: 请只包含与我们的讨论相关的信息。

reliability.s: The reliability of the test results depends on careful data collection.
reliability.z: 测试结果的可靠性取决于仔细的数据收集。

reliable.s: We need a reliable source of information before we make the final decision.
reliable.z: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要一个可靠的信息来源。

reliance.s: Too much reliance on phones can weaken our ability to think independently.
reliance.z: 过度依赖手机会削弱我们独立思考的能力。

relief.s: She felt a great sense of relief after finishing her final exam.
relief.z: 完成期末考试后，她感到如释重负。

relieve.s: Taking a short walk after class can help relieve the stress of a long day.
relieve.z: 课后短暂散步有助于缓解漫长一天的压力。

relieved.s: She felt relieved when she heard that the exam had been cancelled.
relieved.z: 听说考试取消了，她感到如释重负。

religion.s: Many students study world religion to understand different cultures and traditions.
religion.z: 许多学生学习世界宗教，以了解不同的文化和传统。

religious.s: Her family is deeply religious and attends church every Sunday morning.
religious.z: 她的家人非常虔诚，每个星期天早上都去教堂。

reluctance.s: She showed great reluctance to leave her hometown and start a new life in the city.
reluctance.z: 她非常不情愿离开家乡去城市开始新的生活。

reluctant.s: She was reluctant to admit that her study plan had failed.
reluctant.z: 她不愿承认自己的学习计划已经失败了。

rely.s: Many students rely on their phones to look up new words every day.
rely.z: 许多学生每天依靠手机查阅新单词。

remainder.s: After paying the rent, she saved the remainder of her salary for a trip.
remainder.z: 付完房租后，她把剩下的工资存起来准备去旅行。

remark.s: She made a rude remark about his cooking, which upset everyone at the table.
remark.z: 她对他的厨艺说了一句粗鲁的话，这让餐桌上的每个人都很不高兴。

remarkable.s: Her remarkable progress in spoken English surprised all of her teachers.
remarkable.z: 她在英语口语方面的显著进步让她所有的老师都感到惊讶。

remedy.s: The doctor suggested a simple remedy to help her sleep better at night.
remedy.z: 医生建议了一种简单的疗法来帮助她晚上睡得更好。

remonstrate.s: The students decided to remonstrate with the teacher about the unfair grading system.
remonstrate.z: 学生们决定就评分制度不公平一事向老师提出抗议。

remote.s: She enjoys working in a remote village where few tourists ever go.
remote.z: 她喜欢在一个很少有游客前往的偏远村庄工作。

removal.s: The removal of old trees from the park has upset many local residents.
removal.z: 从公园里移除老树让许多当地居民感到不安。

remove.s: Please remove your shoes before you enter the clean room.
remove.z: 进入洁净室之前请脱掉鞋子。

renaissance.s: The city has experienced a cultural renaissance since the new museum opened last year.
renaissance.z: 自从去年新博物馆开放以来，这座城市经历了一场文化复兴。

render.s: The heavy rain rendered the roads unsafe for driving.
render.z: 大雨使得道路不适合开车。

renew.s: She decided to renew her library books before the due date to avoid a fine.
renew.z: 她决定在到期日前续借图书馆的书，以免被罚款。

renewable.s: The government is investing heavily in renewable energy to reduce pollution.
renewable.z: 政府正在大力投资可再生能源以减少污染。

rental.s: The rental cost of the apartment includes water and electricity.
rental.z: 这套公寓的租金包括水费和电费。

repair.s: The mechanic said it would cost too much to repair the old car.
repair.z: 技工说修理这辆旧车花费太高了。

repave.s: The city plans to repave the main road before the winter rains begin.
repave.z: 市政府计划在冬季降雨开始前重新铺设主干道。

repeal.s: The government decided to repeal the outdated law after years of public pressure.
repeal.z: 在多年的公众压力下，政府决定废除这项过时的法律。

repeatedly.s: The teacher repeatedly reminded students to check their answers before handing in the exam papers.
repeatedly.z: 老师反复提醒学生在交卷前检查答案。

repertoire.s: The pianist spent years expanding his repertoire with works from different periods.
repertoire.z: 这位钢琴家花了多年时间，用不同时期的作品扩充自己的曲目。

repetition.s: Learning a language requires patience and constant repetition of key phrases.
repetition.z: 学习一门语言需要耐心，并不断重复关键短语。

repetitive.s: Doing repetitive tasks every day can make workers feel bored and tired.
repetitive.z: 每天做重复性的工作会让员工感到无聊和疲惫。

replace.s: We need to replace the old equipment with more efficient machines.
replace.z: 我们需要用更高效的机器替换旧设备。

replacement.s: Finding a suitable replacement for the retired manager took the company several months.
replacement.z: 为公司找到一位合适的继任者来接替那位退休的经理花了好几个月时间。

reporter.s: The reporter asked several difficult questions during the press conference.
reporter.z: 记者在新闻发布会上问了几个棘手的问题。

representation.s: The chart gives a clear representation of how students spend their free time.
representation.z: 这张图表清晰地展示了学生如何度过他们的空闲时间。

representative.s: Each department sent one representative to the meeting to share student concerns.
representative.z: 每个系都派了一名代表参加会议，分享学生的关切。

repression.s: Years of political repression finally pushed the citizens to demand freedom.
repression.z: 多年的政治压制最终促使公民们要求自由。

reproduction.s: The reproduction of these plants depends on bees and other insects.
reproduction.z: 这些植物的繁殖依赖于蜜蜂和其他昆虫。

reproductive.s: Good nutrition and regular exercise are important for maintaining reproductive health.
reproductive.z: 良好的营养和规律的运动对于维持生殖健康很重要。

reptile.s: The snake is a reptile that sheds its skin several times a year.
reptile.z: 蛇是一种爬行动物，一年会蜕皮好几次。

republican.s: The debate over republican ideals shaped much of the country's early political history.
republican.z: 关于共和主义理想的辩论塑造了该国早期政治史的很大一部分。

reputation.s: The small restaurant has built a good reputation for serving fresh food at low prices.
reputation.z: 这家小餐馆因提供新鲜且价格低廉的食物而赢得了良好的声誉。

request.s: The manager approved my request to work from home on Friday.
request.z: 经理批准了我周五在家办公的请求。

requirement.s: Passing the final exam is a basic requirement for every student in this course.
requirement.z: 通过期末考试是这门课程每个学生的基本要求。

requisite.s: Patience is a requisite quality for anyone who wants to master a foreign language.
requisite.z: 耐心是任何想要掌握一门外语的人所必备的素质。

rescue.s: Firefighters worked through the night to rescue the trapped miners from the collapsed tunnel.
rescue.z: 消防员连夜工作，从坍塌的隧道中救出被困的矿工。

resemblance.s: There is a strong resemblance between the twin sisters, so people often mistake one for the other.
resemblance.z: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得很像，所以人们常把她们认错。

resemble.s: The new building strongly resembles the old library across the street.
resemble.z: 这座新建筑与街对面的旧图书馆非常相似。

resent.s: She resented having to work overtime every weekend while her colleagues enjoyed their free time.
resent.z: 她讨厌每个周末都得加班，而同事们却在享受空闲时间。

reservation.s: I would like to make a reservation for two at seven o'clock tonight.
reservation.z: 我想预订今晚七点两个人的位子。

reserve.s: We made a reservation at the restaurant to celebrate my friend's birthday.
reserve.z: 我们在这家餐厅预订了位子来庆祝我朋友的生日。

reserved.s: She seems reserved at first, but she becomes quite talkative once you know her well.
reserved.z: 她起初显得矜持，但一旦你和她熟悉起来，她就会变得很健谈。

residence.s: The new student moved into her residence hall a week before classes began.
residence.z: 这名新生在开学前一周搬进了她的宿舍楼。

resident.s: Every resident in the building was asked to save water during the hot summer.
resident.z: 这栋楼里的每一位居民都被要求在炎热的夏天节约用水。

residential.s: The city plans to build a new residential area near the park.
residential.z: 该市计划在公园附近建设一个新的住宅区。

residual.s: Some residual pain remained in his knee weeks after the injury.
residual.z: 受伤数周后，他的膝盖仍留有一些残余的疼痛。

resignation.s: After months of stress, she handed in her resignation and started looking for a new job.
resignation.z: 在经历了数月的压力之后，她递交了辞呈，开始寻找新工作。

resist.s: She could not resist laughing when she saw his funny expression.
resist.z: 看到他滑稽的表情，她忍不住笑了起来。

resistance.s: Many bacteria have developed resistance to the antibiotics that doctors once used freely.
resistance.z: 许多细菌对医生曾经广泛使用的抗生素产生了抗药性。

resistant.s: Many bacteria have become resistant to the antibiotics that doctors once used freely.
resistant.z: 许多细菌已经对医生们曾经随意使用的抗生素产生了抗药性。

resolute.s: She remained resolute in her decision to finish the project despite many difficulties.
resolute.z: 尽管困难重重，她仍坚定地决定完成这个项目。

resolution.s: She made a firm resolution to exercise for thirty minutes every morning.
resolution.z: 她下定决心每天早上锻炼三十分钟。

resolve.s: She finally resolved the problem after discussing it with her teammates.
resolve.z: 她和队友讨论后终于解决了这个问题。

resource.s: The school library provides students with useful resources for their research projects.
resource.z: 学校图书馆为学生的研究项目提供了有用的资源。

resourceful.s: She is a resourceful teacher who always finds creative ways to keep her students interested.
resourceful.z: 她是一位足智多谋的老师，总能找到有创意的方法让学生保持兴趣。

respect.s: Students should show respect for their teachers and classmates at all times.
respect.z: 学生应该始终对老师和同学表示尊重。

respectable.s: He earns a respectable salary, but he still complains about money.
respectable.z: 他挣着一份可观的薪水，却仍然抱怨钱不够。

respectful.s: Students should be respectful to their teachers and classmates during class discussions.
respectful.z: 学生在课堂讨论中应该尊重老师和同学。

respective.s: After the meeting, each manager returned to their respective offices to review the new plan.
respective.z: 会议结束后，每位经理都回到各自的办公室审阅新计划。

respectively.s: The two brothers chose medicine and law as their careers, respectively.
respectively.z: 这两兄弟分别选择了医学和法律作为自己的职业。

respond.s: She did not respond to my email, so I called her office the next morning.
respond.z: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以第二天早上我打电话给了她的办公室。

respondent.s: Most respondents to the survey said they preferred flexible working hours to higher pay.
respondent.z: 大多数调查受访者表示，他们更喜欢弹性工作时间，而不是更高的工资。

response.s: Her quick response to the emergency saved the patient's life.
response.z: 她对紧急情况的迅速反应挽救了病人的生命。

responsibility.s: Every student should take responsibility for keeping the classroom clean and tidy.
responsibility.z: 每个学生都应该负起保持教室干净整洁的责任。

responsible.s: She is responsible for training all the new employees in the department.
responsible.z: 她负责培训部门里所有的新员工。

responsive.s: The teacher was pleased because her students were responsive and eager to share their ideas.
responsive.z: 老师很高兴，因为她的学生反应积极，乐于分享自己的想法。

restock.s: The manager asked us to restock the shelves before the store opens tomorrow.
restock.z: 经理让我们在明天商店开门前补充货架上的商品。

restore.s: The workers spent two years trying to restore the old library to its original beauty.
restore.z: 工人们花了两年时间，努力把这座旧图书馆恢复到原来的美丽模样。

restraint.s: She showed great restraint by not responding to his rude comments.
restraint.z: 她表现出极大的克制，没有回应他粗鲁的言论。

restrict.s: The new rules restrict students from using phones during class.
restrict.z: 新规定限制学生在课堂上使用手机。

restriction.s: The new rules place strict restrictions on the use of plastic bags in supermarkets.
restriction.z: 新规定对超市塑料袋的使用实施了严格的限制。

restructure.s: The company decided to restructure its departments to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
restructure.z: 公司决定重组其部门以提高效率并降低成本。

resultant.s: The heavy rain caused flooding and the resultant damage to local roads was severe.
resultant.z: 大雨引发了洪水，由此对当地道路造成的损坏十分严重。

retail.s: Online retail has grown rapidly as more people choose to shop from home.
retail.z: 随着越来越多的人选择在家购物，网络零售迅速发展。

retailer.s: The retailer offered a generous discount to attract more customers during the holiday season.
retailer.z: 这家零售商提供了大幅折扣，以在节日期间吸引更多顾客。

retain.s: Many students struggle to retain new vocabulary if they never review it regularly.
retain.z: 许多学生如果从不定期复习，就很难记住新词汇。

retard.s: Lack of sleep can retard the growth of young children.
retard.z: 睡眠不足会阻碍幼儿的生长发育。

retention.s: The retention of new vocabulary depends on regular review and active practice.
retention.z: 新词汇的保持取决于定期复习和积极练习。

retire.s: My father plans to retire from his teaching job at the end of this year.
retire.z: 我父亲计划在今年年底从他的教学工作中退休。

retirement.s: After forty years of hard work, she is finally looking forward to a peaceful retirement.
retirement.z: 经过四十年的辛勤工作，她终于可以期待一个平静的退休生活了。

retrain.s: Companies often retrain their employees to keep up with new technology.
retrain.z: 公司经常重新培训员工以跟上新技术的步伐。

retreat.s: When the noise became too much, she retreated to her room to study in peace.
retreat.z: 当噪音变得太大时，她退回到自己的房间安静地学习。

retrospect.s: In retrospect, I realize that choosing that major was a wise decision.
retrospect.z: 回想起来，我意识到选择那个专业是个明智的决定。

reunion.s: The whole family gathered for a happy reunion during the Spring Festival holiday.
reunion.z: 春节期间，全家人聚在一起，度过了一次快乐的团聚。

reveal.s: The scientist refused to reveal the results of the experiment before the meeting.
reveal.z: 这位科学家拒绝在会议前透露实验结果。

revelation.s: Her sudden revelation about the missing money shocked everyone at the meeting.
revelation.z: 她突然揭露关于失踪钱款的事，令会上所有人都大为震惊。

revenue.s: The company's annual revenue increased by ten percent thanks to strong online sales.
revenue.z: 由于线上销售强劲，公司的年收入增长了百分之十。

reverse.s: The new policy is likely to reverse the downward trend in employment.
reverse.z: 这项新政策可能会扭转就业率下降的趋势。

review.s: Before the final exam, she spent the whole weekend reviewing her notes carefully.
review.z: 期末考试前，她花了整个周末仔细复习笔记。

revise.s: The teacher asked us to revise our essays before the final submission next week.
revise.z: 老师要求我们在下周最终提交之前修改我们的论文。

revive.s: The heavy rain revived the dying plants in the garden.
revive.z: 这场大雨使花园里濒临枯死的植物恢复了生机。

revolution.s: The invention of the internet caused a revolution in how people communicate and share information.
revolution.z: 互联网的发明引发了人们沟通和分享信息方式的革命。

revolutionary.s: The new teaching method proved revolutionary because it changed how students learn every day.
revolutionary.z: 这种新教学方法被证明是革命性的，因为它改变了学生每天学习的方式。

revolutionize.s: The new technology may revolutionize the way students learn foreign languages.
revolutionize.z: 这项新技术可能会彻底改变学生学习外语的方式。

reward.s: She received a generous reward for finishing the project ahead of schedule.
reward.z: 她因提前完成项目而获得了丰厚的奖励。

rewarding.s: Teaching children to read is hard work, but it is deeply rewarding.
rewarding.z: 教孩子阅读很辛苦，但非常值得。

rhetorical.s: The speaker asked a rhetorical question that made the audience think deeply.
rhetorical.z: 演讲者问了一个修辞性问题，让听众深入思考。

ridiculous.s: It seems ridiculous to spend so much money on a single meal.
ridiculous.z: 花这么多钱吃一顿饭似乎很荒唐。

rifle.s: The soldier carefully cleaned his rifle before the morning training exercise began.
rifle.z: 士兵在早晨训练开始前仔细擦拭了他的步枪。

rigid.s: The school has rigid rules about wearing uniforms every day.
rigid.z: 学校对每天穿校服有严格的规定。

rigorous.s: The professor expects rigorous analysis rather than superficial opinions in every research paper.
rigorous.z: 教授希望每篇研究论文都进行严谨的分析，而不是肤浅的观点。

rinse.s: Please rinse the vegetables thoroughly before you cook them.
rinse.z: 烹饪前请把蔬菜彻底冲洗干净。

riotous.s: The students had a riotous time at the party, laughing and dancing until midnight.
riotous.z: 学生们在聚会上玩得很狂欢，笑着跳舞直到午夜。

ripple.s: She threw a stone into the pond and watched the ripples spread across the water.
ripple.z: 她往池塘里扔了一块石头，看着涟漪在水面上扩散开来。

ritual.s: Drinking tea every morning has become an important ritual in her daily life.
ritual.z: 每天早上喝茶已成为她日常生活中重要的仪式。

rival.s: The small company is trying hard to compete with its bigger rival.
rival.z: 这家小公司正在努力与其更大的竞争对手竞争。

rivalry.s: The friendly rivalry between the two brothers pushed both of them to work harder.
rivalry.z: 两兄弟之间的友好竞争促使他们俩都更加努力。

roam.s: Wild animals often roam freely across the vast grasslands in search of food.
roam.z: 野生动物常常在广阔的草原上自由漫游以寻找食物。

robbery.s: The police are investigating a robbery that took place at the bank yesterday.
robbery.z: 警方正在调查昨天发生在银行的一起抢劫案。

robust.s: The new teaching method proved robust enough to work well in large classes.
robust.z: 这种新的教学方法被证明足够稳健，在大班教学中也能很好地发挥作用。

rocket.s: The company's profits rocketed after it launched its new product last year.
rocket.z: 该公司去年推出新产品后，利润猛增。

roller.s: She used a roller to paint the wall a bright shade of yellow.
roller.z: 她用滚筒把墙刷成了明亮的黄色。

roman.s: The ancient roman bridge still stands proudly across the narrow river.
roman.z: 那座古老的罗马桥仍然骄傲地横跨在狭窄的河面上。

romantic.s: She enjoys reading romantic novels, but she prefers stories with realistic characters.
romantic.z: 她喜欢读浪漫小说，但她更喜欢人物真实的故事。

rooster.s: The rooster crowed loudly at dawn and woke everyone in the village.
rooster.z: 公鸡在黎明时大声啼叫，吵醒了村里的每一个人。

rotary.s: The rotary engine uses spinning rotors instead of pistons to generate power.
rotary.z: 转子发动机使用旋转的转子而不是活塞来产生动力。

rotation.s: Farmers here change crops in rotation to keep the soil healthy.
rotation.z: 这里的农民轮换种植作物，以保持土壤健康。

rotten.s: The fruit in the fridge had gone rotten, so we threw it away.
rotten.z: 冰箱里的水果已经腐烂了，所以我们把它扔掉了。

rough.s: The road to the village is rough and full of stones.
rough.z: 通往村庄的路崎岖不平，满是石头。

roundabout.s: We took a roundabout route to avoid the heavy traffic downtown.
roundabout.z: 我们绕道而行，以避开市中心的拥堵交通。

rouse.s: The loud music outside finally roused him from a deep sleep.
rouse.z: 外面嘈杂的音乐终于把他从熟睡中唤醒了。

route.s: The driver chose a shorter route to avoid the heavy traffic downtown.
route.z: 司机选择了一条较短的路线以避开市中心的拥堵。

routine.s: She follows a simple morning routine before starting her work each day.
routine.z: 她每天开始工作前都会遵循一个简单的晨间常规。

routinely.s: The nurses routinely check the patients' vital signs every morning before breakfast.
routinely.z: 护士们每天早上在早餐前例行检查病人的生命体征。

royal.s: The royal family attended the ceremony in the capital city yesterday.
royal.z: 昨天，王室成员出席了在首都举行的典礼。

royalty.s: The young singer signed a contract that gives her a share of the royalties from every album sold.
royalty.z: 这位年轻歌手签了一份合同，让她从每张售出的专辑中获得一部分版税。

ruby.s: She wore a necklace with a small ruby in the center.
ruby.z: 她戴着一条中间镶有一颗小红宝石的项链。

ruin.s: The heavy rain ruined our picnic plans, so we stayed indoors all afternoon.
ruin.z: 大雨毁了我们的野餐计划，所以我们整个下午都待在室内。

rule.s: The school has a strict rule against using phones during class.
rule.z: 学校有严格的规定，禁止在上课时使用手机。

ruling.s: The court's ruling surprised everyone who had followed the case closely.
ruling.z: 法院的裁决让所有密切关注此案的人感到惊讶。

rumour.s: A rumour spread quickly that the factory would close, worrying many workers.
rumour.z: 有关工厂将要关闭的谣言迅速传开，令许多工人忧心忡忡。

rupture.s: The pipeline rupture released a huge amount of gas into the air.
rupture.z: 管道破裂导致大量气体泄漏到空气中。

rural.s: Many young people leave rural areas to find better jobs in big cities.
rural.z: 许多年轻人离开农村地区，去大城市寻找更好的工作。

rustle.s: I heard a soft rustle of leaves as the wind moved through the trees.
rustle.z: 当风吹过树林时，我听到树叶轻柔的沙沙声。

ruthless.s: The ruthless coach made the players train for hours without any rest.
ruthless.z: 那位无情的教练让球员们连续训练了几个小时，一刻也不休息。

sacred.s: For many people, family traditions are sacred and must be respected.
sacred.z: 对许多人来说，家庭传统是神圣的，必须受到尊重。

sacrifice.s: Many parents sacrifice their free time to help their children succeed in school.
sacrifice.z: 许多父母牺牲自己的空闲时间来帮助孩子在学校取得成功。

safeguard.s: We must safeguard our personal information when shopping online.
safeguard.z: 网上购物时我们必须保护好自己的个人信息。

sailor.s: The old sailor shared exciting stories about his adventures at sea.
sailor.z: 这位老水手分享了他在海上冒险的精彩故事。

salary.s: She earns a good salary, so she can easily afford her own apartment.
salary.z: 她挣着不错的薪水，所以能轻松负担得起自己的公寓。

saleable.s: The company redesigned its packaging to make the product more saleable in overseas markets.
saleable.z: 公司重新设计了包装，使产品在海外市场更易销售。

sample.s: The researchers collected a small sample of water from the river to test its quality.
sample.z: 研究人员从河里采集了一小份水样来检测水质。

sanction.s: The government decided to impose economic sanctions on the country after negotiations failed.
sanction.z: 谈判失败后，政府决定对该国实施经济制裁。

sardine.s: The small boat was so crowded that we felt like sardines packed in a tin.
sardine.z: 小船太拥挤了，我们感觉就像装在罐头里的沙丁鱼。

satellite.s: The new satellite will help scientists monitor changes in the weather more accurately.
satellite.z: 这颗新卫星将帮助科学家更准确地监测天气变化。

satisfaction.s: She smiled with great satisfaction after finishing all her homework before dinner.
satisfaction.z: 她在晚饭前完成所有作业后，满意地笑了。

satisfactorily.s: She answered every question satisfactorily, so the interview went smoothly.
satisfactorily.z: 她圆满地回答了每个问题，所以面试进行得很顺利。

satisfactory.s: The teacher said my essay was satisfactory, though it still needed a few small improvements.
satisfactory.z: 老师说我的文章还算令人满意，不过仍需要做一些小的改进。

saturation.s: Market saturation forced the company to look for customers in other countries.
saturation.z: 市场饱和迫使该公司到其他国家寻找客户。

saturn.s: Saturn is the second largest planet in our solar system.
saturn.z: 土星是我们太阳系中第二大的行星。

saucer.s: She placed the hot cup on a small saucer and carried it to the table.
saucer.z: 她把热杯子放在一个小茶碟上，端到了桌边。

saving.s: She opened a saving account to put aside money for her future studies abroad.
saving.z: 她开了一个储蓄账户，为将来出国留学存钱。

saw.s: She saw an old friend at the supermarket and stopped to chat.
saw.z: 她在超市看到一位老朋友，便停下来聊天。

scaffolding.s: The workers put up scaffolding around the building before they began repairing the roof.
scaffolding.z: 工人们在开始修理屋顶之前在大楼周围搭起了脚手架。

scale.s: The company plans to scale up production to meet the growing demand.
scale.z: 公司计划扩大生产以满足日益增长的需求。

scan.s: She scanned the document carefully before signing her name at the bottom.
scan.z: 她在底部签名之前仔细地扫视了这份文件。

scandal.s: The financial scandal forced the manager to resign from his position immediately.
scandal.z: 这起财务丑闻迫使那位经理立即辞去职务。

scarcely.s: She had scarcely finished her homework when the power went out.
scarcely.z: 她刚做完作业，电就停了。

scarcity.s: The scarcity of clean water in many regions forces people to travel long distances daily.
scarcity.z: 许多地区清洁水源的稀缺迫使人们每天长途跋涉。

scarlet.s: She wore a scarlet dress to the party and everyone noticed her immediately.
scarlet.z: 她穿着一条猩红色的连衣裙去参加聚会，每个人立刻都注意到了她。

scary.s: Walking alone through the dark forest at night was a truly scary experience.
scary.z: 夜晚独自穿过黑暗的森林是一次真正可怕的经历。

scatter.s: The strong wind scattered the dry leaves all over the quiet campus.
scatter.z: 大风把干枯的树叶吹散到安静的校园各处。

scenery.s: We stopped the car to admire the beautiful scenery along the mountain road.
scenery.z: 我们停下车，欣赏着山路沿途美丽的风景。

scent.s: The fresh scent of coffee filled the small kitchen every morning.
scent.z: 每天早上，咖啡的清新香味弥漫着这个小厨房。

schedule.s: She checked her schedule to see when the meeting would start.
schedule.z: 她查看了自己的日程安排，看会议什么时候开始。

scheme.s: The government has introduced a new scheme to help young people find jobs.
scheme.z: 政府推出了一项新计划来帮助年轻人找到工作。

scholar.s: The young scholar spent years studying ancient texts in the library.
scholar.z: 这位年轻的学者花了数年时间在图书馆研究古代文献。

scholarship.s: She worked hard to win a scholarship that would cover her tuition fees.
scholarship.z: 她努力学习，赢得了一份可以支付学费的奖学金。

scientific.s: The scientific evidence clearly shows that regular exercise improves both mental and physical health.
scientific.z: 科学证据清楚地表明，经常锻炼能改善身心健康。

scoff.s: Some students scoff at the idea of studying every night, but good grades reward consistent effort.
scoff.z: 有些学生嘲笑每晚学习的想法，但好成绩会回报持续的努力。

scold.s: His mother scolded him for coming home late again last night.
scold.z: 他妈妈因为他又回家晚了而责骂了他。

scoop.s: She used a small spoon to scoop some sugar into her coffee.
scoop.z: 她用一把小勺舀了一些糖放进咖啡里。

scope.s: The new policy greatly expands the scope of medical care for elderly people.
scope.z: 新政策大大扩大了老年人医疗保健的范围。

scorch.s: The hot sun scorched the grass in the garden during the long summer.
scorch.z: 在漫长的夏天里，烈日把花园里的草晒焦了。

score.s: She worked hard all semester and finally got a high score on the final exam.
score.z: 她整个学期都很努力，终于在期末考试中取得了高分。

scorn.s: She looked at his cheap excuse with scorn and refused to believe a word of it.
scorn.z: 她轻蔑地看着他廉价的借口，一个字都不肯相信。

scrap.s: He wrote the address on a scrap of paper and put it in his pocket.
scrap.z: 他把地址写在一小片纸上，然后放进了口袋。

script.s: She read the script carefully before the audition and memorized every line.
script.z: 她在试镜前仔细阅读了剧本，并记住了每一句台词。

scripture.s: She reads a passage from scripture every morning before starting her work.
scripture.z: 她每天早上开始工作前都会读一段经文。

scrutiny.s: The new policy has come under close scrutiny from both the public and the media.
scrutiny.z: 这项新政策受到了公众和媒体的严密审查。

sculpture.s: The museum recently displayed a beautiful sculpture made entirely of recycled glass.
sculpture.z: 博物馆最近展出了一件完全由回收玻璃制成的精美雕塑。

seam.s: She noticed a small tear along the seam of her jacket and decided to fix it.
seam.z: 她注意到夹克接缝处有个小裂口，决定把它补好。

seaport.s: The city grew rapidly because its seaport made trade with other countries easy.
seaport.z: 这座城市迅速发展，因为它的海港使与其他国家的贸易变得容易。

seasick.s: She felt seasick during the ferry ride and spent most of the trip on deck.
seasick.z: 她在渡轮上感到晕船，大部分时间都待在甲板上。

seaside.s: We spent the whole afternoon walking along the seaside and enjoying the fresh air.
seaside.z: 我们整个下午都沿着海边散步，享受着新鲜的空气。

secretary.s: The secretary quickly arranged all the documents before the important meeting started.
secretary.z: 秘书在重要会议开始前迅速整理好了所有文件。

section.s: Please read the first section of the report before the meeting.
section.z: 请在会议前阅读报告的第一部分。

sector.s: The technology sector has created thousands of new jobs for young graduates.
sector.z: 科技行业为年轻毕业生创造了数千个新工作岗位。

secure.s: She worked hard to secure a good job before graduation.
secure.z: 她在毕业前努力工作以确保找到一份好工作。

security.s: Many students worry about the security of their personal data when shopping online.
security.z: 许多学生在网上购物时担心个人数据的安全。

seed.s: The farmer planted seeds in the field after the spring rain.
seed.z: 春雨过后，农民在田里播下了种子。

seek.s: Many graduates seek advice from their professors before applying for jobs.
seek.z: 许多毕业生在求职前会向教授寻求建议。

seemingly.s: The task seemed simple at first, but it was seemingly impossible to finish on time.
seemingly.z: 这项任务起初看起来很简单，但似乎不可能按时完成。

segment.s: The company divided the market into several segments to serve different customers better.
segment.z: 公司把市场划分为几个细分市场，以便更好地服务不同的客户。

segregation.s: The new law aims to end segregation in public schools across the country.
segregation.z: 这项新法律旨在结束全国公立学校中的种族隔离。

seize.s: She seized the chance to ask the manager a few questions before the meeting ended.
seize.z: 她在会议结束前抓住了机会向经理问了几个问题。

select.s: Students may select up to three elective courses before the end of the week.
select.z: 学生们可以在本周末之前选择最多三门选修课。

selection.s: The selection of qualified candidates for the scholarship was based on both grades and interviews.
selection.z: 奖学金合格人选的选拔基于成绩和面试两方面。

selective.s: She is very selective about the friends she spends her free time with.
selective.z: 她对一起度过空闲时间的朋友非常挑剔。

selfish.s: It is selfish to keep all the information to yourself instead of sharing it with the team.
selfish.z: 把所有信息都留给自己而不与团队分享是自私的。

semester.s: She worked hard during the semester and passed all her final exams.
semester.z: 她在这个学期努力学习，通过了所有期末考试。

semiconductor.s: The factory produces semiconductors used in almost every electronic device today.
semiconductor.z: 这家工厂生产的半导体如今被用于几乎每一种电子设备中。

senate.s: The senate voted to approve the new budget after a long debate.
senate.z: 参议院在长时间辩论后投票批准了新的预算。

senator.s: The senator promised to support the new education bill during the meeting.
senator.z: 那位参议员在会议上承诺支持新的教育法案。

senior.s: My senior advised me to start preparing for the exam early.
senior.z: 我的学姐建议我早点开始准备考试。

sensational.s: The newspaper published a sensational story that shocked readers across the country.
sensational.z: 这家报纸刊登了一篇耸人听闻的报道，震惊了全国读者。

senseless.s: Criticizing him without knowing the full story would be a senseless act.
senseless.z: 在不了解全部真相的情况下批评他，将是一种不明智的行为。

sensible.s: It is sensible to save some money each month for unexpected expenses.
sensible.z: 每个月存一些钱以应对意外开支是明智的。

sensitivity.s: Her sensitivity to criticism makes it hard for her to accept feedback at work.
sensitivity.z: 她对批评很敏感，这使她很难在工作中接受反馈。

sensor.s: The small sensor in the phone detects changes in light and adjusts the screen brightness.
sensor.z: 手机里的小型传感器能检测光线的变化并调节屏幕亮度。

sentiment.s: Public sentiment turned against the new policy after prices rose sharply.
sentiment.z: 物价大幅上涨后，公众情绪转而反对这项新政策。

separate.s: The teacher asked us to separate the mixed waste into different bins.
separate.z: 老师让我们把混合的垃圾分到不同的垃圾桶里。

separately.s: The teacher asked us to hand in our essays separately so she could grade them faster.
separately.z: 老师让我们分别上交作文，这样她可以更快地批改。

sequence.s: Please follow the steps in the correct sequence to avoid mistakes.
sequence.z: 请按照正确的顺序执行这些步骤，以免出错。

series.s: The professor gave a series of lectures on climate change last semester.
series.z: 上学期教授做了一系列关于气候变化的讲座。

sermon.s: The old pastor delivered a powerful sermon about forgiveness that moved everyone in the church.
sermon.z: 那位年长的牧师发表了一篇关于宽恕的感人布道，打动了教堂里的每一个人。

serpent.s: The serpent slid silently through the tall grass before disappearing into the shadows.
serpent.z: 那条蛇悄无声息地滑过高高的草丛，随后消失在阴影中。

server.s: The server brought our drinks quickly and smiled at everyone at the table.
server.z: 服务员很快端来了我们的饮料，并对桌旁的每个人微笑。

session.s: The students spent the whole afternoon in a study session for the final exam.
session.z: 学生们整个下午都在为期末考试进行学习讨论。

setback.s: Losing the scholarship was a serious setback, but she refused to give up her studies.
setback.z: 失去奖学金是一次严重的挫折，但她拒绝放弃学业。

settle.s: After graduation, she decided to settle in a small coastal town and start her career.
settle.z: 毕业后，她决定在一个沿海小镇定居并开始自己的职业生涯。

settlement.s: After months of talks, the two sides finally reached a peaceful settlement of the dispute.
settlement.z: 经过数月的谈判，双方终于达成了争端的和平解决。

severe.s: The severe storm forced the school to close for two days.
severe.z: 这场严重的暴风雨迫使学校停课两天。

severity.s: Doctors were shocked by the severity of his injuries after the accident.
severity.z: 事故发生后，医生们对他伤势的严重程度感到震惊。

sexism.s: The new manager promised to fight sexism and ensure equal pay for all employees.
sexism.z: 新经理承诺打击性别歧视，并确保所有员工获得同等的薪酬。

sexual.s: The school offers sexual health education to help students make safe choices.
sexual.z: 学校提供性健康教育，帮助学生做出安全的选择。

shade.s: We sat in the shade of a large tree to escape the summer heat.
shade.z: 我们坐在一棵大树的树荫下躲避夏日的炎热。

shadowy.s: She saw a shadowy figure standing quietly at the end of the empty street.
shadowy.z: 她看见一个模糊的身影静静地站在空荡的街道尽头。

shady.s: We sat under a shady tree to escape the strong afternoon sun.
shady.z: 我们坐在树荫下躲避午后强烈的阳光。

sham.s: The company's promise to protect the environment turned out to be a complete sham.
sham.z: 该公司保护环境的承诺最终被证明完全是个骗局。

shameful.s: It is shameful that some students cheat on exams to get higher grades.
shameful.z: 有些学生为了取得更高的分数而在考试中作弊，这真是可耻。

shareholder.s: Every shareholder has the right to vote at the annual meeting of the company.
shareholder.z: 每位股东都有权在公司的年度大会上投票。

shark.s: The lifeguard warned swimmers that a shark had been seen near the beach.
shark.z: 救生员警告游泳者，有人在海滩附近看到了一条鲨鱼。

sharply.s: The price of fresh vegetables rose sharply after the heavy storm hit the region.
sharply.z: 暴雨袭击该地区后，新鲜蔬菜的价格急剧上涨。

shatter.s: The loud crash of breaking glass shattered the quiet peace of the entire neighborhood.
shatter.z: 玻璃破碎的巨大声响打破了整个街区的宁静。

shear.s: The farmer used large machines to shear the sheep before the hot summer arrived.
shear.z: 农民在炎热的夏天到来之前用大型机器给绵羊剪毛。

shed.s: The company decided to shed several outdated products to focus on new ideas.
shed.z: 公司决定淘汰几款过时的产品，以便专注于新的想法。

shelf.s: She placed the heavy books on the top shelf where her children could not reach them.
shelf.z: 她把那些沉重的书放在孩子们够不到的最上层架子上。

sheriff.s: The sheriff warned residents to stay indoors during the severe storm.
sheriff.z: 治安官警告居民在强风暴期间待在室内。

shift.s: Public attitudes toward online learning have shifted dramatically over the past few years.
shift.z: 过去几年里，公众对在线学习的态度发生了巨大转变。

shipbuilding.s: The country's shipbuilding industry has grown rapidly, creating thousands of new jobs along the coast.
shipbuilding.z: 该国的造船业发展迅速，在沿海地区创造了数千个新工作岗位。

shipment.s: The store expects a new shipment of winter coats to arrive before the weekend.
shipment.z: 这家商店预计新一批冬季外套会在周末前到货。

shipwreck.s: Divers explored the ancient shipwreck and found many well-preserved objects on the ocean floor.
shipwreck.z: 潜水员探索了那艘古代沉船，在海底发现了许多保存完好的物品。

shock.s: The sudden news of his failure came as a great shock to the whole family.
shock.z: 他失败的突然消息让全家人都大为震惊。

shore.s: We walked along the shore and watched the waves gently reach the sand.
shore.z: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着海浪轻轻拍打到沙滩上。

shortage.s: The city faces a serious shortage of clean water during the dry season.
shortage.z: 在旱季，这座城市面临严重的清洁水短缺。

shortcut.s: Taking a shortcut through the park saved me ten minutes on my way to class.
shortcut.z: 穿过公园抄近路让我去上课省了十分钟。

shorten.s: The new highway will shorten the journey between the two cities by nearly an hour.
shorten.z: 这条新高速公路将使两座城市之间的路程缩短近一个小时。

shove.s: He shoved the heavy box into the corner and wiped his hands.
shove.z: 他把沉重的箱子推到角落里，然后擦了擦手。

shovel.s: The old man used a shovel to clear the snow from his driveway.
shovel.z: 那位老人用铲子清除车道上的积雪。

showmanship.s: Her showmanship on stage made the simple speech unforgettable.
showmanship.z: 她在舞台上的表演技巧让这场简单的演讲令人难忘。

shrank.s: The company's profits shrank sharply last year because of falling demand.
shrank.z: 由于需求下降，公司去年的利润大幅缩水。

shrewd.s: She made a shrewd decision to save part of her salary every month.
shrewd.z: 她做了一个精明的决定，每个月存下一部分工资。

shriek.s: She let out a loud shriek when she saw the spider on the floor.
shriek.z: 她看到地板上的蜘蛛时发出了一声尖叫。

shrill.s: Her shrill voice cut through the quiet room and made everyone look up.
shrill.z: 她刺耳的嗓音划破了安静的教室，让所有人都抬起了头。

shrine.s: Every spring, many families visit the small shrine near the river to pray for good luck.
shrine.z: 每年春天，许多家庭都会去河边的小神殿祈求好运。

shrink.s: The company's profits began to shrink after several major competitors entered the market.
shrink.z: 几家主要竞争对手进入市场后，公司的利润开始缩水。

shutter.s: She closed the shutter before the storm to keep the rain out.
shutter.z: 暴风雨来临前，她关上了百叶窗，以防雨水进来。

sieve.s: She used a sieve to separate the flour from the larger lumps.
sieve.z: 她用筛子把面粉和较大的结块分离开来。

sift.s: She spent the afternoon sifting through old photos to find one for the family album.
sift.z: 她花了一下午翻找旧照片，想为家庭相册挑一张。

sight.s: The mountain village is a beautiful sight in the early morning light.
sight.z: 这座山村在清晨的阳光下是一道美丽的景色。

sign.s: Please sign your name at the bottom of the form before you leave.
sign.z: 离开之前，请在表格底部签上你的名字。

signal.s: The teacher gave a signal, and the students stopped talking immediately.
signal.z: 老师发出一个信号，学生们立刻停止了交谈。

signature.s: Please write your signature at the bottom of the contract before we proceed.
signature.z: 请在我们继续之前，在合同底部写上您的签名。

significance.s: Many students underestimate the significance of regular review before final exams.
significance.z: 许多学生低估了期末考试前定期复习的重要性。

significant.s: The new policy has brought significant changes to the way students learn English.
significant.z: 这项新政策给学生的英语学习方式带来了重大变化。

silence.s: The sudden silence in the classroom made everyone feel a little nervous.
silence.z: 教室里突如其来的寂静让每个人都感到有些紧张。

silly.s: It was silly of me to forget my umbrella on such a rainy day.
silly.z: 在这样一个雨天忘记带伞，我真是太傻了。

similarity.s: There is a clear similarity between the two brothers in both appearance and personality.
similarity.z: 这两兄弟在外貌和性格上都有明显的相似之处。

similarly.s: The second experiment failed, and similarly, the third one produced no useful results.
similarly.z: 第二个实验失败了，同样地，第三个实验也没有产生有用的结果。

simplicity.s: The simplicity of her design made the device easy for anyone to use.
simplicity.z: 她设计的简洁性使这个设备任何人都能轻松使用。

simplify.s: The new software helps us simplify complex tasks and save hours of work.
simplify.z: 这款新软件帮助我们简化复杂的任务，节省数小时的工作时间。

simply.s: She simply forgot to bring her notebook to class this morning.
simply.z: 她今天早上只是忘了把笔记本带到教室。

simultaneously.s: She listened to music while simultaneously finishing her homework before dinner.
simultaneously.z: 她一边听音乐，一边在晚饭前完成了作业。

sincere.s: Her sincere apology convinced everyone that she truly regretted the mistake.
sincere.z: 她真诚的道歉让每个人都相信她确实为这个错误感到后悔。

sincerity.s: Her sincerity during the conversation made everyone feel comfortable and willing to share their own stories.
sincerity.z: 她在交谈中的真诚让每个人都感到自在，并愿意分享自己的故事。

singular.s: The teacher noticed a singular error in the report that everyone else had missed.
singular.z: 老师注意到报告中有一个其他人都没发现的独特错误。

sink.s: The dishes piled up in the sink after the family finished dinner.
sink.z: 一家人吃完晚饭后，盘子堆积在水槽里。

sip.s: She took a small sip of hot tea before answering the question.
sip.z: 回答问题前，她小口喝了一点热茶。

siren.s: The fire truck's siren woke the whole neighborhood late at night.
siren.z: 深夜，消防车的警报器吵醒了整个街区的居民。

site.s: The city plans to build a new sports site near the river next year.
site.z: 市政府计划明年在河边建一个新的体育场地。

situated.s: The new library is situated in the center of the campus.
situated.z: 新图书馆位于校园的中心。

skilled.s: She is a highly skilled engineer who solves complex problems quickly.
skilled.z: 她是一位技术高超的工程师，能迅速解决复杂的问题。

skillful.s: She is a skillful teacher who explains difficult ideas in simple ways.
skillful.z: 她是一位技术娴熟的老师，能用简单的方式解释复杂的观点。

skip.s: She decided to skip breakfast and go straight to the library.
skip.z: 她决定不吃早饭，直接去图书馆。

skyrocket.s: Housing prices in big cities have skyrocketed over the past decade, making it hard for young people to buy homes.
skyrocket.z: 过去十年间，大城市的房价飞涨，使年轻人很难买得起房子。

skyscraper.s: The new skyscraper downtown is so tall that it seems to touch the clouds.
skyscraper.z: 市中心的新摩天大楼高得似乎能触到云层。

slack.s: The rope around the boat was too slack to hold it securely.
slack.z: 船周围的绳子太松了，无法牢固地固定住它。

slander.s: She threatened to sue the newspaper for slander after it published the false story.
slander.z: 那家报纸刊登虚假报道后，她威胁要以诽谤罪起诉该报。

slang.s: Many students use slang with friends but avoid it in formal writing.
slang.z: 许多学生和朋友聊天时使用俚语，但在正式写作中会避免使用。

slave.s: Many workers felt like slaves to their demanding schedules and endless tasks.
slave.z: 许多工人觉得自己像是繁重日程和无休止任务的奴隶。

slavery.s: Slavery was finally abolished after centuries of struggle by brave activists.
slavery.z: 经过勇敢的活动家们几个世纪的斗争，奴隶制最终被废除了。

slice.s: She cut a thin slice of bread and spread some butter on it.
slice.z: 她切了一片薄薄的面包，并在上面涂了些黄油。

slick.s: The salesman's slick manner made everyone suspicious of his offer.
slick.z: 那个推销员圆滑的举止让每个人都对他的提议起了疑心。

slight.s: There was a slight delay in the train schedule this morning.
slight.z: 今天早上火车时刻表有轻微的延误。

slightly.s: The weather today is slightly colder than it was yesterday morning.
slightly.z: 今天天气比昨天早上稍微冷了一点。

slim.s: She has been exercising every morning to stay slim and healthy.
slim.z: 她每天早上锻炼，以保持苗条和健康。

slippery.s: Be careful when you walk on the wet floor because it is very slippery.
slippery.z: 走在这湿漉漉的地板上要小心，因为它非常滑。

slumber.z: 音乐一响起，婴儿便陷入了沉睡。

slump.s: Sales slumped sharply after the company raised its prices last month.
slump.z: 上个月公司提价后，销售额急剧下滑。

snack.s: She usually has a light snack between lunch and dinner to avoid feeling hungry.
snack.z: 她通常在午餐和晚餐之间吃点零食，以免感到饥饿。

sneak.z: 她试图在没人注意的情况下偷偷溜出会议。

social.z: 花太多时间上网会损害你的社交生活和学业。

socialist.z: 许多年轻人认为社会主义社会应当关爱穷人和老年人。

socialize.z: 学生们上午的课结束后，常常在校园咖啡馆与同学交往。

sole.z: 她是负责管理整个项目的唯一责任人。

solely.z: 这一决定完全基于审判期间提供的证据。

solicitor.z: 她在签署合同之前请她的律师审阅了该合同。

soluble.z: 这种药易溶于水，所以你可以用一杯冷水送服。

solution.z: 经过几个小时的讨论，团队终于找到了一个简单的问题解决方案。

somehow.s: She lost her keys somewhere in the house and somehow managed to find them before dinner.
somehow.z: 她把钥匙丢在房子的某个地方，但不知怎么在晚饭前找到了。

sophisticated.z: 她对危机期间市场的表现形成了深刻而复杂的理解。

sort.z: 她花了一下午时间整理桌上的所有文件。

spatial.z: 孩子们通过玩积木和拼图来发展空间意识。

spectacular.z: 日落时分从山顶看到的景色真是壮观。

speculate.z: 许多学生在考试成绩正式公布之前就对其进行了猜测。

sponsor.z: 今年有几家本地公司同意赞助学生科学展。

spontaneous.z: 她临时决定参加这次旅行，让我们大家都很惊讶。

sportsman.z: 这位年轻的运动员每天训练数小时以提高跑步速度。

spouse.z: 她经常和配偶讨论如何平衡工作与家庭生活。

spring.z: 新鲜的蔬菜和干净的水从这片山谷肥沃的土壤中涌出。

spy.z: 她怀疑她的邻居可能是竞争对手公司的一名间谍。

squalor.z: 难民们逃离家园后被迫生活在肮脏的环境中。

square.z: 孩子们在旧图书馆前的广场上快乐地玩耍。

squash.z: 她试图用卷起的报纸把那只蜘蛛压扁。

squat.z: 比赛开始前，她不得不蹲下来系鞋带。

squeeze.z: 她不得不挤过拥挤的走廊才能准时到达教室。

stability.z: 规律的锻炼和均衡的饮食能改善身体和心理的稳定性。

stabilize.z: 医生给了他一些药，以便在手术后稳定他的血压。

stable.s: Children need a stable and loving home in order to grow up healthy.
stable.z: 孩子们需要一个稳定而充满爱的家庭才能健康成长。

staff.z: 酒店员工很友好，帮我们把行李搬到了房间。

stage.z: 这个项目仍处于早期阶段，需要更多的研究。

stain.z: 她努力想去除白衬衫上的咖啡渍。

stainless.z: 她买了一个不锈钢水壶，应该能用很多年。

stairway.z: 她匆匆走下狭窄的楼梯，去赶回家的末班车。

stake.z: 她与这个项目的成功有着切身利害关系，因为她的事业取决于此。

stalk.z: 猎人悄悄地在茂密的森林里跟踪那头鹿长达数小时。

standardize.z: 公司决定统一其测试程序以提高产品质量。

stare.z: 她盯着屏幕看了几个小时，试图解决这个难题。

startup.z: 毕业后她加入了一家小型初创公司，并很快学会了如何处理许多不同的任务。

starve.z: 如果自然环境被人类活动破坏，许多野生动物可能会饿死。

statement.z: 警方要求目击者就那晚发生的事情作出明确的陈述。

statesman.z: 这位年长的政治家发表了关于和平与合作的强有力的演讲。

statistic.z: 一项令人惊讶的统计数据显示，大多数学生每晚睡眠不足七小时。

statistical.z: 研究人员使用统计方法分析了五百多名学生的调查数据。

statistics.s: The latest statistics show that more students are choosing to study abroad.
statistics.z: 最新的统计数据显示，越来越多的学生选择出国留学。

status.z: 她作为团队负责人的身份使她有權做出最终决定。

steady.z: 她在英语上稳步的进步给了她参加考试的信心。

steamer.z: 她用蒸锅烹饪新鲜蔬菜，以保留其中的所有维生素。

steep.z: 上山的那条陡峭小路让我们完全喘不过气来。

steer.z: 她试图把谈话引开，避开那个令人尴尬的话题。

stereo.z: 她把音响调大，和朋友们在客厅里跳舞。

stern.z: 我们上课迟到时，老师严厉地看了我们一眼。

stew.z: 我妈妈喜欢用土豆和胡萝卜炖牛肉当晚餐。

sticky.z: 我用湿布擦了两遍后，厨房地板仍然黏黏的。

stiffness.z: 长时间坐着之后，定期拉伸可以减轻肌肉僵硬。

stillness.z: 她坐在湖边，享受着清晨完美的宁静。

stimulate.z: 阅读有趣的书籍能激发孩子们对周围世界的好奇心。

stimulus.z: 新政策为农村地区的经济增长提供了强有力的刺激。

stock.z: 寒冷季节到来之前，这家商店储备了大量冬装。

stockbroker.z: 股市崩盘前，这位股票经纪人建议客户卖出股票。

storage.z: 我们需要更多的存储空间来保存这些旧文件和文档。

store.s: We store extra chairs and boxes in the small room upstairs.
store.z: 我们把多余的椅子和箱子存放在楼上的小房间里。

strain.z: 长时间工作给她的健康和家庭生活带来了严重的负担。

stranger.z: 在新办公室里，她感觉自己像个陌生人，直到同事们邀请她一起吃午饭。

strategic.z: 公司做出了一个战略性的决定，加大对可再生能源的投资。

straw.z: 她用纸吸管喝果汁，以帮助保护环境。

stream.z: 一条小溪静静地流过我们校园后面的绿色山谷。

strength.s: Regular exercise can improve both your physical strength and your mental health.
strength.z: 经常锻炼可以增强你的体力和改善心理健康。
