subdivide.z: 老师把大班分成了四个更小的组来完成这个项目。

subdivision.s: The city is divided into several subdivisions, each with its own schools and parks.
subdivision.z: 这座城市被划分为几个分区，每个分区都有自己的学校和公园。

subdue.s: The firefighters worked for hours to subdue the flames before the wind could spread them.
subdue.z: 消防员奋战数小时才压制住火焰，以防风势将其蔓延。

subject.s: The teacher asked every student to choose a subject they truly enjoy studying.
subject.z: 老师要求每个学生选择一门他们真正喜欢学习的科目。

submit.s: Students must submit their essays before the deadline on Friday.
submit.z: 学生必须在周五截止日期前提交他们的论文。

subscribe.s: Many students subscribe to several online learning platforms to improve their English skills.
subscribe.z: 许多学生订阅了几个在线学习平台来提高他们的英语水平。

subscript.s: In the chemical formula, the number of hydrogen atoms is shown by a small subscript.
subscript.z: 在化学式中，氢原子的数量由一个小下标表示。

subscription.s: She cancelled her monthly subscription because she rarely used the service.
subscription.z: 她取消了每月的订阅，因为她很少使用这项服务。

subsequent.s: The first meeting set clear goals, and subsequent discussions focused on how to achieve them.
subsequent.z: 第一次会议设定了明确的目标，随后的讨论则聚焦于如何实现这些目标。

subsequently.s: The company changed its marketing strategy, and sales subsequently increased by twenty percent.
subsequently.z: 公司改变了营销策略，随后销售额增长了百分之二十。

subsidiary.s: The company opened a subsidiary in another city to expand its business.
subsidiary.z: 这家公司在另一个城市开设了一家子公司以扩展业务。

subsidize.s: The government plans to subsidize public transport to reduce air pollution in cities.
subsidize.z: 政府计划补贴公共交通，以减少城市的空气污染。

subsidy.s: The government provides a subsidy to help low-income families pay for heating in winter.
subsidy.z: 政府提供补贴，帮助低收入家庭支付冬季取暖费用。

substantial.s: The new policy brought substantial improvements to public transportation in the city.
substantial.z: 新政策给城市的公共交通带来了显著的改善。

substitute.s: You can substitute honey for sugar in this simple recipe.
substitute.z: 在这个简单的食谱中，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtle.s: She noticed a subtle change in his tone that suggested he was worried.
subtle.z: 她注意到他的语气中有一丝细微的变化，表明他在担心。

suburb.s: They moved to a quiet suburb because the city center was too noisy.
suburb.z: 他们搬到了一个安静的郊区，因为市中心太吵了。

suburban.s: Many young couples move to suburban areas because housing there is much cheaper.
suburban.z: 许多年轻夫妇搬到郊区，因为那里的住房便宜得多。

succeeding.s: Succeeding in a competitive job market requires both strong skills and careful preparation.
succeeding.z: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中取得成功既需要过硬技能，也需要充分准备。

succession.s: The rapid succession of storms damaged many houses along the coast.
succession.z: 接连不断的暴风雨损坏了沿海的许多房屋。

successive.s: The team won three successive games and moved to the top of the league.
successive.z: 这支球队连续赢了三场比赛，跃居联赛榜首。

successively.s: She passed the three exams successively and finally earned her certificate.
successively.z: 她连续通过了三场考试，最终获得了证书。

successor.s: The new manager proved to be a worthy successor to her popular predecessor.
successor.z: 这位新经理证明自己是深受欢迎的前任的合格继任者。

suck.s: The new vacuum cleaner really sucks up all the dust on the carpet.
suck.z: 这台新吸尘器确实能把地毯上的灰尘全部吸干净。

suffer.s: Many students suffer from stress before important exams and need more support.
suffer.z: 许多学生在重要考试前会承受压力，需要更多支持。

sufficient.s: The evidence was not sufficient to prove that he had committed the crime.
sufficient.z: 证据不足以证明他犯了罪。

suggestion.s: Her suggestion that we start the meeting earlier was accepted by everyone.
suggestion.z: 她提出的早点开始会议的建议被大家接受了。

suit.s: This dark blue suit fits him perfectly for the job interview.
suit.z: 这套深蓝色西装非常适合他参加求职面试。

suite.s: She booked a suite with a beautiful view of the harbor for her parents' anniversary.
suite.z: 她为父母的结婚纪念日预订了一间可以欣赏美丽海港景色的套房。

sullen.s: After losing the game, he sat alone in a sullen silence for the rest of the evening.
sullen.z: 输掉比赛后，他独自闷闷不乐地坐着，整个晚上一言不发。

sulphur.s: Burning coal releases sulphur into the air, which can harm the environment.
sulphur.z: 燃烧煤炭会向空气中释放硫，这可能对环境造成危害。

summarize.s: Please summarize the main points of the article in your own words.
summarize.z: 请用你自己的话总结这篇文章的要点。

summit.s: After months of planning, the team finally reached the summit of the mountain.
summit.z: 经过数月的计划，团队终于到达了山顶。

superb.s: The hotel offered superb service, and every guest felt genuinely welcome.
superb.z: 这家酒店提供了极佳的服务，每位客人都感到由衷的欢迎。

superior.s: Her superior knowledge of the subject impressed everyone at the meeting.
superior.z: 她对该学科更深入的了解给会上的每个人留下了深刻印象。

superiority.s: Some students feel a sense of superiority simply because they own the latest smartphone.
superiority.z: 有些学生仅仅因为拥有最新款智能手机就感到一种优越感。

supersonic.s: The new supersonic jet can cross the ocean in just a few hours.
supersonic.z: 这架新型超音速喷气机只需几个小时就能飞越大洋。

superstition.s: Many old superstitions about luck still influence how people behave today.
superstition.z: 许多关于运气的古老迷信至今仍影响着人们的行为方式。

supervise.s: A senior teacher was asked to supervise the students during their final examination.
supervise.z: 一位资深教师被安排在学生期末考试期间进行监考。

supervision.s: Children need close supervision when they play near busy roads.
supervision.z: 孩子们在繁忙的道路附近玩耍时需要密切的看护。

supervisor.s: My supervisor asked me to finish the report before Friday.
supervisor.z: 我的导师要求我在周五之前完成报告。

supplement.s: Many students take a part-time job to supplement their income while studying at college.
supplement.z: 许多学生在大学学习期间做兼职来补充收入。

supplementary.s: The teacher gave us supplementary materials to help us prepare for the exam.
supplementary.z: 老师给了我们补充材料来帮助我们备考。

supply.s: The company must supply enough food and water to all the workers every day.
supply.z: 公司必须每天为所有工人供应足够的食物和水。

support.s: My parents always support my decision to study abroad after graduation.
support.z: 父母总是支持我毕业后出国留学的决定。

suppress.s: She tried hard to suppress her laughter during the serious meeting.
suppress.z: 在严肃的会议上，她努力忍住不笑。

supreme.s: The court holds supreme authority in interpreting the constitution and settling legal disputes.
supreme.z: 法院在解释宪法和解决法律纠纷方面拥有最高权威。

surgeon.s: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before the operation began.
surgeon.z: 外科医生在手术开始前仔细地洗了手。

surgery.s: After the surgery, she stayed in the hospital for three days to recover.
surgery.z: 手术后，她在医院住了三天以恢复健康。

surgical.s: The patient recovered quickly after a successful surgical operation on his knee.
surgical.z: 病人在膝盖手术成功后恢复得很快。

surpass.s: She worked hard every day and finally surpassed all her classmates in the final exam.
surpass.z: 她每天努力学习，最终在期末考试中超过了所有同学。

surround.s: Tall trees surround the small lake, making it a peaceful place to study.
surround.z: 高大的树木环绕着这个小湖，使它成为一个适合学习的宁静之地。

surrounding.s: The surrounding hills protect the small village from strong winter winds.
surrounding.z: 周围的山丘保护着这个小村庄免受强烈冬季风的侵袭。

surroundings.s: The quiet surroundings of the library help students focus on their studies.
surroundings.z: 图书馆安静的环境有助于学生专注于学习。

survival.s: Clean water is essential for the survival of every living creature on earth.
survival.z: 清洁的水对地球上每一个生物的生存都至关重要。

survivor.s: The only survivor of the accident was treated in hospital for minor injuries.
survivor.z: 这次事故的唯一幸存者在医院接受了轻伤治疗。

suspect.s: The police suspect that he stole the money from the office.
suspect.z: 警方怀疑他从办公室里偷了钱。

suspend.s: The airline decided to suspend all flights during the heavy storm.
suspend.z: 航空公司决定在暴风雨期间暂停所有航班。

suspension.s: The school announced a temporary suspension of classes after the heavy snowstorm.
suspension.z: 暴风雪过后，学校宣布暂时停课。

suspicion.s: She felt a sudden suspicion that her roommate had read her private diary.
suspicion.z: 她突然怀疑室友看过她的私人日记。

suspicious.s: The police became suspicious when the man gave several different answers to the same question.
suspicious.z: 当那名男子对同一个问题给出几个不同的答案时，警方起了疑心。

sustain.s: She could not sustain her attention on the lecture for more than ten minutes.
sustain.z: 她无法把注意力集中在讲座上超过十分钟。

sustainable.s: We need sustainable solutions to reduce waste and protect natural resources for future generations.
sustainable.z: 我们需要可持续的解决方案来减少浪费，并为子孙后代保护自然资源。

swallow.s: She had to swallow her pride and ask her classmates for help with the project.
swallow.z: 她不得不放下自尊，向同学们寻求项目上的帮助。

swamp.s: Heavy rain turned the low field into a muddy swamp within hours.
swamp.z: 大雨在几个小时内就把低洼的田地变成了一片泥泞的沼泽。

sweater.s: She put on a warm sweater before going out into the cold wind.
sweater.z: 出门迎上寒风之前，她穿上了一件暖和的毛衣。

sweeten.s: A little honey can sweeten the tea without adding too much sugar.
sweeten.z: 加一点蜂蜜可以让茶变甜，而不会添加太多糖。

sweetness.s: The sweetness of the ripe peaches reminded her of summer afternoons at her grandmother's house.
sweetness.z: 熟透的桃子那甜美的滋味让她想起了在祖母家度过的夏日午后。

switch.s: Please switch off the lights before you leave the classroom.
switch.z: 离开教室前请把灯关掉。

symbol.s: The dove is often used as a symbol of peace around the world.
symbol.z: 鸽子在世界各地常被用作和平的象征。

symbolic.s: The old bridge is a symbolic link between the city's past and its future.
symbolic.z: 这座老桥是连接这座城市过去与未来的象征性纽带。

symbolize.s: In many cultures, the white dove symbolizes peace and hope for a better future.
symbolize.z: 在许多文化中，白鸽象征着和平与对更美好未来的希望。

symmetrical.s: The two sides of the building look perfectly symmetrical from the front.
symmetrical.z: 从正面看，这栋建筑的两侧完全对称。

sympathetic.s: My roommate was very sympathetic when I told her about my failed exam.
sympathetic.z: 当我告诉室友我考试没通过时，她非常同情我。

sympathize.s: She could sympathize with his situation because she had faced similar problems before.
sympathize.z: 她能同情他的处境，因为她以前也遇到过类似的问题。

sympathy.s: She felt deep sympathy for the family who lost their home in the fire.
sympathy.z: 她对那家在火灾中失去家园的家庭深表同情。

symphony.s: The whole family enjoyed a wonderful symphony at the concert hall last night.
symphony.z: 昨晚全家人在音乐厅欣赏了一场美妙的交响乐。

synthetic.s: Many everyday products are made from synthetic materials rather than natural ones.
synthetic.z: 许多日常用品是由合成材料制成的，而不是天然材料。

system.s: The new computer system helps students finish their homework more quickly.
system.z: 新的计算机系统帮助学生更快地完成作业。

systematic.s: The researchers carried out a systematic review of all the available evidence.
systematic.z: 研究人员对所有现有证据进行了系统性的审查。

systematical.s: A systematical approach to reviewing notes helps students prepare for exams more efficiently.
systematical.z: 系统化的复习笔记方法能帮助学生更高效地备考。

systematically.s: The researchers systematically recorded every change in temperature throughout the experiment.
systematically.z: 研究人员在整个实验过程中系统地记录了温度的每一次变化。

tabulate.s: The assistant tabulated the survey results and shared them with the whole team.
tabulate.z: 助理将调查结果制成表格，并与整个团队分享。

tackle.s: The new manager decided to tackle the budget problem before the end of the month.
tackle.z: 新经理决定在月底前解决这个预算问题。

tactics.s: The coach changed his tactics in the second half and the team scored twice.
tactics.z: 教练在下半场改变了战术，球队攻入两球。

tag.s: Every item in the store has a small tag showing its price and size.
tag.z: 商店里的每件商品都有一个小标签，标明了价格和尺寸。

tailor.s: The course is tailored to meet the needs of working professionals.
tailor.z: 这门课程是为满足在职专业人士的需求而量身定制的。

talent.s: She has a natural talent for explaining difficult ideas in simple words.
talent.z: 她有把难懂的观点用简单的话解释清楚的天赋。

tangled.s: The wires behind the desk were so tangled that she could not unplug the computer.
tangled.z: 桌子后面的电线缠得太乱了，她无法拔掉电脑的插头。

tap.s: She gently tapped the screen to open the app on her phone.
tap.z: 她轻轻点了点屏幕，打开了手机上的应用。

taper.s: The doctor advised him to taper the dose gradually over several weeks.
taper.z: 医生建议他在几周内逐渐减少剂量。

tar.s: Workers used hot tar to repair the cracks in the road.
tar.z: 工人们用热焦油修补道路上的裂缝。

target.s: The company set a clear target for reducing waste over the next year.
target.z: 公司为明年减少废物设定了一个明确的目标。

tasteless.s: The soup was so tasteless that I added salt and pepper to it.
tasteless.z: 这汤太没味道了，所以我在里面加了盐和胡椒。

tax.s: The new policy will tax wealthy families more heavily than middle-class households.
tax.z: 新政策对富裕家庭的征税将比中产阶级家庭更重。

technical.s: The report explains the technical details in a way that ordinary readers can understand.
technical.z: 这份报告用普通读者能理解的方式解释了技术细节。

technician.s: The technician quickly repaired the broken machine before the factory reopened.
technician.z: 技术员在工厂重新开工前迅速修好了那台坏掉的机器。

technique.s: The teacher showed us a simple technique for remembering new words quickly.
technique.z: 老师向我们展示了一种快速记住新单词的简单技巧。

teenager.s: Many teenagers spend several hours a day playing games on their phones.
teenager.z: 许多青少年每天花好几个小时在手机上玩游戏。

telegram.s: She sent a telegram to her parents as soon as she arrived in the city.
telegram.z: 她一到达那座城市就给父母发了一封电报。

telescope.s: We used a small telescope to observe the moon and several bright stars last night.
telescope.z: 昨晚我们用一架小型望远镜观察了月亮和几颗明亮的星星。

telex.s: Before email became common, companies often sent urgent orders by telex.
telex.z: 在电子邮件普及之前，公司经常通过电传发送紧急订单。

temperament.s: Her calm temperament helps her stay relaxed even during stressful exams.
temperament.z: 她沉着的性情帮助她即使在压力很大的考试期间也能保持放松。

temporary.s: She took a temporary job at a bookstore while searching for a full-time position.
temporary.z: 她在寻找全职工作期间在一家书店做了一份临时工作。

tempt.s: The low price tempted many students to buy books they did not really need.
tempt.z: 低廉的价格诱使许多学生购买了并非真正需要的书。

temptation.s: She resisted the temptation to check her phone during the lecture.
temptation.z: 她在讲座期间抵制住了查看手机的诱惑。

tempting.s: The chocolate cake looked so tempting that she decided to have a small slice.
tempting.z: 那块巧克力蛋糕看起来太诱人了，所以她决定吃一小块。

tend.s: Young people tend to spend too much time on their phones before going to sleep.
tend.z: 年轻人往往在睡前花太多时间玩手机。

tendency.s: She has a tendency to check her phone whenever she feels nervous.
tendency.z: 每当感到紧张时，她都有查看手机的倾向。

tense.s: She felt tense before the interview and could hardly speak.
tense.z: 面试前她感到紧张，几乎说不出话来。

tensile.s: The engineers tested the tensile strength of the new material before using it in construction.
tensile.z: 工程师们在使用这种新材料进行建筑之前测试了它的抗拉强度。

tension.s: You could feel the tension in the room before the exam results were announced.
tension.z: 考试成绩公布之前，你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

terminology.s: Students must learn the technical terminology before they can read research papers.
terminology.z: 学生在阅读研究论文之前必须学会专业术语。

terribly.s: She felt terribly nervous before giving her first speech in front of the whole class.
terribly.z: 在全班同学面前做第一次演讲之前，她感到非常紧张。

terrify.s: The loud thunder terrified the little girl, so she hid under the bed.
terrify.z: 响亮的雷声吓坏了小女孩，于是她躲到了床底下。

terrorist.s: The police arrested a terrorist who was planning an attack on the city.
terrorist.z: 警方逮捕了一名策划袭击该城市的恐怖分子。

testify.s: Several witnesses agreed to testify in court about what they saw that night.
testify.z: 几名目击者同意出庭就那天晚上看到的情况作证。

textile.s: The factory produces high-quality textiles for customers across the country.
textile.z: 这家工厂为全国各地的客户生产高品质的纺织品。

theatre.s: We watched a funny play at the theatre with our classmates last weekend.
theatre.z: 上周末我们和同学在剧院看了一场有趣的戏剧。

theft.s: The police arrested a man for the theft of several expensive bicycles from the neighborhood.
theft.z: 警方逮捕了一名男子，因为他从社区盗窃了几辆昂贵的自行车。

theme.s: The main theme of the novel is the struggle between good and evil.
theme.z: 这部小说的主题是善与恶的斗争。

theorem.s: The professor explained the theorem clearly enough for every student to understand it.
theorem.z: 教授把这个定理讲解得很清楚，每个学生都能听懂。

theoretical.s: The professor's theoretical explanation helped students understand the difficult concept much better.
theoretical.z: 教授的理论解释帮助学生更好地理解了这个难懂的概念。

theory.s: Many students find it easier to remember a theory when they see how it applies to daily life.
theory.z: 许多学生发现，当他们看到理论如何应用于日常生活时，会更容易记住它。

thereafter.s: He moved to the city and thereafter rarely visited his hometown.
thereafter.z: 他搬到了城市，此后很少回访家乡。

therein.s: The report lists several serious errors, and therein lies the main problem.
therein.z: 报告中列出了几个严重错误，主要问题就在于此。

thereof.s: The contract was signed, and the terms thereof must be followed by both parties.
thereof.z: 合同已签署，双方必须遵守其条款。

thesis.s: Her thesis argues that social media has changed the way young people communicate.
thesis.z: 她的论文论证了社交媒体改变了年轻人交流的方式。

thicken.s: The sauce will thicken quickly once you add a little flour and stir.
thicken.z: 一旦你加入一点面粉并搅拌，酱汁很快就会变稠。

thickness.s: The thickness of the ice on the lake made it safe to walk across.
thickness.z: 湖面上冰的厚度使得在冰上行走是安全的。

thinking.s: Critical thinking helps students solve complex problems more effectively in their daily studies.
thinking.z: 批判性思维有助于学生在日常学习中更有效地解决复杂问题。

thirsty.s: After the long hike, we were so thirsty that we drank three bottles of water each.
thirsty.z: 长途徒步之后，我们渴得每人喝了三瓶水。

thoughtful.s: She was thoughtful enough to send a card to her teacher after the exam.
thoughtful.z: 考试结束后，她体贴地给老师寄了一张卡片。

thoughtless.s: It was thoughtless of him to leave without saying goodbye to anyone.
thoughtless.z: 他没有跟任何人告别就离开了，这样做很欠考虑。

thrash.s: The losing team was thrashed by ten points in front of their own fans.
thrash.z: 失利的那支队伍在自己球迷面前以十分之差惨败。

threat.s: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to many coastal cities around the world.
threat.z: 海平面上升对世界许多沿海城市构成了严重威胁。

threaten.s: Rising sea levels threaten many coastal cities around the world.
threaten.z: 海平面上升威胁着世界各地的许多沿海城市。

thresh.s: Farmers used to thresh the wheat by hand before modern machines arrived.
thresh.z: 在现代机器出现之前，农民们过去常常手工给小麦脱粒。

threshold.s: The noise outside finally crossed the threshold and woke everyone in the dormitory.
threshold.z: 外面的噪音终于超过了阈值，把宿舍里的每个人都吵醒了。

thrifty.s: My grandmother is so thrifty that she never wastes a single piece of bread.
thrifty.z: 我的祖母非常节俭，她从不浪费一片面包。

thrilling.s: The final minutes of the match were so thrilling that everyone jumped to their feet.
thrilling.z: 比赛最后几分钟惊心动魄，所有人都跳了起来。

throne.s: The young king sat on the throne and promised to serve his people well.
throne.z: 年轻的国王坐在王座上，承诺要好好为人民服务。

throughout.s: The museum is free to visit throughout the year, attracting many students.
throughout.z: 这家博物馆全年免费开放，吸引了许多学生。

tighten.s: The company decided to tighten its budget after sales dropped sharply last quarter.
tighten.z: 上季度销售额大幅下降后，公司决定收紧预算。

tightly.s: She held the fragile vase tightly with both hands as she walked downstairs.
tightly.z: 她双手紧紧握住那个易碎的花瓶，走下楼梯。

timely.s: The doctor's timely advice helped him recover from the illness much faster.
timely.z: 医生及时的建议帮助他更快地从疾病中康复。

tin.s: She kept the old letters in a small tin box under her bed.
tin.z: 她把旧信件保存在床下的一个小铁盒里。

tiny.s: A tiny mistake in the calculation can lead to a completely wrong result.
tiny.z: 计算中一个微小的错误可能导致完全错误的结果。

tip.s: She gave me a useful tip on how to save money on textbooks.
tip.z: 她给了我一个关于如何节省课本开支的实用建议。

tiresome.s: Waiting in long lines at the bank can be really tiresome.
tiresome.z: 在银行排长队等候可能真的很令人厌烦。

tissue.s: The doctor examined the tissue sample carefully under the microscope before making a diagnosis.
tissue.z: 医生在显微镜下仔细检查了组织样本，然后才做出诊断。

title.s: She forgot the title of the book she had read last month.
title.z: 她忘记了她上个月读过的那本书的书名。

toad.s: The old story says a princess must kiss a toad to break the spell.
toad.z: 这个古老的故事说，公主必须亲吻一只蟾蜍才能破除咒语。

token.s: She gave him a small gift as a token of her appreciation.
token.z: 她送给他一份小礼物，以表谢意。

tolerance.s: Living in a dorm requires tolerance for your roommates' different habits.
tolerance.z: 住在宿舍里需要对室友不同的习惯保持宽容。

tolerant.s: Young people should be tolerant of different opinions when discussing social issues online.
tolerant.z: 年轻人在网上讨论社会问题时应该对不同的观点持宽容态度。

tolerate.s: Many students find it hard to tolerate loud noise while studying in the library.
tolerate.z: 许多学生发现在图书馆学习时很难忍受大声的噪音。

toothache.s: She could not concentrate on her homework because of a terrible toothache.
toothache.z: 因为严重的牙痛，她无法专心做作业。

torment.s: The constant noise from the construction site tormented the students during their final exams.
torment.z: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音在期末考试期间折磨着学生们。

torpedo.s: The sudden scandal could torpedo the company's plan to expand overseas.
torpedo.z: 这起突如其来的丑闻可能会破坏该公司向海外扩张的计划。

torque.s: The mechanic tightened the bolt until the torque reached the required level.
torque.z: 机械师拧紧螺栓，直到扭矩达到要求的水平。

toss.s: She tossed the keys onto the table and hurried out the door.
toss.z: 她把钥匙扔到桌上，匆匆走出了门。

total.s: The total cost of the project was much higher than we had expected.
total.z: 该项目的总成本远高于我们的预期。

tough.s: Learning a new language can be tough, but regular practice makes it easier.
tough.z: 学习一门新语言可能很艰难，但经常练习会让它变得更容易。

tourist.s: Every summer, this small coastal town attracts thousands of tourists from all over the country.
tourist.z: 每年夏天，这座海滨小镇都会吸引来自全国各地的成千上万名游客。

towards.s: She walked slowly towards the window to get a better view of the garden.
towards.z: 她慢慢走向窗户，以便更好地欣赏花园的景色。

toxic.s: The factory dumped toxic waste into the river, killing fish and harming the local environment.
toxic.z: 那家工厂将有毒废物倾倒进河里，导致鱼类死亡并破坏了当地环境。

trace.s: The police found no trace of the missing car near the river.
trace.z: 警方在河边没有找到失踪汽车的踪迹。

track.s: She used a simple app to track her daily spending and save more money.
track.z: 她用一款简单的应用来记录日常开销，从而省下更多的钱。

trade-off.s: Choosing a major often involves a trade-off between personal interest and future income.
trade-off.z: 选择专业往往需要在个人兴趣和未来收入之间做出权衡。

trader.s: The trader bought goods at a low price and sold them in the market.
trader.z: 这个商人以低价买入货物，然后在市场上出售。

tradesman.s: The tradesman repaired our kitchen sink quickly and charged a fair price.
tradesman.z: 那位工匠很快修好了我们的厨房水槽，而且收费合理。

tradition.s: It is a family tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.z: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是一个家庭传统。

traffic.s: Heavy traffic during rush hour makes the morning commute stressful for many office workers.
traffic.z: 高峰时段的繁忙交通让许多上班族的早晨通勤压力很大。

tragic.s: The tragic accident reminded everyone to drive more carefully on rainy days.
tragic.z: 这场悲惨的事故提醒每个人在雨天开车要更加小心。

trail.s: The hikers followed a narrow trail through the forest to reach the lake.
trail.z: 徒步旅行者沿着一条狭窄的小径穿过森林到达湖边。

trait.s: Patience is a valuable trait that helps students succeed in their studies.
trait.z: 耐心是一种宝贵的品质，有助于学生在学业上取得成功。

tramp.s: We saw a tired tramp sleeping on the bench in the park.
tramp.z: 我们看到一个疲惫的流浪汉睡在公园的长椅上。

trample.s: The angry crowd began to trample the flowers in the park.
trample.z: 愤怒的人群开始踩踏公园里的花。

transaction.s: Every online transaction requires a secure password to protect your money.
transaction.z: 每笔网上交易都需要一个安全的密码来保护你的钱。

transfer.s: She decided to transfer to another department to gain more experience.
transfer.z: 她决定转到另一个部门以获得更多经验。

transform.s: The new library has transformed an old factory into a bright study space.
transform.z: 新图书馆把一座旧工厂改造成了明亮的学习空间。

transformation.s: The small village has undergone a remarkable transformation over the past ten years.
transformation.z: 这个村庄在过去十年里经历了显著的变化。

transformer.s: The new transformer outside the building keeps the whole neighborhood's power supply stable during storms.
transformer.z: 楼外的新变压器在暴风雨期间保持整个街区的电力供应稳定。

transient.s: The pain was transient, and she felt completely fine the next morning.
transient.z: 疼痛是短暂的，第二天早上她就完全好了。

transition.s: The transition from high school to college can be challenging for many students.
transition.z: 从高中到大学的过渡对许多学生来说可能具有挑战性。

translation.s: The translation of this novel captures the humor of the original perfectly.
translation.z: 这部小说的译本完美地再现了原著的幽默感。

transmission.s: The transmission of the disease was slowed by regular hand washing.
transmission.z: 经常洗手减缓了这种疾病的传播。

transparent.s: The company promised to make its pricing policy more transparent to all customers.
transparent.z: 该公司承诺让其定价政策对所有顾客更加透明。

transplant.s: The doctor said the patient would need a heart transplant within the next few months.
transplant.z: 医生说这位病人需要在接下来的几个月内进行心脏移植。

transportation.s: Public transportation in big cities is often cheaper and faster than driving a car.
transportation.z: 大城市的公共交通通常比开车更便宜、更快捷。

transverse.s: The engineer drew a transverse line across the map to show where the new road would cross the river.
transverse.z: 工程师在地图上画了一条横线，以显示新道路将横穿河流的位置。

trap.s: The heavy rain trapped several cars under the bridge for hours.
trap.z: 大雨把几辆汽车困在桥下好几个小时。

trash.s: Please take the trash out before you leave for work this morning.
trash.z: 今天早上上班前请把垃圾拿出去。

traverse.s: The hikers had to traverse a narrow bridge to reach the other side of the river.
traverse.z: 徒步者必须穿过一座窄桥才能到达河的对岸。

treasurer.s: The treasurer keeps careful records of every donation the club receives.
treasurer.z: 财务主管仔细记录俱乐部收到的每一笔捐款。

treatment.s: The doctor said the new treatment would help her recover much faster.
treatment.z: 医生说这种新疗法能帮助她更快康复。

tremendous.s: The new policy brought tremendous benefits to students and teachers alike.
tremendous.z: 这项新政策给学生和教师都带来了巨大的好处。

trench.s: The soldiers dug a deep trench to protect themselves from enemy fire.
trench.z: 士兵们挖了一条深战壕来保护自己免受敌人炮火的攻击。

trend.s: More young people are choosing to work from home, and this trend is likely to continue.
trend.z: 越来越多的年轻人选择在家工作，这一趋势很可能会持续下去。

trial.s: The new medicine showed promising results during the clinical trial.
trial.z: 这种新药在临床试验中显示出令人鼓舞的结果。

triangle.s: The teacher drew a triangle on the board to explain the geometry lesson.
triangle.z: 老师在黑板上画了一个三角形来讲解几何课。

triangular.s: The engineer designed a triangular support to make the bridge stronger.
triangular.z: 工程师设计了一个三角形支架来使桥梁更加坚固。

trick.s: He used a simple trick to remember all the new words.
trick.z: 他用一个简单的窍门记住了所有生词。

trigger.s: The heavy rain triggered a serious flood in the low-lying village.
trigger.z: 大雨在低洼的村庄引发了严重的洪水。

triumph.s: She raised her arms in triumph after finishing the marathon in record time.
triumph.z: 她以创纪录的时间跑完马拉松后，高举双臂庆祝胜利。

triumphant.s: After months of hard training, the young athlete gave a triumphant smile as she crossed the finish line.
triumphant.z: 经过数月的刻苦训练，这位年轻运动员冲过终点线时露出了胜利的微笑。

trivial.s: Do not waste your time arguing about such trivial matters before the exam.
trivial.z: 考试前不要浪费时间争论这些琐碎的事情。

tropical.s: The tropical climate in this region attracts many tourists every winter.
tropical.z: 这个地区的热带气候每年冬天吸引许多游客。

trot.s: The horse began to trot gently along the path beside the river.
trot.z: 那匹马开始沿着河边的小路轻快地小跑起来。

troublesome.s: Dealing with this troublesome issue took the whole team several days.
troublesome.z: 处理这个棘手的问题花了整个团队好几天时间。

truly.s: She truly believes that hard work will lead to success in the future.
truly.z: 她真心相信努力工作会在未来带来成功。

tuberculosis.s: The doctor warned that tuberculosis can spread quickly in crowded, poorly ventilated rooms.
tuberculosis.z: 医生警告说，肺结核在拥挤且通风不良的房间里会迅速传播。

tuition.s: Rising tuition costs have forced many students to take part-time jobs.
tuition.z: 不断上涨的学费迫使许多学生去做兼职。

tulip.s: She planted tulips along the garden path so visitors could enjoy their bright colors.
tulip.z: 她沿花园小径种下郁金香，好让来访者欣赏它们鲜艳的色彩。

tuna.s: She made a quick lunch with a tuna sandwich and a glass of juice.
tuna.z: 她做了一个金枪鱼三明治配一杯果汁当快手午餐。

turbine.s: The new turbine generates enough electricity to power several hundred homes in the village.
turbine.z: 这台新涡轮机产生的电力足以供应村里几百户家庭的用电。

turbulence.s: The flight was delayed because of severe turbulence over the mountains.
turbulence.z: 由于山地上空出现强烈气流，航班延误了。

turbulent.s: The small boat struggled through the turbulent waters during the storm.
turbulent.z: 暴风雨中，小船在汹涌的水域中艰难前行。

twilight.s: The old couple enjoys walking along the river in the peaceful twilight.
twilight.z: 这对老夫妇喜欢在宁静的暮色中沿着河边散步。

type.s: This type of question often appears in the final exam.
type.z: 这种类型的问题经常出现在期末考试中。

typical.s: On a typical weekday, most students spend several hours studying in the library.
typical.z: 在普通的工作日，大多数学生会在图书馆学习几个小时。

typist.s: The typist finished the report quickly and checked every page for mistakes.
typist.z: 打字员很快完成了报告，并检查了每一页是否有错误。

tyranny.s: The novel describes how the people rose up against tyranny and won their freedom.
tyranny.z: 这部小说描写了人民如何奋起反抗暴政并赢得了自由。

tyrant.s: The old tyrant ignored the people's needs and ruled the country for many years.
tyrant.z: 那个老暴君无视人民的需求，统治这个国家很多年。

ultimate.s: After years of hard work, she finally reached her ultimate goal of becoming a doctor.
ultimate.z: 经过多年的努力，她终于实现了成为医生的最终目标。

ultimately.s: Ultimately, the success of any project depends on careful planning and teamwork.
ultimately.z: 最终，任何项目的成功都取决于周密的计划和团队合作。

ultrasonic.s: The doctor used an ultrasonic device to examine the baby's heart during the checkup.
ultrasonic.z: 医生在检查时使用超声波设备检查婴儿的心脏。

ultraviolet.s: Too much ultraviolet light from the sun can seriously damage your skin.
ultraviolet.z: 来自太阳的过多紫外线会严重损害你的皮肤。

unaffordable.s: For many young graduates, buying a house in big cities has become completely unaffordable.
unaffordable.z: 对许多年轻毕业生来说，在大城市买房已经变得完全负担不起。

unanimous.s: The committee reached a unanimous decision to approve the new budget after a long discussion.
unanimous.z: 经过长时间讨论，委员会一致决定批准新预算。

unbearable.s: The noise from the construction site was so unbearable that we had to close all the windows.
unbearable.z: 建筑工地的噪音如此难以忍受，我们只好把所有的窗户都关上。

unbiased.s: A good judge must remain unbiased when listening to both sides of the story.
unbiased.z: 好的法官在听取双方陈述时必须保持公正。

unconscious.s: She remained unconscious for several hours after the accident on the icy road.
unconscious.z: 在结冰的路上发生事故后，她昏迷了好几个小时。

uncover.s: The investigation helped uncover the real reason behind the sudden price increase.
uncover.z: 这项调查帮助揭开了价格突然上涨背后的真正原因。

undecided.s: She remains undecided about which major to choose before the deadline.
undecided.z: 在截止日期前，她仍未决定选择哪个专业。

underestimate.s: Many students underestimate the time they need to prepare for final exams.
underestimate.z: 许多学生低估了准备期末考试所需的时间。

underfunded.s: Many rural schools remain underfunded, so students there lack basic learning materials.
underfunded.z: 许多农村学校仍然资金不足，因此那里的学生缺乏基本的学习用品。

undergo.s: The old library will undergo major repairs before it reopens to the public.
undergo.z: 这座老图书馆在重新向公众开放前将进行大规模修缮。

undergraduate.s: As an undergraduate, she spent most of her free time working in the research lab.
undergraduate.z: 作为一名本科生，她把大部分空闲时间都花在实验室做研究上。

underline.s: The teacher asked us to underline the key sentences in the passage.
underline.z: 老师让我们在文章中划出关键句子。

underlying.s: The underlying cause of the problem was not obvious at first.
underlying.z: 这个问题的根本原因起初并不明显。

undermine.s: Constant criticism from parents can seriously undermine a child's confidence and motivation.
undermine.z: 父母不断的批评会严重削弱孩子的自信和动力。

underrepresented.s: Women remain underrepresented in senior management positions at many large companies.
underrepresented.z: 在许多大公司的高级管理职位中，女性仍然代表性不足。

underscore.s: The new report underscores the urgent need for cleaner energy sources.
underscore.z: 这份新报告强调了迫切需要更清洁的能源。

understanding.s: A good teacher shows patience and understanding when students struggle with difficult ideas.
understanding.z: 当学生难以理解困难的概念时，好老师会表现出耐心和理解。

undertaking.s: Starting a new business is a risky undertaking that requires careful planning.
undertaking.z: 创办新企业是一项需要仔细规划的高风险事业。

undervalue.s: Many graduates undervalue their communication skills when applying for their first job.
undervalue.z: 许多毕业生在申请第一份工作时低估了自己的沟通能力。

undesirable.s: The new policy may have some undesirable effects on small businesses.
undesirable.z: 这项新政策可能会对小企业产生一些不良影响。

undocumented.s: Many workers remain undocumented and therefore lack access to basic legal protection.
undocumented.z: 许多工人没有合法证件，因此无法获得基本的法律保护。

uneasy.s: She felt uneasy about walking home alone after the meeting ended late.
uneasy.z: 会议结束得很晚，她对于独自走回家感到不安。

unemployment.s: Rising unemployment has forced many young graduates to accept low-paying jobs.
unemployment.z: 不断上升的失业率迫使许多年轻毕业生接受低薪工作。

unethical.s: The company was criticized for using unethical methods to increase its profits.
unethical.z: 这家公司因采用不道德的手段增加利润而受到批评。

uneven.s: The table wobbled because one of its legs was slightly uneven.
uneven.z: 桌子摇晃是因为其中一条桌腿略微不平。

unexpected.s: The unexpected heavy rain forced us to cancel the outdoor meeting.
unexpected.z: 这场意外的大雨迫使我们取消了户外会议。

unfit.s: The doctor warned him that his unhealthy diet made him unfit for the long race.
unfit.z: 医生警告他，不健康的饮食使他无法胜任这场长跑比赛。

unfold.s: As the story unfolds, we gradually understand why the main character left home.
unfold.z: 随着故事展开，我们逐渐明白主人公为什么离开了家。

unfortunately.s: Unfortunately, the train was delayed, so we missed the beginning of the concert.
unfortunately.z: 不幸的是，火车晚点了，所以我们错过了音乐会开场。

unified.s: The new manager created a unified team by encouraging everyone to share their ideas openly.
unified.z: 新经理通过鼓励大家公开分享想法，打造了一个团结一致的团队。

uniform.s: Every student in our school must wear a clean uniform during the morning assembly.
uniform.z: 我们学校的每个学生在早会期间都必须穿干净的校服。

uniformly.s: The teacher spoke slowly and uniformly so that every student could follow the lecture.
uniformly.z: 老师讲话缓慢而一致，以便每个学生都能跟上课程。

unify.s: The new leader promised to unify the team and work toward a common goal.
unify.z: 新领导承诺团结整个团队，朝着共同的目标努力。

uninformed.s: Many people make poor health choices because they are uninformed about basic nutrition.
uninformed.z: 许多人因为对基本营养知识不了解而做出糟糕的健康选择。

unintended.s: The new policy had several unintended effects on small businesses across the country.
unintended.z: 这项新政策对全国的小企业产生了几个意想不到的影响。

unintentionally.s: She unintentionally offended her colleague by forgetting to invite him to the meeting.
unintentionally.z: 她因为忘记邀请那位同事参加会议而无意中冒犯了他。

union.s: The workers formed a union to protect their rights and improve working conditions.
union.z: 工人们成立了一个工会来保护他们的权利并改善工作条件。

unique.s: Each student has a unique learning style that teachers should respect.
unique.z: 每个学生都有独特的学习方式，老师应该予以尊重。

unite.s: The whole community united to help the families after the terrible flood.
unite.z: 那场可怕的洪水过后，整个社区团结起来帮助这些家庭。

unity.s: The team's unity helped them finish the difficult project ahead of schedule.
unity.z: 团队的团结帮助他们提前完成了这个艰难的项目。

universal.s: The desire for kindness and respect is a universal human need.
universal.z: 对善意和尊重的渴望是人类普遍的需求。

universally.s: The new safety rules were universally accepted by all the workers in the factory.
universally.z: 这些新的安全规定被工厂里的所有工人普遍接受了。

universe.s: Scientists believe the universe is still expanding at an incredible speed.
universe.z: 科学家认为宇宙仍在以惊人的速度膨胀。

unknown.s: The cause of the sudden power failure remains unknown to the engineers.
unknown.z: 突然停电的原因对工程师们来说仍然未知。

unlike.s: Unlike her sister, she prefers reading books to watching television.
unlike.z: 与她姐姐不同，她更喜欢读书而不是看电视。

unlikely.s: It is unlikely that the meeting will end before noon.
unlikely.z: 会议不太可能在中午之前结束。

unlimited.s: The new library gives students unlimited access to online journals and research databases.
unlimited.z: 新图书馆为学生提供了对在线期刊和研究数据库的无限访问权限。

unload.s: The workers began to unload the heavy boxes from the truck.
unload.z: 工人们开始从卡车上卸下沉重的箱子。

unlock.s: She used the correct password to unlock the door and enter the quiet office.
unlock.z: 她用正确的密码打开门，走进了安静的办公室。

unpaid.s: Many graduates struggle to repay their unpaid student loans after finding low-paying jobs.
unpaid.z: 许多毕业生在找到低薪工作后难以偿还尚未还清的学生贷款。

unqualified.s: She was rejected for the job because she was unqualified for the position.
unqualified.z: 她因为不胜任这个职位而被拒绝录用。

unrealistic.s: It is unrealistic to expect students to master a language in just a few weeks.
unrealistic.z: 指望学生在短短几周内掌握一门语言是不现实的。

unreasonable.s: It seems unreasonable to expect students to finish so much work in one evening.
unreasonable.z: 指望学生在一个晚上完成这么多作业似乎是不合理的。

unrest.s: Growing political unrest in the region has forced many families to leave their homes.
unrest.z: 该地区日益加剧的政治动荡迫使许多家庭离开家园。

unstable.s: His unstable internet connection made it hard to finish the online exam.
unstable.z: 他不稳定的网络连接使他很难完成在线考试。

untie.s: She bent down to untie her shoes before stepping into the warm house.
untie.z: 她弯下腰解开鞋带，然后才走进温暖的屋子。

untiring.s: Her untiring efforts to help students improve their English finally paid off.
untiring.z: 她为帮助学生提高英语水平而不懈努力，最终得到了回报。

untreated.s: If left untreated, the infection can spread quickly and become dangerous.
untreated.z: 如果不及时治疗，感染会迅速扩散并变得危险。

untrustworthy.s: The witness was considered untrustworthy because his story kept changing.
untrustworthy.z: 这名证人被认为不可信，因为他的说法一直在变。

unusual.s: It is unusual for him to arrive late at the office.
unusual.z: 他在办公室迟到是不寻常的。

unwilling.s: She was unwilling to accept the low salary offered by the small company.
unwilling.z: 她不愿意接受这家小公司提供的低薪。

up-to-date.s: The library keeps an up-to-date collection of journals for students and teachers.
up-to-date.z: 图书馆为学生和教师保存着最新的期刊收藏。

upbringing.s: Her strict upbringing taught her to respect others and work hard.
upbringing.z: 她严格的家教教会她尊重他人并努力工作。

update.s: Please update your contact information before the new semester begins.
update.z: 请在新学期开始前更新你的联系方式。

upgrade.s: The airline offered to upgrade our seats because the flight was overbooked.
upgrade.z: 由于航班超售，航空公司提出为我们升级座位。

uphold.s: Teachers have a duty to uphold fairness when they grade every student's work.
uphold.z: 教师在给每个学生的作业评分时有责任维护公平。

upper.s: She kept her passport in the upper drawer of the desk.
upper.z: 她把护照放在书桌上层的抽屉里。

upright.s: Please keep your back upright while sitting at the desk for long hours.
upright.z: 长时间坐在书桌前时，请保持背部挺直。

uproar.s: The sudden change in policy caused a huge uproar among the students.
uproar.z: 政策的突然变化在学生中引起了巨大的骚动。

upset.s: She felt upset when she heard the bad news about her friend.
upset.z: 当她听到关于朋友的坏消息时，她感到心烦意乱。

urban.s: Many young people move to urban areas to find better jobs and education.
urban.z: 许多年轻人搬到城市地区寻找更好的工作和教育机会。

urbanization.s: Rapid urbanization has brought both economic opportunities and serious environmental challenges to many developing countries.
urbanization.z: 快速的城市化给许多发展中国家带来了经济机遇，也带来了严重的环境挑战。

urge.s: My parents urged me to apply for the scholarship before the deadline.
urge.z: 父母催促我在截止日期前申请奖学金。

urgent.s: The doctor said the patient needed urgent treatment, so an ambulance was called immediately.
urgent.z: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗，因此立即叫了救护车。

utensil.s: Please wash the cooking utensils thoroughly before you use them again.
utensil.z: 再次使用前，请把炊具彻底清洗干净。

utilization.s: Better utilization of study time can greatly improve your exam results.
utilization.z: 更好地利用学习时间能大大提高你的考试成绩。

utopian.s: His utopian vision of a world without conflict seemed unrealistic to most people.
utopian.z: 他关于一个没有冲突的世界的乌托邦式愿景在大多数人看来并不现实。

utterly.s: She was utterly exhausted after studying for the final exam all night.
utterly.z: 她通宵复习期末考试后感到筋疲力尽。

vacation.s: My family plans to take a two-week vacation by the sea this summer.
vacation.z: 今年夏天我们一家打算去海边度两周假。

vaccinate.s: Doctors strongly recommend that children be vaccinated against common diseases before starting school.
vaccinate.z: 医生强烈建议儿童在入学前接种疫苗以预防常见疾病。

vacuum.s: She cleaned the carpet with a vacuum before the guests arrived.
vacuum.z: 客人到来之前，她用吸尘器清洁了地毯。

vague.s: His answer was so vague that nobody could tell what he actually meant.
vague.z: 他的回答太含糊了，没人能明白他到底是什么意思。

valid.s: Her passport is no longer valid, so she must renew it before the trip.
valid.z: 她的护照不再有效，所以她必须在旅行前续办。

validation.s: Her research findings received validation from several experts in the field.
validation.z: 她的研究成果得到了该领域几位专家的认可。

validity.s: Researchers questioned the validity of the survey results because the sample was too small.
validity.z: 研究人员质疑调查结果的有效性，因为样本量太小。

valuable.s: The old teacher gave us some valuable advice about preparing for the exam.
valuable.z: 这位老教师给了我们一些关于备考的宝贵建议。

vanish.s: The morning fog vanished quickly as the sun rose over the quiet town.
vanish.z: 当太阳在安静的小镇上升起时，晨雾很快消散了。

vapour.s: When the kettle boils, hot vapour rises and quickly covers the kitchen window.
vapour.z: 水壶烧开时，热蒸汽升起并很快覆盖了厨房的窗户。

variable.s: The results of the experiment were affected by several variable factors that we could not control.
variable.z: 实验结果受到了几个我们无法控制的变量的影响。

variance.s: There was a slight variance between the two reports on the same event.
variance.z: 关于同一事件的两份报告之间存在细微差异。

variation.s: There is a slight variation in price between the two online stores.
variation.z: 这两家网店之间的价格有轻微差异。

variety.s: The campus library offers a wide variety of books for students to borrow.
variety.z: 校园图书馆提供各种各样的书籍供学生借阅。

various.s: The library offers various books and magazines for students to read.
various.z: 图书馆提供各种书籍和杂志供学生阅读。

vary.s: The prices of fresh vegetables vary from season to season in local markets.
vary.z: 当地市场上新鲜蔬菜的价格随季节而变化。

vast.s: The vast majority of students agreed that the new library hours were much more convenient.
vast.z: 绝大多数学生都认为新的图书馆开放时间要方便得多。

vault.s: The bank keeps its most valuable documents in a secure vault underground.
vault.z: 银行将最贵重的文件存放在地下的安全金库里。

vector.s: Scientists used a vector to insert the new gene into the plant cells.
vector.z: 科学家利用一种载体将新基因植入植物细胞中。

vegetarian.s: My roommate became a vegetarian last year and now cooks fresh vegetables every day.
vegetarian.z: 我的室友去年成了素食者，现在每天都会做新鲜蔬菜。

vengeance.s: She swore to take vengeance on those who had destroyed her family.
vengeance.z: 她发誓要向那些毁了她家庭的人报仇。

venus.s: The planet Venus is often called Earth's sister because of its similar size.
venus.z: 金星常被称为地球的姐妹，因为两者大小相似。

verbal.s: Her verbal skills improved quickly after she joined the debate club.
verbal.z: 加入辩论社后，她的口头表达能力提高得很快。

verdict.s: The jury took several hours to reach a unanimous verdict after hearing all the evidence.
verdict.z: 陪审团在听取所有证据后花了几个小时才达成一致的裁决。

verge.s: The old bridge is on the verge of collapsing after years of heavy rain.
verge.z: 经过多年的大雨，这座旧桥处于坍塌的边缘。

verify.s: Please verify your email address before you can log in to the system.
verify.z: 在登录系统之前，请验证您的电子邮件地址。

version.s: She wrote a shorter version of the report for the meeting.
version.z: 她为会议写了一份更简短的报告版本。

versus.s: The students debated the advantages of online learning versus traditional classroom teaching.
versus.z: 学生们讨论了在线学习与传统课堂教学相比的优势。

vessel.s: The small vessel sailed slowly across the calm river at dawn.
vessel.z: 那艘小船在黎明时分缓缓驶过平静的河面。

veteran.s: The veteran teacher shared useful advice with the young staff.
veteran.z: 这位经验丰富的老师与年轻员工分享了有用的建议。

via.s: She sent the documents to the manager via email before the meeting.
via.z: 她在会议前通过电子邮件把文件发给了经理。

vice.s: Gambling is his only vice, and it has caused serious problems in his family.
vice.z: 赌博是他唯一的恶习，这给他的家庭带来了严重的问题。

vicious.s: The vicious dog chased the frightened children down the narrow street.
vicious.z: 那只凶猛的狗沿着狭窄的街道追赶受惊的孩子们。

victim.s: The victim reported the theft to the police immediately after it happened.
victim.z: 受害者在盗窃发生后立即向警方报案。

victimize.s: The report shows that poorer neighborhoods are more likely to be victimized by crime.
victimize.z: 报告显示，较贫困的社区更容易成为犯罪的受害者。

view.s: In my view, students should read widely to improve their vocabulary.
view.z: 在我看来，学生应该广泛阅读以提高词汇量。

viewpoint.s: From my viewpoint, studying in a quiet place is much more effective than studying in a noisy room.
viewpoint.z: 在我看来，在安静的地方学习比在嘈杂的房间里学习有效得多。

vigorous.s: Regular vigorous exercise helps students stay healthy and improve their academic performance.
vigorous.z: 有规律的剧烈运动有助于学生保持健康并提高学习成绩。

vigour.s: After a good night's sleep, she returned to work with renewed vigour and focus.
vigour.z: 睡了个好觉之后，她精神焕发、全神贯注地重新投入工作。

villa.s: They rented a quiet villa by the lake for their summer holiday.
villa.z: 他们租了一栋湖边安静的小别墅来度过暑假。

vine.s: Thick vines climbed up the old stone wall and covered the whole window.
vine.z: 粗壮的藤蔓爬上古老的石墙，遮住了整扇窗户。

violate.s: Drivers who violate traffic rules may face heavy fines and lose their licenses.
violate.z: 违反交通规则的司机可能面临高额罚款并失去驾照。

violation.s: Driving without a seatbelt is a serious violation of traffic safety rules.
violation.z: 不系安全带驾驶是对交通安全规则的严重违反。

violence.s: The school teaches students to solve conflicts peacefully instead of turning to violence.
violence.z: 学校教导学生和平解决冲突，而不是诉诸暴力。

violent.s: The violent storm destroyed several houses and left the whole village without power.
violent.z: 这场猛烈的风暴摧毁了几座房屋，使整个村庄停电。

violet.s: She planted a row of violet flowers along the garden path last spring.
violet.z: 去年春天，她沿着花园小径种了一排紫罗兰。

virgin.s: The forest remains a virgin wilderness untouched by human development.
virgin.z: 这片森林仍然是一片未受人类开发影响的原始荒野。

virtual.s: Students can attend virtual classes from home when the weather is bad.
virtual.z: 天气不好时，学生可以在家上虚拟课程。

virtually.s: The new software makes it virtually impossible to lose important files.
virtually.z: 这款新软件使丢失重要文件几乎不可能。

virtue.s: Patience is a virtue that helps students handle stress during exams.
virtue.z: 耐心是一种美德，能帮助学生在考试期间应对压力。

visa.s: She applied for a student visa months before her flight to London.
visa.z: 她在飞往伦敦的几个月前就申请了学生签证。

visceral.s: Her visceral reaction to the shocking news was obvious to everyone in the room.
visceral.z: 她对这条令人震惊的消息的本能反应让房间里的每个人都看得清清楚楚。

viscous.s: The viscous liquid flowed slowly out of the bottle and covered the whole table.
viscous.z: 那种黏稠的液体从瓶子里缓缓流出，覆盖了整张桌子。

visibility.s: Heavy fog reduced visibility on the highway, so drivers had to slow down considerably.
visibility.z: 大雾降低了高速公路上的能见度，因此司机们不得不大幅减速。

visible.s: The mountains were clearly visible from our hotel room window this morning.
visible.z: 今天早上从我们酒店房间的窗户可以清楚地看到那些山。

vision.s: Regular eye exams can help protect your vision as you get older.
vision.z: 定期进行眼部检查有助于随着年龄增长保护你的视力。

visual.s: The teacher used visual aids to help students understand the difficult concept.
visual.z: 老师使用视觉辅助工具帮助学生理解这个难懂的概念。

visualize.s: She closed her eyes to visualize the peaceful beach and calm her anxious mind.
visualize.z: 她闭上眼睛想象那片宁静的海滩，以平复焦虑的心情。

vital.s: Getting enough sleep is vital for students who want to stay healthy and focused.
vital.z: 充足的睡眠对于想要保持健康和专注的学生来说至关重要。

vitality.s: Regular exercise and enough sleep can greatly improve your vitality and overall health.
vitality.z: 经常锻炼和充足睡眠能大大提升你的活力和整体健康。

vitally.s: Getting enough sleep is vitally important for students preparing for difficult exams.
vitally.z: 充足睡眠对备考困难考试的学生来说至关重要。

vitamin.s: Eating fresh fruit and vegetables every day provides your body with essential vitamins.
vitamin.z: 每天吃新鲜的水果和蔬菜能为你的身体提供必需的维生素。

vivid.s: She still has vivid memories of her first day at college.
vivid.z: 她对大学第一天的记忆仍然栩栩如生。

vocabulary.s: Reading widely is the best way to build a large vocabulary.
vocabulary.z: 广泛阅读是积累大量词汇的最佳途径。

vocal.s: She became very vocal about the unfair treatment of workers in the factory.
vocal.z: 她对工厂工人受到的不公平待遇直言不讳。

vocational.s: Many students choose vocational training because it helps them find jobs quickly.
vocational.z: 许多学生选择职业培训，因为它能帮助他们快速找到工作。

volcano.s: The volcano erupted suddenly, forcing thousands of nearby villagers to leave their homes.
volcano.z: 火山突然喷发，迫使附近数千名村民离开家园。

voltage.s: The technician checked the voltage before connecting the new machine.
voltage.z: 技术员在连接新机器之前检查了电压。

volume.s: The volume of traffic on the highway increases sharply during holidays.
volume.z: 节假日期间，高速公路上车流量急剧增加。

voluntary.s: She does voluntary work at the local hospital every weekend.
voluntary.z: 她每个周末都在当地医院做志愿工作。

volunteer.s: Many students volunteer to help at the local library on weekends.
volunteer.z: 许多学生周末自愿到当地图书馆帮忙。

vote.s: The students will vote on whether to extend the library hours during exam week.
vote.z: 学生们将就考试周是否延长图书馆开放时间进行投票。

vowel.s: Every English word must contain at least one vowel sound.
vowel.z: 每个英语单词都必须至少包含一个元音音素。

vulnerable.s: Older people living alone are often more vulnerable to illness during cold winters.
vulnerable.z: 在寒冷的冬天，独居的老年人往往更容易患病。

wade.s: We had to wade through the shallow river to reach the other side.
wade.z: 我们不得不蹚过那条浅浅的河才能到达对岸。

wag.s: The happy dog began to wag its tail when its owner came home.
wag.z: 当主人回家时，那只快乐的狗开始摇尾巴。

wage.s: Many workers complained that their wages were too low to support their families.
wage.z: 许多工人抱怨他们的工资太低，无法养家糊口。

waggon.s: The farmer loaded the hay onto the waggon before heading to the market.
waggon.z: 农夫把干草装上马车，然后前往市场。

waist.s: She tied a light jacket around her waist before the morning run.
waist.z: 晨跑前，她把一件轻便的夹克系在了腰上。

waitress.s: The waitress smiled warmly as she brought our coffee to the table.
waitress.z: 女服务员微笑着把咖啡端到我们的桌上。

waken.s: The loud noise from the street wakened the baby from her afternoon nap.
waken.z: 街上巨大的噪音把婴儿从午睡中吵醒了。

walnut.s: She added crushed walnuts to the salad to give it a pleasant crunch.
walnut.z: 她在沙拉里加了碎核桃，让它有令人愉快的脆感。

wardrobe.s: She hung her new dress in the wardrobe before going to bed.
wardrobe.z: 睡觉前，她把新裙子挂进了衣柜里。

warehouse.s: The company stores all its goods in a large warehouse near the river.
warehouse.z: 公司把所有货物存放在河边的一个大仓库里。

warmth.s: The warmth of her smile made everyone in the room feel welcome.
warmth.z: 她微笑中的温暖让房间里的每个人都感到受欢迎。

warning.s: The doctor gave him a serious warning about the dangers of smoking.
warning.z: 医生严重警告他吸烟的危害。

warrant.s: The serious nature of the evidence may warrant a full investigation by the committee.
warrant.z: 证据的严重性可能值得委员会进行全面调查。

wasp.s: A wasp flew into the kitchen and landed on the fruit bowl.
wasp.z: 一只黄蜂飞进厨房，落在了水果碗上。

wasteful.s: Leaving the lights on all night is wasteful and harms the environment.
wasteful.z: 整夜开着灯很浪费，而且对环境有害。

watchful.s: The teacher kept a watchful eye on the students during the exam.
watchful.z: 考试期间，老师警惕地注视着学生们。

watery.s: The soup tasted watery because the cook added too much water to it.
watery.z: 这汤尝起来很淡，因为厨师往里面加了太多的水。

wave.s: A huge wave crashed against the rocks and sent water flying into the air.
wave.z: 一个巨浪拍打在岩石上，把水花溅向空中。

waver.s: She did not waver in her decision to study abroad despite her parents' concerns.
waver.z: 尽管父母担忧，她出国留学的决定并未动摇。

weaken.s: The doctor warned that too much stress could weaken the body's natural defenses.
weaken.z: 医生警告说，压力过大会削弱身体的天然防御能力。

weakness.s: His greatest weakness is that he cannot stay calm under pressure.
weakness.z: 他最大的弱点是在压力下无法保持冷静。

wealthy.s: Her family became wealthy after her father started a small business.
wealthy.z: 她父亲开始做小生意后，她家变得富有了。

weapon.s: The police found a dangerous weapon hidden under the suspect's bed.
weapon.z: 警方在嫌疑人的床下发现了一件危险的武器。

weaver.s: The skilled weaver turned the soft wool into a beautiful warm blanket.
weaver.z: 那位熟练的织工把柔软的羊毛织成了一条漂亮暖和的毯子。

web.s: She spent hours searching the web for information about her research topic.
web.z: 她花了几个小时在网上搜索有关她研究课题的信息。

wedding.s: They invited all their closest friends to the wedding held in a small garden.
wedding.z: 他们邀请了所有最亲密的朋友参加在小花园里举行的婚礼。

weekly.s: She writes a weekly report to keep her manager informed about the team's progress.
weekly.z: 她每周写一份报告，让经理了解团队的进展。

weird.s: It felt weird to walk into the office and find nobody there.
weird.z: 走进办公室发现一个人都没有，感觉很奇怪。

weld.s: The workers used a hot flame to weld the two metal pipes together securely.
weld.z: 工人们用高温火焰将两根金属管牢固地焊接在一起。

welfare.s: The government should spend more money on the welfare of children and the elderly.
welfare.z: 政府应该在儿童和老年人的福利上投入更多资金。

whatever.s: Whatever you decide to study, remember that consistent effort matters most.
whatever.z: 无论你决定学什么，记住持续的努力才是最重要的。

wheat.s: Farmers in this region grow wheat and corn every year.
wheat.z: 这个地区的农民每年种植小麦和玉米。

wheel.s: She grabbed the steering wheel tightly as the car turned around the sharp corner.
wheel.z: 汽车急转弯时，她紧紧抓住方向盘。

whereby.s: She set up a small online study group whereby students could share notes and help each other.
whereby.z: 她建立了一个小型在线学习小组，学生们借此可以分享笔记并互相帮助。

whichever.s: You can take whichever seat you like near the window.
whichever.z: 你可以随便坐靠窗的任何一个座位。

whilst.s: Whilst studying late at night, she often drinks tea to stay awake.
whilst.z: 在深夜学习时，她常常喝茶来保持清醒。

whip.s: The chef used a wire whip to beat the eggs until they were fluffy.
whip.z: 厨师用钢丝打蛋器把鸡蛋搅打至蓬松。

whisker.s: The cat twitched its whiskers and stared curiously at the moving toy.
whisker.z: 那只猫抽动胡须，好奇地盯着移动的玩具。

whisper.s: She leaned over and whispered the answer softly into her friend's ear.
whisper.z: 她俯身把答案轻声低语到朋友的耳朵里。

whitewash.s: The village council tried to whitewash the scandal by hiding the report from the public.
whitewash.z: 村委会试图通过向公众隐瞒报告来掩盖这起丑闻。

whoever.s: Whoever finishes the report first can leave the office early today.
whoever.z: 谁先完成报告，今天就可以早点离开办公室。

wholly.s: The success of the project depended wholly on careful planning and honest communication.
wholly.z: 该项目的成功完全取决于周密的计划和坦诚的沟通。

widely.s: English is widely used in international business and academic conferences.
widely.z: 英语在国际商务和学术会议中被广泛使用。

widen.s: The local council plans to widen the main road to reduce traffic congestion.
widen.z: 当地议会计划拓宽主干道以缓解交通拥堵。

widespread.s: The use of smartphones has become widespread among college students in recent years.
widespread.z: 近年来，智能手机的使用在大学生中已变得十分普遍。

widow.s: The young widow raised three children alone after her husband's sudden death.
widow.z: 丈夫突然去世后，这位年轻的寡妇独自抚养了三个孩子。

width.s: The width of the river makes it difficult to build a bridge here.
width.z: 这条河的宽度使在这里建桥变得困难。

wildfire.s: The wildfire spread quickly across the dry hills, forcing many families to leave their homes.
wildfire.z: 野火迅速蔓延过干燥的山丘，迫使许多家庭离开家园。

willful.s: His willful refusal to follow the safety rules put everyone on the team at risk.
willful.z: 他故意拒绝遵守安全规则，使团队中的每个人都处于危险之中。

willing.s: She is always willing to help her classmates with their difficult homework.
willing.z: 她总是愿意帮助同学们解决困难的作业。

willow.s: The old willow by the river bends gently whenever the wind blows.
willow.z: 每当风吹过，河边那棵老柳树就会轻轻弯下枝条。

winding.s: The winding country road led us through several small villages and beautiful green hills.
winding.z: 那条蜿蜒的乡间小路带我们穿过了几个小村庄和美丽的绿色山丘。

windmill.s: The old windmill on the hill still turns slowly when the wind blows.
windmill.z: 山上的那座老风车在风吹来时仍然缓慢转动。

windy.s: It was so windy outside that my umbrella turned inside out twice.
windy.z: 外面风太大了，我的雨伞被吹翻了两次。

wisdom.s: True wisdom comes from experience rather than from reading books alone.
wisdom.z: 真正的智慧来自经验，而非仅仅来自读书。

wishful.s: Hoping to pass the exam without studying is just wishful thinking.
wishful.z: 不学习就希望通过考试，这不过是痴心妄想。

withdraw.s: She decided to withdraw her application because the working hours were too long.
withdraw.z: 由于工作时间太长，她决定撤回申请。

withhold.s: The committee decided to withhold the final results until all complaints were reviewed.
withhold.z: 委员会决定在审查完所有投诉之前暂不公布最终结果。

withstand.s: The old bridge was built to withstand strong winds and heavy floods.
withstand.z: 这座老桥的建造能够抵御强风和大洪水。

witness.s: Several students witnessed the accident and later described it to the police.
witness.z: 几名学生目睹了那起事故，后来向警方描述了经过。

witty.s: Her witty remarks made the long meeting feel much shorter and more enjoyable.
witty.z: 她机智的言辞让漫长的会议显得短了许多，也愉快了许多。

woe.s: She listened patiently to his tale of woe and offered him some comfort.
woe.z: 她耐心地听他诉说自己的不幸遭遇，并给了他一些安慰。

wonder.s: I wonder whether she will accept the job offer in another city.
wonder.z: 我想知道她是否会接受另一个城市的工作邀请。

wooden.s: The old man sat on a wooden bench in the park and fed the birds.
wooden.z: 那位老人坐在公园里的木制长椅上喂鸟。

woodpecker.s: A woodpecker was tapping loudly on the old tree outside my window.
woodpecker.z: 一只啄木鸟在我窗外的老树上大声地啄着。

workload.s: Heavy workloads often leave teachers with little time to rest or prepare lessons.
workload.z: 繁重的工作量常常使教师几乎没有时间休息或备课。

workman.s: The workman repaired the broken pipe in our kitchen within an hour.
workman.z: 那个工人在一小时内修好了我们厨房里破裂的管道。

workpiece.s: The worker clamped the metal workpiece firmly before starting the cutting machine.
workpiece.z: 工人在启动切割机前把金属工件牢牢夹紧。

world-wide.s: The Internet has made world-wide communication faster and cheaper than ever before.
world-wide.z: 互联网使全球通信比以往任何时候都更快、更便宜。

worldly.s: After years of traveling, she gained a worldly understanding of different cultures.
worldly.z: 经过多年的旅行，她对不同的文化有了世俗而深刻的了解。

worldwide.s: The new smartphone app quickly became popular worldwide after its release last month.
worldwide.z: 这款新的智能手机应用在上个月发布后迅速在世界各地流行起来。

worsen.s: Without proper treatment, his cough began to worsen within a few days.
worsen.z: 由于没有得到适当治疗，他的咳嗽在几天内开始加重。

worship.s: Many people worship at the temple every morning before going to work.
worship.z: 许多人每天早上上班前去寺庙里拜神。

worthless.s: He felt worthless after losing the job he had loved for years.
worthless.z: 失去了那份他热爱多年的工作后，他觉得自己毫无价值。

worthy.s: Her hard work and honesty make her worthy of everyone's respect.
worthy.z: 她的努力和诚实使她值得每个人的尊重。

wrath.s: Her face turned red with wrath when she discovered that someone had lied to her.
wrath.z: 当她发现有人对她撒谎时，她的脸因愤怒而涨得通红。

wreck.s: The storm wrecked several fishing boats along the coast last night.
wreck.z: 昨晚的暴风雨摧毁了沿海的几艘渔船。

wring.s: She had to wring the wet towel before hanging it on the line.
wring.z: 她不得不把湿毛巾拧干，然后再挂到绳子上。

writer.s: The writer spent three years working on her first novel about city life.
writer.z: 这位作家花了三年时间创作她第一部关于城市生活的小说。

writing.s: Her writing has improved a lot since she started keeping a daily journal.
writing.z: 自从她开始每天写日记以来，她的写作进步了很多。

xerox.s: She asked me to xerox the report before the meeting started.
xerox.z: 她让我在会议开始前复印那份报告。

yearly.s: The company holds a yearly meeting to review its progress and set new goals.
yearly.z: 公司每年举行一次会议，回顾进展并设定新目标。

yeast.s: The baker added a small amount of yeast to the dough before baking the bread.
yeast.z: 面包师在烘烤面包前向面团中加入了少量酵母。

yield.s: The new farming methods yielded twice as much grain as before.
yield.z: 新的耕作方法使粮食产量比过去翻了一番。

yoke.s: Many young workers feel the yoke of long hours and low pay every day.
yoke.z: 许多年轻工人每天都在承受长时间工作和低工资的束缚。

yolk.s: She carefully separated the yolk from the egg white before making the cake.
yolk.z: 做蛋糕前，她小心地把蛋黄和蛋清分开。

youth.s: Many young people spend their youth exploring new ideas and building lasting friendships.
youth.z: 许多年轻人在青年时期探索新想法并建立持久的友谊。

zinc.s: Doctors say that zinc can help the body fight off common colds.
zinc.z: 医生说锌有助于身体抵抗普通感冒。

zone.s: Students should avoid using their phones in the quiet study zone of the library.
zone.z: 学生应避免在图书馆的安静学习区内使用手机。
